"use client";

export const dynamic = "force-dynamic";

import { useEffect, useState } from "react";

interface DeliveryZone {
  id: number;
  zoneName: string;
  sectors: string;
  charge: number;
  createdAt: string;
}

export default function DeliveryZonesPage() {
  const [zones, setZones] =
    useState<DeliveryZone[]>([]);

  const [loading, setLoading] =
    useState(false);

  const [zoneName, setZoneName] =
    useState("");

  const [sectors, setSectors] =
    useState("");

  const [charge, setCharge] =
    useState("");

  useEffect(() => {
    loadZones();
  }, []);

  async function loadZones() {
    try {
      setLoading(true);

      const res = await fetch(
        "/api/delivery-zones"
      );

      const data =
        await res.json();

      setZones(data);
    } catch (error) {
      alert(
        "Failed To Load Zones"
      );
    } finally {
      setLoading(false);
    }
  }

  async function addZone() {
    if (
      !zoneName ||
      !sectors ||
      !charge
    ) {
      alert("Fill All Fields");
      return;
    }

    await fetch(
      "/api/delivery-zones",
      {
        method: "POST",
        headers: {
          "Content-Type":
            "application/json",
        },
        body: JSON.stringify({
          zoneName,
          sectors,
          charge,
        }),
      }
    );

    setZoneName("");
    setSectors("");
    setCharge("");

    loadZones();
  }

  async function editZone(
    zone: DeliveryZone
  ) {
    const newName =
      prompt(
        "Zone Name",
        zone.zoneName
      );

    if (!newName) return;

    const newSectors =
      prompt(
        "Sectors",
        zone.sectors
      );

    if (!newSectors) return;

    const newCharge =
      prompt(
        "Charge",
        String(zone.charge)
      );

    if (!newCharge) return;

    await fetch(
      "/api/delivery-zones",
      {
        method: "PUT",
        headers: {
          "Content-Type":
            "application/json",
        },
        body: JSON.stringify({
          id: zone.id,
          zoneName:
            newName,
          sectors:
            newSectors,
          charge:
            Number(
              newCharge
            ),
        }),
      }
    );

    loadZones();
  }

  async function deleteZone(
    id: number
  ) {
    const ok = confirm(
      "Delete This Zone?"
    );

    if (!ok) return;

    await fetch(
      "/api/delivery-zones",
      {
        method:
          "DELETE",
        headers: {
          "Content-Type":
            "application/json",
        },
        body: JSON.stringify({
          id,
        }),
      }
    );

    loadZones();
  }

  return (
    <div className="min-h-screen bg-gray-100 p-6">

      <div className="max-w-7xl mx-auto">

        <h1 className="text-4xl font-bold mb-8">
          Delivery Zones
        </h1>

        <div className="bg-white p-6 rounded-3xl shadow mb-8">

          <h2 className="text-2xl font-bold mb-4">
            Add Zone
          </h2>

          <div className="grid md:grid-cols-3 gap-4">

            <input
              value={zoneName}
              onChange={(e) =>
                setZoneName(
                  e.target.value
                )
              }
              placeholder="Zone Name"
              className="border p-3 rounded-xl"
            />

            <input
              value={sectors}
              onChange={(e) =>
                setSectors(
                  e.target.value
                )
              }
              placeholder="Sectors"
              className="border p-3 rounded-xl"
            />

            <input
              type="number"
              value={charge}
              onChange={(e) =>
                setCharge(
                  e.target.value
                )
              }
              placeholder="Charge"
              className="border p-3 rounded-xl"
            />

          </div>

          <button
            onClick={addZone}
            className="mt-5 bg-green-600 text-white px-8 py-3 rounded-xl"
          >
            Add Zone
          </button>

        </div>

        {loading ? (
          <div className="bg-white p-8 rounded-3xl">
            Loading...
          </div>
        ) : (
          <div className="grid md:grid-cols-3 gap-6">

            {zones.map(
              (zone) => (
                <div
                  key={zone.id}
                  className="bg-white p-6 rounded-3xl shadow"
                >
                  <h2 className="text-2xl font-bold">
                    {
                      zone.zoneName
                    }
                  </h2>

                  <p className="mt-3">
                    {
                      zone.sectors
                    }
                  </p>

                  <p className="mt-3 text-green-600 font-bold text-xl">
                    Ã¢â€šÂ¹
                    {
                      zone.charge
                    }
                  </p>

                  <div className="flex gap-2 mt-5">

                    <button
                      onClick={() =>
                        editZone(
                          zone
                        )
                      }
                      className="flex-1 bg-blue-600 text-white py-2 rounded-xl"
                    >
                      Edit
                    </button>

                    <button
                      onClick={() =>
                        deleteZone(
                          zone.id
                        )
                      }
                      className="flex-1 bg-red-600 text-white py-2 rounded-xl"
                    >
                      Delete
                    </button>

                  </div>

                </div>
              )
            )}

          </div>
        )}

      </div>

    </div>
  );

    setLoading] =
    useState(false);

    loadOrders();
  }, []);

  async function loadOrders() {
    try {
      const res =
        await fetch(
          "/api/admin-order-board"
        );

      const data =
        await res.json();

      setOrders(
        Array.isArray(data)
          ? data
          : []
      );
    } catch (
      error
    ) {
      console.error(
        error
      );
    }
  }

  async function dispatchOrder(
    order: any
  ) {
    setLoading(true);

    try {
      const res =
        await fetch(
          "/api/admin-auto-dispatch",
          {
            method:
              "POST",
            headers: {
              "Content-Type":
                "application/json",
            },
            body: JSON.stringify(
              {
                orderId:
                  order.id,

                latitude:
                  28.6139,

                longitude:
                  77.209,
              }
            ),
          }
        );

      const data =
        await res.json();

          data.error
        );

      alert(

Distance : ${data.distance} KM`
      );

      loadOrders();

      error
    ) {
      console.error(
        error
      );

"use client";

export const dynamic = "force-dynamic";

import { useEffect, useState } from "react";

export default function EmployeesPage() {
  const [employees, setEmployees] =
    useState<any[]>([]);

  const [form, setForm] = useState({
    name: "",
    phone: "",
    role: "",
    salary: "",
  });

  useEffect(() => {
    loadEmployees();
  }, []);

  function loadEmployees() {
    const data = JSON.parse(
      localStorage.getItem(
        "freshcut-employees"
      ) || "[]"
    );

    setEmployees(data);
  }

  function addEmployee() {
    if (
      !form.name ||
      !form.phone
    ) {
      alert("Fill Required Fields");
      return;
    }

    const employee = {
      id: Date.now(),
      ...form,
      attendance: "Present",
      salaryPaid: false,
      joiningDate:
        new Date().toLocaleDateString(),
    };

    const updated = [
      employee,
      ...employees,
    ];

    localStorage.setItem(
      "freshcut-employees",
      JSON.stringify(updated)
    );

    setForm({
      name: "",
      phone: "",
      role: "",
      salary: "",
    });

    loadEmployees();
  }

  function toggleAttendance(
    id: number
  ) {
    const updated =
      employees.map((emp) =>
        emp.id === id
          ? {
              ...emp,
              attendance:
                emp.attendance ===
                "Present"
                  ? "Absent"
                  : "Present",
            }
          : emp
      );

    localStorage.setItem(
      "freshcut-employees",
      JSON.stringify(updated)
    );

    setEmployees(updated);
  }

  function markSalaryPaid(
    id: number
  ) {
    const updated =
      employees.map((emp) =>
        emp.id === id
          ? {
              ...emp,
              salaryPaid: true,
            }
          : emp
      );

    localStorage.setItem(
      "freshcut-employees",
      JSON.stringify(updated)
    );

    setEmployees(updated);

        <div className="bg-white rounded-3xl shadow p-6 mb-8">

          <h2 className="text-2xl font-bold mb-4">
            Add Employee
          </h2>

          <div className="grid md:grid-cols-4 gap-4">

            <input
              placeholder="Employee Name"
              value={form.name}
              onChange={(e) =>
                setForm({
                  ...form,
                  name:
                    e.target.value,
                })
              }
              className="border p-3 rounded-xl"
            />

            <input
              placeholder="Phone Number"
              value={form.phone}
              onChange={(e) =>
                setForm({
                  ...form,
                  phone:
                    e.target.value,
                })
              }
              className="border p-3 rounded-xl"
            />

            <input
              placeholder="Role"
              value={form.role}
              onChange={(e) =>
                setForm({
                  ...form,
                  role:
                    e.target.value,
                })
              }
              className="border p-3 rounded-xl"
            />

            <input
              placeholder="Monthly Salary"
              value={form.salary}
              onChange={(e) =>
                setForm({
                  ...form,
                  salary:
                    e.target.value,
                })
              }
              className="border p-3 rounded-xl"
            />

          </div>

          <button
            onClick={addEmployee}
            className="mt-6 bg-green-600 text-white px-8 py-3 rounded-xl"
          >
            Add Employee
          </button>

        </div>

        <div className="grid md:grid-cols-3 gap-6">

          {employees.map(
            (employee) => (

              <div
                key={employee.id}
                className="bg-white rounded-3xl shadow p-6"
              >

                <h2 className="text-2xl font-bold">
                  {employee.name}
                </h2>

                <p>
                  ÃƒÂ°Ã…Â¸Ã¢â‚¬Å“Ã…Â¾ {employee.phone}

"use client";

export const dynamic = "force-dynamic";

import { useEffect, useState } from "react";

export default function ExpensesPage() {
  const [expenses, setExpenses] = useState<any[]>([]);
  const [title, setTitle] = useState("");
  const [amount, setAmount] = useState("");

  useEffect(() => {
    loadExpenses();
  }, []);

  function loadExpenses() {
    try {
      setExpenses(
        JSON.parse(localStorage.getItem("freshcut-expenses") || "[]")
      );
    } catch {
      setExpenses([]);
    }
  }

  function addExpense() {
    if (!title || !amount) {
      alert("Fill All Fields");
      return;
    }

    const updated = [
      {
        id: Date.now(),
        title,
        amount: Number(amount),
        date: new Date().toLocaleDateString(),
      },
      ...expenses,
    ];

    localStorage.setItem("freshcut-expenses", JSON.stringify(updated));
    setExpenses(updated);
    setTitle("");
    setAmount("");
  }

  function deleteExpense(id: number) {
    const updated = expenses.filter((item) => item.id !== id);
    localStorage.setItem("freshcut-expenses", JSON.stringify(updated));
    setExpenses(updated);
  }

  const totalExpense = expenses.reduce(
    (sum, item) => sum + Number(item.amount || 0),
    0
  );

  return (
    <div className="min-h-screen bg-[#f5f7f7] p-5 md:p-7">
      <div className="mx-auto max-w-[1600px]">
        <div className="mb-7">
          <p className="text-xs font-bold uppercase tracking-[0.18em] text-emerald-700">
            Fresh2Cook Admin
          </p>
          <h1 className="mt-1 text-3xl font-extrabold text-[#123b38] md:text-4xl">
            Expense Management
          </h1>
          <p className="mt-1 text-sm text-slate-500">
            Track operational expenses and business spending.
          </p>
        </div>

        <div className="mb-7 rounded-2xl border border-slate-200 bg-white p-6 shadow-sm">
          <h2 className="text-lg font-extrabold text-[#123b38]">
            Add Expense
          </h2>

          <div className="mt-5 grid gap-4 md:grid-cols-3">
            <input
              value={title}
              onChange={(e) => setTitle(e.target.value)}
              placeholder="Expense Title"
              className="rounded-xl border border-slate-300 px-4 py-3 text-sm outline-none focus:border-emerald-600"
            />

            <input
              value={amount}
              onChange={(e) => setAmount(e.target.value)}
              placeholder="Amount"
              type="number"
              className="rounded-xl border border-slate-300 px-4 py-3 text-sm outline-none focus:border-emerald-600"
            />

            <button
              onClick={addExpense}
              className="rounded-xl bg-[#063f3d] px-6 py-3 text-sm font-bold text-white hover:bg-[#0a514d]"
            >
              + Add Expense
            </button>
          </div>
        </div>

        <div className="mb-7 rounded-2xl border border-red-100 bg-red-50 p-6">
          <p className="text-sm font-bold text-red-700">Total Expenses</p>
          <p className="mt-2 text-4xl font-extrabold text-[#123b38]">
            â‚¹{totalExpense.toLocaleString("en-IN")}
          </p>
        </div>

        <div className="rounded-2xl border border-slate-200 bg-white p-6 shadow-sm">
          <div className="mb-5">
            <h2 className="text-lg font-extrabold text-[#123b38]">
              Expense History
            </h2>
            <p className="text-sm text-slate-500">
              Recent business expenses.
            </p>
          </div>

          <div className="space-y-3">
            {expenses.length === 0 && (
              <div className="rounded-xl bg-slate-50 p-10 text-center text-sm text-slate-500">
                No Expenses Found
              </div>
            )}

            {expenses.map((item) => (
              <div
                key={item.id}
                className="flex flex-col gap-4 rounded-xl border border-slate-100 bg-slate-50 p-4 md:flex-row md:items-center md:justify-between"
              >

"use client";

export const dynamic = "force-dynamic";

import { useEffect, useMemo, useState } from "react";

type Feedback = {
  id: number;
  customer: string;
  phone: string;
  rating: number;
  comment: string;
  createdAt: string;
};

export default function AdminFeedbackPage() {
  const [feedback, setFeedback] =
    useState<Feedback[]>([]);

  const [loading, setLoading] =
    useState(true);

  const [search, setSearch] =
    useState("");

  const [ratingFilter, setRatingFilter] =
    useState("All");

  const [errorMessage, setErrorMessage] =
    useState("");

  useEffect(() => {
    loadFeedback();
  }, []);

  async function loadFeedback() {
    try {
      setLoading(true);
      setErrorMessage("");

      const response =
        await fetch("/api/feedback", {
          cache: "no-store",
        });

      const data =
        await response.json();

      if (!response.ok) {
        throw new Error(
          data?.error ||
            "Failed to load feedback"
        );
      }

      setFeedback(
        Array.isArray(data)
          ? data
          : []
      );
    } catch (error) {
      console.error(
        "LOAD FEEDBACK ERROR:",
        error
      );

      setErrorMessage(
        error instanceof Error
          ? error.message
          : "Failed to load feedback"
      );
    } finally {
      setLoading(false);
    }
  }

  const filteredFeedback =
    useMemo(() => {
      const query =
        search
          .trim()
          .toLowerCase();

      return feedback.filter(
        (item) => {
          const matchesSearch =
            !query ||
            item.customer
              .toLowerCase()
              .includes(query) ||
            item.phone
              .toLowerCase()
              .includes(query) ||
            item.comment
              .toLowerCase()
              .includes(query);

          const matchesRating =
            ratingFilter === "All" ||
            item.rating ===
              Number(ratingFilter);

          return (
            matchesSearch &&
            matchesRating
          );
        }
      );
    }, [
      feedback,
      search,
      ratingFilter,
    ]);

  const averageRating =
    feedback.length > 0
      ? (
          feedback.reduce(
            (sum, item) =>
              sum +
              Number(
                item.rating || 0
              ),
            0
          ) / feedback.length
        ).toFixed(1)
      : "0.0";

  const fiveStarCount =
    feedback.filter(
      (item) =>
        item.rating === 5
    ).length;

  const fourStarCount =
    feedback.filter(
      (item) =>
        item.rating === 4
    ).length;

  function openWhatsApp(
    item: Feedback
  ) {
    const number =
      item.phone.replace(
        /\D/g,
        ""
      );

    if (!number) {
      alert(
        "Customer mobile number is not available."
      );
      return;
    }

    const whatsappNumber =
      number.length === 10
        ? `91${number}`
        : number;

    const message = [
      `Hello ${item.customer},`,
      "",
      "Thank you for your valuable feedback for Fresh2Cook! ÃƒÂ¢Ã‚ÂÃ‚Â¤ÃƒÂ¯Ã‚Â¸Ã‚Â",
      "",
      `Your Rating: ${item.rating}/5 ÃƒÂ¢Ã‚Â­Ã‚Â`,
      `Your Review: ${item.comment}`,
      "",
      "We truly appreciate your support.",
    ].join("\n");

    window.open(
      `https://wa.me/${whatsappNumber}?text=${encodeURIComponent(
        message
      )}`,
      "_blank",
      "noopener,noreferrer"
    );
  }

  return (
    <div className="min-h-screen bg-gray-100 p-6">

      <div className="max-w-7xl mx-auto">

        {/* HEADER */}

        <div className="flex flex-col md:flex-row md:items-center md:justify-between gap-4 mb-8">

          <div>

            <h1 className="text-4xl font-bold">
              Customer Feedback & Reviews
            </h1>

            <p className="text-gray-500 mt-1">
              View customer ratings and reviews for Fresh2Cook.
            </p>

          </div>

          <button
            onClick={loadFeedback}
            className="bg-green-600 hover:bg-green-700 text-white px-6 py-3 rounded-xl font-bold"
          >
            Refresh Reviews
          </button>

        </div>

        {/* ERROR */}

        {errorMessage && (
          <div className="mb-6 bg-red-50 border border-red-200 text-red-700 rounded-2xl p-4 font-semibold">
            {errorMessage}
          </div>
        )}

        {/* STATS */}

        <div className="grid grid-cols-2 md:grid-cols-4 gap-4 mb-6">

          <div className="bg-white rounded-2xl shadow p-5">

            <div className="text-sm text-gray-500">
              Total Reviews
            </div>

            <div className="text-3xl font-extrabold mt-1">
              {feedback.length}
            </div>

          </div>

          <div className="bg-white rounded-2xl shadow p-5">

            <div className="text-sm text-gray-500">
              Average Rating
            </div>

            <div className="text-3xl font-extrabold text-yellow-500 mt-1">
              {averageRating} ÃƒÂ¢Ã‚Â­Ã‚Â
            </div>

          </div>

          <div className="bg-white rounded-2xl shadow p-5">

            <div className="text-sm text-gray-500">

            </div>

          <div className="bg-white rounded-2xl shadow p-5">

  const [stats, setStats] =
    useState({
      revenue: 0,
      expenses: 0,
      profit: 0,
      gst: 0,
      orders: 0,
    });

  useEffect(() => {
    loadData();
  }, []);

  function loadData() {
    const orders = JSON.parse(
      localStorage.getItem(
        "freshcut-orders"
      ) || "[]"
    );

    const expenses = JSON.parse(
      localStorage.getItem(
        "freshcut-expenses"
      ) || "[]"
    );

    const revenue =
      orders.reduce(
        (
          sum: number,
          item: any
        ) =>
          sum +
          Number(
            item.total || 0
          ),
        0
      );

    const totalExpense =
      expenses.reduce(
        (
          sum: number,
          item: any
        ) =>
          sum +
          Number(
            item.amount || 0
          ),
        0
      );

    const gst =
      revenue * 0.05;

    const profit =
      revenue -
      totalExpense -
      gst;

    setStats({
      revenue,
      expenses:
        totalExpense,
      profit,
      gst,
      orders:
        orders.length,
    });
  }

  return (
    <div className="min-h-screen bg-gray-100 p-6">

      <div className="max-w-7xl mx-auto">

        <h1 className="text-4xl font-bold mb-8">
          Finance & GST Dashboard
        </h1>

        <div className="grid md:grid-cols-5 gap-4 mb-8">

          <div className="bg-white p-6 rounded-3xl shadow">
            <p>Revenue</p>
            <h2 className="text-3xl font-bold text-green-600">
              Ã¢â€šÂ¹{stats.revenue}
            </h2>
          </div>

          <div className="bg-white p-6 rounded-3xl shadow">
            <p>Expenses</p>
            <h2 className="text-3xl font-bold text-red-600">
              Ã¢â€šÂ¹{stats.expenses}
            </h2>
          </div>

          <div className="bg-white p-6 rounded-3xl shadow">
            <p>GST</p>
            <h2 className="text-3xl font-bold text-orange-600">
              Ã¢â€šÂ¹{stats.gst}
            </h2>
          </div>

          <div className="bg-white p-6 rounded-3xl shadow">
            <p>Profit</p>
            <h2 className="text-3xl font-bold text-blue-600">
              Ã¢â€šÂ¹{stats.profit}
            </h2>
          </div>

          <div className="bg-white p-6 rounded-3xl shadow">

"use client";

export const dynamic = "force-dynamic";

import { useEffect, useState } from "react";

export default function FranchisePage() {
  const [franchises, setFranchises] =
    useState<any[]>([]);

  const [name, setName] =
    useState("");

  const [city, setCity] =
    useState("");

  const [phone, setPhone] =
    useState("");

  useEffect(() => {
    loadData();
  }, []);

  function loadData() {
    const data = JSON.parse(
      localStorage.getItem(
        "freshcut-franchises"
      ) || "[]"
    );

    setFranchises(data);
  }

  function addFranchise() {
    if (
      !name ||
      !city ||
      !phone
    ) {
      alert(
        "Fill All Fields"
      );
      return;
    }

    const updated = [
      {
        id: Date.now(),
        name,
        city,
        phone,
        status: "Active",
        createdAt:
          new Date().toLocaleDateString(),
      },
      ...franchises,
    ];

    localStorage.setItem(
      "freshcut-franchises",
      JSON.stringify(updated)
    );

    setName("");
    setCity("");
    setPhone("");

    loadData();
  }

  function removeFranchise(
    id: number
  ) {
    const updated =
      franchises.filter(
        (item) =>
          item.id !== id
      );

    localStorage.setItem(
      "freshcut-franchises",
      JSON.stringify(updated)
    );

    loadData();
  }

  return (
    <div className="min-h-screen bg-gray-100 p-6">

      <div className="max-w-7xl mx-auto">

        <h1 className="text-4xl font-bold mb-8">
          Franchise Management
        </h1>

        <div className="bg-white rounded-3xl shadow p-6 mb-8">

          <h2 className="text-2xl font-bold mb-4">
            Add Franchise
          </h2>

          <div className="grid md:grid-cols-3 gap-4">

            <input
              value={name}
              onChange={(e) =>
                setName(
                  e.target.value
                )
              }
              placeholder="Franchise Owner"
              className="border p-3 rounded-xl"
            />

            <input
              value={city}
              onChange={(e) =>
                setCity(
                  e.target.value
                )
              }
              placeholder="City"
              className="border p-3 rounded-xl"
            />

            <input
              value={phone}
              onChange={(e) =>
                setPhone(
                  e.target.value
                )
              }
              placeholder="Mobile Number"
              className="border p-3 rounded-xl"
            />

          </div>

          <button
            onClick={
              addFranchise
            }
            className="mt-5 bg-green-600 text-white px-8 py-3 rounded-xl font-bold"
          >
            Add Franchise
          </button>

        </div>

        <div className="space-y-4">

          {franchises.map(
            (item: any) => (
              <div
                key={item.id}
                className="bg-white rounded-3xl shadow p-6"
              >

                <div className="flex justify-between items-center">

                  <div>

                    <h2 className="text-xl font-bold">
                      {item.name}
                    </h2>

                    <p>
                      ÃƒÂ°Ã…Â¸Ã¢â‚¬Å“Ã‚Â {item.city}

export const dynamic = "force-dynamic";

import { useEffect, useState } from "react";

export default function FranchiseLeadsPage() {
  const [leads, setLeads] =
    useState<any[]>([]);

  const [name, setName] =
    useState("");

  const [city, setCity] =
    useState("");

  const [phone, setPhone] =
    useState("");

  useEffect(() => {
    loadLeads();
  }, []);

  function loadLeads() {
    const data = JSON.parse(
      localStorage.getItem(
        "freshcut-franchise-leads"
      ) || "[]"
    );

    setLeads(data);
  }

  function addLead() {
    if (
      !name ||
      !city ||
      !phone
    ) {
      alert(
        "Fill All Fields"
      );
      return;
    }

    const updated = [
      {
        id: Date.now(),
        name,
        city,
        phone,
        status: "New Lead",
        createdAt:
          new Date().toLocaleDateString(),
      },
      ...leads,
    ];

    localStorage.setItem(
      "freshcut-franchise-leads",
      JSON.stringify(updated)
    );

    setName("");
    setCity("");
    setPhone("");

    loadLeads();
  }

  function updateStatus(
    id: number,
    status: string
  ) {
    const updated =
      leads.map(
        (lead: any) =>
          lead.id === id
            ? {
                ...lead,
                status,
              }
            : lead
      );

    localStorage.setItem(
      "freshcut-franchise-leads",
      JSON.stringify(updated)
    );

    loadLeads();
  }

  function deleteLead(
    id: number
  ) {
    const updated =
      leads.filter(
        (lead: any) =>
          lead.id !== id
      );

    localStorage.setItem(
      "freshcut-franchise-leads",
      JSON.stringify(updated)
    );

    loadLeads();
  }

  return (
    <div className="min-h-screen bg-gray-100 p-6">

                  e.target.value
                )

              placeholder="Lead Name"
              className="border p-3 rounded-xl"
            />

            <input
              value={city}
              onChange={(e) =>
                setCity(
                  e.target.value
                )
              }
              placeholder="City"
              className="border p-3 rounded-xl"
            />

            <input
              value={phone}
              onChange={(e) =>
                setPhone(
                  e.target.value
                )
              }
              placeholder="Phone Number"
              className="border p-3 rounded-xl"
            />

          </div>

          <button
            onClick={addLead}
            className="mt-5 bg-green-600 text-white px-8 py-3 rounded-xl font-bold"
          >
            Save Lead
          </button>

        </div>

        <div className="space-y-4">

          {leads.map(
            (lead: any) => (
              <div
                key={lead.id}
                className="bg-white rounded-3xl shadow p-6"

      localStorage.getItem(
        "freshcut-franchises"
      ) || "[]"
    );

    setFranchises(data);
  }

  const totalRevenue =
    franchises.reduce(

        ),

          </div>

        </div>

          <h2 className="text-2xl font-bold mb-4">

          </h2>

            {franchises.map(

                  key={index}

                >
                  <div>

                      {item.name}
                    </h3>

                    <p>
                      {item.city}

"use client";

export const dynamic = "force-dynamic";

import { useState } from "react";

export default function ImportProductsPage() {
  const [csvData, setCsvData] =
    useState("");

  function importProducts() {
    if (!csvData) {
      alert("Paste CSV Data");
      return;
    }

    const rows =
      csvData.trim().split("\n");

    const products =
      JSON.parse(
        localStorage.getItem(
          "freshcut-products"
        ) || "[]"
      );

    rows.forEach((row) => {
      const cols = row.split(",");

      if (cols.length >= 5) {
        products.push({
          id: Date.now() + Math.random(),
          name: cols[0],
          price: Number(cols[1]),
          stock: cols[2],
          pack: cols[3],
          image: cols[4],
        });
      }
    });

    localStorage.setItem(
      "freshcut-products",
      JSON.stringify(products)
    );

    alert(
      "Products Imported Successfully"
    );

    setCsvData("");
  }

  return (
    <div className="min-h-screen bg-gray-100 p-6">

      <div className="max-w-5xl mx-auto">

        <div className="bg-white rounded-3xl shadow-xl p-8">

          <h1 className="text-4xl font-bold mb-6">
            Bulk Product Import
          </h1>

          <div className="bg-yellow-50 border rounded-xl p-4 mb-6">

            <p className="font-bold">
              CSV Format
            </p>

            <p>
              Name,Price,Stock,Pack,ImageURL
            </p>

            <p>
              Bhindi,49,100,500gm,https://image.jpg
            </p>

          </div>

          <textarea
            value={csvData}
            onChange={(e) =>
              setCsvData(
                e.target.value
              )
            }
            rows={15}
            className="w-full border rounded-xl p-4"
            placeholder="Paste CSV Here..."
          />

          <button
            onClick={importProducts}
            className="mt-6 bg-green-600 text-white px-8 py-3 rounded-xl font-bold"
          >
            Import Products
          </button>

        </div>

      </div>

    </div>
  );
}

"use client";

export const dynamic = "force-dynamic";

import { useEffect, useState } from "react";

export default function InventoryPage() {
  const [items, setItems] =
    useState<any[]>([]);

  const [name, setName] =
    useState("");

  const [stock, setStock] =
    useState("");

  const [unit, setUnit] =
    useState("Kg");

  useEffect(() => {
    loadInventory();
  }, []);

  function loadInventory() {
    const data = JSON.parse(
      localStorage.getItem(
        "freshcut-inventory"
      ) || "[]"
    );

    setItems(data);
  }

  function addItem() {
    if (!name || !stock) {
      alert(
        "Fill All Fields"
      );
      return;
    }

    const item = {
      id: Date.now(),
      name,
      stock,
      unit,
      updatedAt:
        new Date().toLocaleDateString(),
    };

    const updated = [
      item,
      ...items,
    ];

    localStorage.setItem(
      "freshcut-inventory",
      JSON.stringify(updated)
    );

    setItems(updated);

    setName("");
    setStock("");

    alert(
      "Inventory Added"
    );
  }

  function updateStock(
    id: number,
    value: string
  ) {
    const updated =
      items.map((item) =>
        item.id === id
          ? {
              ...item,
              stock: value,
              updatedAt:
                new Date().toLocaleDateString(),
            }
          : item
      );

    localStorage.setItem(
      "freshcut-inventory",
      JSON.stringify(updated)
    );

    setItems(updated);
  }

  function deleteItem(
    id: number
  ) {
    if (
      !confirm(
        "Delete Item?"
      )
    )
      return;

    const updated =
      items.filter(
        (item) =>
          item.id !== id
      );

    localStorage.setItem(
      "freshcut-inventory",
      JSON.stringify(updated)
    );

    setItems(updated);
  }

  return (
    <div className="min-h-screen bg-gray-100 p-6">

      <div className="max-w-7xl mx-auto">

        <h1 className="text-4xl font-bold mb-8">
          Inventory Management
        </h1>

        <div className="bg-white rounded-3xl shadow p-6 mb-8">

          <h2 className="text-2xl font-bold mb-4">
            Add Inventory
          </h2>

          <div className="grid md:grid-cols-3 gap-4">

            <input
              value={name}
              onChange={(e) =>
                setName(
                  e.target.value
                )
              }
              placeholder="Item Name"
              className="border p-3 rounded-xl"
            />

            <input
              value={stock}
              onChange={(e) =>
                setStock(
                  e.target.value
                )
              }
              placeholder="Stock"
              className="border p-3 rounded-xl"
            />

            <select
              value={unit}
              onChange={(e) =>
                setUnit(
                  e.target.value
                )
              }
              className="border p-3 rounded-xl"
            >
              <option>Kg</option>
              <option>Gram</option>
              <option>Piece</option>
              <option>Packet</option>
              <option>Box</option>
            </select>

          </div>

          <button
            onClick={addItem}
            className="mt-5 bg-green-600 text-white px-8 py-3 rounded-xl font-bold"
          >
            Add Item
          </button>

        </div>

        <div className="space-y-4">

          {items.map(
            (item) => (

              <div
                key={item.id}
                className="bg-white rounded-3xl shadow p-6 flex justify-between items-center"
              >

                <div>

                  <h2 className="text-xl font-bold">
                    {item.name}
                  </h2>

                  <p className="text-gray-500">
                    Updated:
                    {" "}
                    {item.updatedAt}
                  </p>

                </div>

                <div className="flex items-center gap-3">

                  <input
                    value={item.stock}
                    onChange={(e) =>
                      updateStock(
                        item.id,
                        e.target.value
                      )
                    }
                    className="border p-2 rounded-lg w-24"
                  />

                  <span>
                    {item.unit}
                  </span>

                  <button
                    onClick={() =>
                      deleteItem(
                        item.id
                      )
                    }
                    className="bg-red-600 text-white px-4 py-2 rounded-xl"
                  >
                    Delete
                  </button>

                </div>

              </div>

            )
          )}

        </div>

      </div>

    </div>
  );
}

"use client";

export const dynamic = "force-dynamic";

import { FormEvent, useState } from "react";
import {
  ShieldCheck,
  Eye,
  EyeOff,
  Loader2,
  UserPlus,
} from "lucide-react";

export default function AdminLoginPage() {
  const [setupMode, setSetupMode] = useState(false);
  const [name, setName] = useState("");
  const [mobile, setMobile] = useState("");
  const [password, setPassword] = useState("");
  const [showPassword, setShowPassword] = useState(false);
  const [loading, setLoading] = useState(false);
  const [message, setMessage] = useState("");

  async function submit(event: FormEvent) {
    event.preventDefault();

    setLoading(true);
    setMessage("");

    try {
      const endpoint = setupMode
        ? "/api/auth/staff-setup"
        : "/api/auth/staff-login";

      const body = setupMode
        ? {
            name,
            mobile,
            password,
            role: "SUPER_ADMIN",
          }
        : {
            mobile,
            password,
            role: "SUPER_ADMIN",
          };

      const response = await fetch(endpoint, {
        method: "POST",
        headers: {
          "Content-Type": "application/json",
        },
        body: JSON.stringify(body),
      });

      const data = await response.json();

      if (!response.ok || !data.success) {
        if (
          !setupMode &&
          data.code === "NO_ACCOUNT"
        ) {
          setSetupMode(true);
        }

        throw new Error(
          data.message ||
            "Unable to continue"
        );
      }

      window.location.href = "/admin";
    } catch (error) {
      setMessage(
        error instanceof Error
          ? error.message
          : "Unable to continue"
      );
    } finally {
      setLoading(false);
    }
  }

  return (
    <main className="min-h-screen bg-gradient-to-br from-slate-50 via-white to-emerald-50 px-4 py-10">
      <div className="mx-auto flex min-h-[80vh] max-w-md items-center justify-center">

        <div className="w-full rounded-3xl border border-slate-200 bg-white p-7 shadow-xl">

          <div className="mb-7 text-center">

            <div className="mx-auto mb-4 flex h-16 w-16 items-center justify-center rounded-2xl bg-slate-900 text-white">
              <ShieldCheck size={34} />
            </div>

            <h1 className="text-2xl font-extrabold text-slate-900">
              Super Admin
            </h1>

            <p className="mt-1 text-sm text-slate-500">
              {setupMode
                ? "Create the first Super Admin account"
                : "Secure admin login"}
            </p>

          </div>

          <form
            onSubmit={submit}
            className="space-y-4"
          >

            {setupMode && (
              <input
                value={name}
                onChange={(e) =>
                  setName(e.target.value)
                }
                placeholder="Full Name"
                className="h-12 w-full rounded-xl border border-slate-200 px-4 outline-none focus:border-emerald-500"
              />
            )}

            <input
              value={mobile}
              onChange={(e) =>
                setMobile(
                  e.target.value
                    .replace(/\D/g, "")
                    .slice(0, 10)
                )
              }
              placeholder="Mobile Number"
              inputMode="numeric"
              className="h-12 w-full rounded-xl border border-slate-200 px-4 outline-none focus:border-emerald-500"
            />

            <div className="relative">

              <input
                value={password}
                onChange={(e) =>
                  setPassword(
                    e.target.value
                  )
                }
                type={
                  showPassword
                    ? "text"
                    : "password"
                }
                placeholder="Password"
                className="h-12 w-full rounded-xl border border-slate-200 px-4 pr-12 outline-none focus:border-emerald-500"
              />

              <button
                type="button"
                onClick={() =>
                  setShowPassword(
                    (value) => !value
                  )
                }
                className="absolute right-3 top-1/2 -translate-y-1/2 text-slate-500"
                aria-label="Toggle password visibility"
              >
                {showPassword ? (
                  <EyeOff size={20} />
                ) : (
                  <Eye size={20} />
                )}
              </button>

            </div>

            {message && (
              <div className="rounded-xl bg-red-50 px-4 py-3 text-sm font-medium text-red-700">
                {message}
              </div>
            )}

            <button
              type="submit"
              disabled={loading}
              className="flex h-12 w-full items-center justify-center gap-2 rounded-xl bg-emerald-600 font-bold text-white transition hover:bg-emerald-700 disabled:opacity-60"
            >
              {loading ? (
                <Loader2
                  className="animate-spin"
                  size={19}
                />
              ) : setupMode ? (
                <UserPlus size={19} />
              ) : (
                <ShieldCheck size={19} />
              )}

              {loading
                ? "Please wait..."
                : setupMode
                  ? "Create Super Admin"
                  : "Login"}
            </button>

          </form>

          <div className="mt-5 text-center">
            <button
              type="button"
              onClick={() => {
                setSetupMode(
                  (value) => !value
                );
                setMessage("");
              }}
              className="text-sm font-semibold text-emerald-700 hover:underline"
            >
              {setupMode
                ? "Back to Login"
                : "First time setup"}
            </button>
          </div>

          <div className="mt-6 border-t pt-5 text-center text-xs text-slate-400">
            Processing Team Login:{" "}
            <a
              className="font-semibold text-emerald-700"
              href="/processing/login"
            >
              /processing/login
            </a>
          </div>

        </div>
      </div>
    </main>
  );
}

"use client";

export const dynamic = "force-dynamic";

import { useEffect, useState } from "react";

export default function LoyaltyPage() {
  const [customers, setCustomers] =
    useState<any[]>([]);

  useEffect(() => {
    loadCustomers();
  }, []);

  function loadCustomers() {
    const orders = JSON.parse(
      localStorage.getItem(
        "freshcut-orders"
      ) || "[]"
    );

    const customerMap: any = {};

    orders.forEach(
      (order: any) => {
        const phone =
          order.phone;

        if (
          !customerMap[phone]
        ) {
          customerMap[phone] = {
            customer:
              order.customer,
            phone:
              order.phone,
            orders: 0,
            spend: 0,
            points: 0,
          };
        }

        customerMap[
          phone
        ].orders += 1;

        customerMap[
          phone
        ].spend += Number(
          order.total || 0
        );

        customerMap[
          phone
        ].points =
          Math.floor(
            customerMap[
              phone
            ].spend / 100
          );
      }
    );

    setCustomers(
      Object.values(
        customerMap
      )
    );
  }

  function redeemPoints(
    phone: string
  ) {
    const updated =
      customers.map(
        (customer: any) =>
          customer.phone ===
          phone
            ? {
                ...customer,
                points: 0,
              }
            : customer
      );

    setCustomers(updated);

    alert(
      "Points Redeemed Successfully"
    );
  }

  return (
    <div className="min-h-screen bg-gray-100 p-6">

      <div className="max-w-7xl mx-auto">

        <h1 className="text-4xl font-bold mb-8">
          Loyalty Program
        </h1>

        <div className="grid md:grid-cols-3 gap-6">

          {customers.map(
            (
              customer: any,
              index
            ) => (

              <div
                key={index}
                className="bg-white rounded-3xl shadow p-6"
              >

                <h2 className="text-2xl font-bold">
                  {
                    customer.customer
                  }
                </h2>

                <p className="mt-2">
                  ÃƒÂ°Ã…Â¸Ã¢â‚¬Å“Ã…Â¾{" "}
                  {
                    customer.phone
                  }
                </p>

                <div className="mt-5">

                  <div className="bg-blue-50 rounded-xl p-3 mb-3">

                    Orders:
                    {" "}
                    <strong>
                      {
                        customer.orders
                      }
                    </strong>

                  </div>

                  <div className="bg-green-50 rounded-xl p-3 mb-3">

                    Spend:
                    {" "}
                    <strong>
                      Ã¢â€šÂ¹
                      {
                        customer.spend
                      }
                    </strong>

                  </div>

                  <div className="bg-yellow-50 rounded-xl p-3">

                    Reward Points:
                    {" "}
                    <strong>

                    </strong>

"use client";

export const dynamic = "force-dynamic";

import { useEffect, useState } from "react";

export default function NotificationsPage() {
  const [notifications, setNotifications] = useState<any[]>([]);
  const [title, setTitle] = useState("");
  const [message, setMessage] = useState("");

  useEffect(() => {
    loadNotifications();
  }, []);

  function loadNotifications() {
    const data = JSON.parse(
      localStorage.getItem("freshcut-notifications") || "[]"
    );

    setNotifications(data);
  }

  function sendNotification() {
    if (!title || !message) {
      alert("Fill All Fields");
      return;
    }

    const notification = {
      id: Date.now(),
      title,
      message,
      date: new Date().toLocaleString(),
      status: "Sent",
    };

    const updated = [notification, ...notifications];

    localStorage.setItem(
      "freshcut-notifications",
      JSON.stringify(updated)
    );

    setNotifications(updated);
    setTitle("");
    setMessage("");

    alert("Notification Sent Successfully");
  }

  function deleteNotification(id: number) {
    if (!confirm("Delete Notification?")) return;

    const updated = notifications.filter(
      (item) => item.id !== id
    );

    localStorage.setItem(
      "freshcut-notifications",
      JSON.stringify(updated)
    );

    setNotifications(updated);
  }

  return (
    <div className="min-h-screen bg-gradient-to-br from-slate-50 via-white to-emerald-50 p-6">

      <div className="max-w-7xl mx-auto space-y-6">

        <div className="bg-white/80 backdrop-blur-xl border border-white rounded-3xl shadow-xl p-8">

          <h1 className="text-4xl font-bold text-slate-800">
            Notification Center
          </h1>

          <p className="text-slate-500 mt-2">
            Customer Alerts & Push Notifications
          </p>

        </div>

        <div className="grid md:grid-cols-3 gap-5">

          <div className="bg-white rounded-3xl shadow-lg p-6">
            <p className="text-slate-500">Total Notifications</p>
            <h2 className="text-4xl font-bold text-slate-800 mt-2">
              {notifications.length}
            </h2>
          </div>

          <div className="bg-white rounded-3xl shadow-lg p-6">
            <p className="text-slate-500">Today's Broadcast</p>
            <h2 className="text-4xl font-bold text-emerald-600 mt-2">
              {notifications.length}

"use client";

export const dynamic = "force-dynamic";

import { useEffect, useMemo, useState } from "react";

export default function OrdersPage() {
  const [orders, setOrders] = useState<any[]>([]);
  const [boys, setBoys] = useState<any[]>([]);
  const [loading, setLoading] = useState(true);
  const [search, setSearch] = useState("");
  const [statusFilter, setStatusFilter] = useState("All");

  useEffect(() => {
    loadData();
  }, []);

  async function loadData() {
    try {
      const [ordersRes, boysRes] = await Promise.all([
        fetch("/api/orders"),
        fetch("/api/delivery-boys"),
      ]);

      const ordersData = await ordersRes.json();
      const boysData = await boysRes.json();

      setOrders(Array.isArray(ordersData) ? ordersData : ordersData?.orders || []);
      setBoys(
        Array.isArray(boysData)
          ? boysData
          : boysData?.riders || []
      );
    } catch (error) {
      console.error(error);
    } finally {
      setLoading(false);
    }
  }

  async function assignOrder(orderId: number, riderId: number) {
    if (!riderId) return;

    try {
      const res = await fetch("/api/delivery-control", {
        method: "POST",
        headers: {
          "Content-Type": "application/json",
        },
        body: JSON.stringify({
          orderId,
          riderId,
        }),
      });

      const data = await res.json();

      if (!res.ok) {
        alert(data.error || "Assignment Failed");
        return;
      }

      alert("Order Assigned Successfully");
      loadData();
    } catch (error) {
      console.error(error);
      alert("Something Went Wrong");
    }
  }

  const statuses = useMemo(() => {
    const values = orders
      .map((order) => order.status)
      .filter(Boolean);

    return ["All", ...Array.from(new Set(values))];
  }, [orders]);

  const filteredOrders = useMemo(() => {
    const keyword = search.toLowerCase().trim();

    return orders.filter((order) => {
      const matchesSearch =
        !keyword ||
        String(order.id || "").toLowerCase().includes(keyword) ||
        String(order.customer || "").toLowerCase().includes(keyword) ||
        String(order.phone || "").toLowerCase().includes(keyword) ||
        String(order.address || "").toLowerCase().includes(keyword);

      const matchesStatus =
        statusFilter === "All" ||
        order.status === statusFilter;

      return matchesSearch && matchesStatus;
    });
  }, [orders, search, statusFilter]);

  const totalAmount = orders.reduce(
    (sum, order) => sum + Number(order.amount || 0),
    0
  );

  const pendingCount = orders.filter(
    (order) =>
      !["Delivered", "Cancelled"].includes(order.status)
  ).length;

  const assignedCount = orders.filter((order) =>
    String(order.status || "")
      .toLowerCase()
      .includes("assigned")
  ).length;

  if (loading) {
    return (
      <div className="min-h-[70vh] flex items-center justify-center bg-[#f4f7f7]">
        <div className="bg-white rounded-2xl shadow-sm border border-gray-200 px-8 py-6 text-center">
          <div className="w-10 h-10 border-4 border-[#159447] border-t-transparent rounded-full animate-spin mx-auto" />
          <p className="mt-4 text-sm font-semibold text-gray-600">
            Loading Orders...
          </p>
        </div>
      </div>
    );
  }

  return (
    <div className="min-h-screen bg-[#f4f7f7] p-4 md:p-6">
      <div className="max-w-[1500px] mx-auto space-y-6">

        {/* HEADER */}
        <div className="bg-white border border-gray-200 rounded-2xl shadow-sm overflow-hidden">
          <div className="bg-gradient-to-r from-[#063f3d] to-[#0b625c] px-6 py-7 text-white">
            <div className="flex flex-col lg:flex-row lg:items-center lg:justify-between gap-5">
              <div>
                <div className="flex items-center gap-3">
                  <div className="w-11 h-11 rounded-xl bg-white/10 border border-white/20 flex items-center justify-center text-2xl">
                    ðŸ“¦
                  </div>

                    </h1>

                      Manage orders and assign delivery riders

              </div>

              <button
                onClick={loadData}
                className="bg-white text-[#063f3d] px-5 py-3 rounded-xl font-bold text-sm hover:bg-gray-100 transition"

                â†» Refresh Orders

            </div>
          </div>

          {/* STATS */}

                Total Orders
              </p>
              <p className="text-2xl font-bold text-[#063f3d] mt-1">
                {orders.length}
              </p>
            </div>

            <div className="p-5">

  const [payouts, setPayouts] = useState<any[]>([]);

  useEffect(() => {
    try {
      setVendors(JSON.parse(localStorage.getItem("freshcut-vendors") || "[]"));
      setPayouts(JSON.parse(localStorage.getItem("freshcut-payouts") || "[]"));
    } catch {
      setVendors([]);
      setPayouts([]);
    }
  }, []);

  function makePayment(vendor: any) {
    const amount = prompt(`Enter Payment Amount For ${vendor.name}`);
    if (!amount) return;

    const payout = {
      id: Date.now(),
      vendorId: vendor.id,
      vendor: vendor.name,
      mobile: vendor.mobile,
      amount,
      date: new Date().toLocaleDateString(),
      status: "Paid",
    };

    const updated = [payout, ...payouts];
    localStorage.setItem("freshcut-payouts", JSON.stringify(updated));
    setPayouts(updated);
    alert("Payment Recorded Successfully");
  }

  const totalPayout = payouts.reduce(
    (sum, item) => sum + Number(item.amount || 0),
    0
  );

  return (
    <div className="min-h-screen bg-[#f5f7f7] p-5 md:p-7">
      <div className="mx-auto max-w-[1600px]">
        <div className="mb-7">

            Vendor Payouts
          </h1>
          <p className="mt-1 text-sm text-slate-500">
            Manage vendor payments and payout history.
          </p>
        </div>

        <div className="mb-7 rounded-2xl border border-emerald-100 bg-emerald-50 p-6 shadow-sm">
          <p className="text-sm font-bold text-emerald-700">Total Payout</p>
          <p className="mt-2 text-4xl font-extrabold text-[#123b38]">
            â‚¹{totalPayout.toLocaleString("en-IN")}
          </p>
        </div>

        <div className="mb-8 grid gap-5 md:grid-cols-2 xl:grid-cols-3">
          {vendors.map((vendor) => (
            <div
              key={vendor.id}
              className="rounded-2xl border border-slate-200 bg-white p-6 shadow-sm"
            >
              <div className="flex items-start justify-between">
                <div>
                  <h2 className="text-xl font-extrabold text-[#123b38]">
                    {vendor.name}
                  </h2>
                  <p className="mt-2 text-sm text-slate-500">
                    {vendor.mobile || "No mobile"}
                  </p>
                  <p className="mt-1 text-sm text-slate-500">
                    {vendor.category || "Vendor"}
                  </p>

                <span className="rounded-full bg-emerald-50 px-3 py-1 text-xs font-bold text-emerald-700">
                  ACTIVE

"use client";

export const dynamic = "force-dynamic";

import { useEffect, useState } from "react";

export default function PayrollPage() {
  const [staff, setStaff] = useState<any[]>([]);

  useEffect(() => {
    loadStaff();
  }, []);

  function loadStaff() {
    try {
      setStaff(JSON.parse(localStorage.getItem("freshcut-staff") || "[]"));
    } catch {
      setStaff([]);
    }
  }

  function markPaid(id: number) {
    const updated = staff.map((item) =>
      item.id === id
        ? {
            ...item,
            salaryStatus: "Paid",
            paidDate: new Date().toLocaleDateString(),
          }
        : item
    );

    localStorage.setItem("freshcut-staff", JSON.stringify(updated));
    setStaff(updated);
  }

  const totalSalary = staff.reduce(
    (sum, item) => sum + Number(item.salary || 0),
    0
  );

  const paidSalary = staff
    .filter((item) => item.salaryStatus === "Paid")
    .reduce((sum, item) => sum + Number(item.salary || 0), 0);

  const pendingSalary = totalSalary - paidSalary;

  const cards = [
    ["Total Salary", totalSalary, "bg-blue-50", "text-blue-700"],
    ["Paid Salary", paidSalary, "bg-emerald-50", "text-emerald-700"],
    ["Pending Salary", pendingSalary, "bg-red-50", "text-red-700"],
  ];

  return (
    <div className="min-h-screen bg-[#f5f7f7] p-5 md:p-7">
      <div className="mx-auto max-w-[1600px]">
        <div className="mb-7">
          <p className="text-xs font-bold uppercase tracking-[0.18em] text-emerald-700">
            Fresh2Cook Admin
          </p>
          <h1 className="mt-1 text-3xl font-extrabold text-[#123b38] md:text-4xl">
            Payroll Management
          </h1>
          <p className="mt-1 text-sm text-slate-500">
            Track salary payments and pending payroll.
          </p>
        </div>

        <div className="mb-7 grid gap-4 md:grid-cols-3">
          {cards.map(([title, value, bg, color]) => (
            <div
              key={String(title)}
              className={`rounded-2xl border border-slate-200 ${bg} p-6 shadow-sm`}
            >
              <p className="text-sm font-bold text-slate-600">
                {title}
              </p>
              <p className={`mt-2 text-3xl font-extrabold ${color}`}>
                â‚¹{Number(value).toLocaleString("en-IN")}
              </p>
            </div>
          ))}
        </div>

        <div className="space-y-4">
          {staff.map((employee) => (
            <div
              key={employee.id}
              className="rounded-2xl border border-slate-200 bg-white p-6 shadow-sm"
            >
              <div className="flex flex-col gap-5 md:flex-row md:items-center md:justify-between">
                <div>
                  <h2 className="text-xl font-extrabold text-[#123b38]">
                    {employee.name}
                  </h2>
                  <p className="mt-1 text-sm text-slate-500">
                    {employee.role}
                  </p>
                  <p className="mt-1 text-sm text-slate-500">
                    {employee.mobile || employee.phone || "â€”"}
                  </p>
                </div>

                <div className="text-left md:text-right">
                  <p className="text-2xl font-extrabold text-emerald-700">
                    â‚¹{Number(employee.salary || 0).toLocaleString("en-IN")}
                  </p>

                  <span
                    className={`mt-2 inline-block rounded-full px-3 py-1 text-xs font-bold ${
                      employee.salaryStatus === "Paid"
                        ? "bg-emerald-50 text-emerald-700"
                        : "bg-amber-50 text-amber-700"
                    }`}
                  >
                    {employee.salaryStatus || "Pending"}
                  </span>
                </div>
              </div>

              <div className="mt-5 flex flex-wrap gap-3">

                  onClick={() => markPaid(employee.id)}

"use client";

export const dynamic = "force-dynamic";

import { useState } from "react";

export default function POSPage() {
  const [customer, setCustomer] = useState("");
  const [mobile, setMobile] = useState("");
  const [amount, setAmount] = useState("");
  const [message, setMessage] = useState("");

  async function generateInvoice() {
    try {
      const res = await fetch("/api/orders", {
        method: "POST",
        headers: {
          "Content-Type": "application/json",
        },
        body: JSON.stringify({
          customer,
          amount: Number(amount),
          status: "Paid",
        }),
      });

      if (!res.ok) {
        throw new Error("Failed");
      }

      const data = await res.json();

      setMessage(
        `Invoice Created Successfully. Order ID: ${data.id}`
      );

      setCustomer("");
      setMobile("");
      setAmount("");
    } catch (err) {
      setMessage("Error creating invoice");
    }
  }

  return (
    <div className="p-8">
      <h1 className="text-3xl font-bold mb-6">
        POS Billing
      </h1>

      <div className="bg-white rounded-xl p-6 shadow max-w-xl">
        <input
          value={customer}
          onChange={(e) => setCustomer(e.target.value)}
          placeholder="Customer Name"
          className="border p-3 w-full mb-4"
        />

        <input
          value={mobile}
          onChange={(e) => setMobile(e.target.value)}
          placeholder="Mobile Number"
          className="border p-3 w-full mb-4"
        />

        <input
          value={amount}
          onChange={(e) => setAmount(e.target.value)}
          placeholder="Bill Amount"
          type="number"
          className="border p-3 w-full mb-4"
        />

        <button
          onClick={generateInvoice}
          className="bg-green-600 text-white px-6 py-3 rounded-lg"
        >
          Generate Invoice
        </button>

        {message && (
          <div className="mt-4 text-green-700 font-semibold">
            {message}
          </div>
        )}
      </div>
    </div>
  );
}

==================== D:\D Drive\Desktop\CRM\FreshCut-CRM-Professional-Starter\app\admin\products-manage\page.tsx ====================

"use client";

export const dynamic = "force-dynamic";

import { useEffect, useMemo, useState } from "react";

type Product = {
  id: number;
  name: string;
  category?: string;
  pack?: string;
  mrp?: number;
  price?: number;
  stock?: number;
  image?: string;
  description?: string;
  bestSeller?: boolean;
  active?: boolean;
};

type ProductForm = {
  name: string;
  category: string;
  pack: string;
  mrp: string;
  price: string;
  stock: string;
  image: string;
  description: string;
  bestSeller: boolean;
  active: boolean;
};

const emptyForm: ProductForm = {
  name: "",
  category: "Vegetables",
  pack: "Piece",
  mrp: "",
  price: "",
  stock: "",
  image: "",
  description: "",
  bestSeller: false,
  active: true,
};

async function getResponseData(response: Response) {
  const text = await response.text();

  try {
    return text ? JSON.parse(text) : {};
  } catch {
    return {};
  }
}

export default function ProductsManagePage() {
  const [products, setProducts] = useState<Product[]>([]);
  const [loading, setLoading] = useState(true);
  const [saving, setSaving] = useState(false);
  const [errorMessage, setErrorMessage] = useState("");
  const [search, setSearch] = useState("");
  const [categoryFilter, setCategoryFilter] = useState("All");
  const [statusFilter, setStatusFilter] = useState("All");
  const [editingProduct, setEditingProduct] = useState<Product | null>(null);

  const [newProduct, setNewProduct] =
    useState<ProductForm>(emptyForm);

  const [editForm, setEditForm] =
    useState<ProductForm>(emptyForm);

  useEffect(() => {
    loadProducts();
  }, []);

  async function loadProducts() {
    try {
      setLoading(true);
      setErrorMessage("");

      const response = await fetch("/api/products", {
        cache: "no-store",
      });

      const data = await getResponseData(response);

      if (!response.ok) {
        throw new Error(
          data?.error || "Failed to load products"
        );
      }

      const list = Array.isArray(data)
        ? data
        : data?.products || [];

      setProducts(list);
    } catch (error) {
      console.error(error);

      setErrorMessage(
        error instanceof Error
          ? error.message
          : "Failed to load products"
      );
    } finally {
      setLoading(false);
    }
  }

  function validateForm(form: ProductForm) {
    const name = form.name.trim();
    const pack = form.pack.trim();
    const mrp = Number(form.mrp || 0);
    const price = Number(form.price || 0);
    const stock = Number(form.stock || 0);

    if (!name) {
      return "Please enter Product Name.";
    }

    if (!pack) {
      return "Please enter Pack Size.";
    }

    if (!Number.isFinite(mrp) || mrp < 0) {
      return "Please enter a valid MRP.";
    }

    if (!Number.isFinite(price) || price < 0) {
      return "Please enter a valid Our Price.";
    }

    if (mrp < price) {
      return "MRP cannot be less than Our Price.";
    }

    if (!Number.isFinite(stock) || stock < 0) {
      return "Please enter a valid Stock.";
    }

    return "";
  }

  async function addProduct() {
    const validationError = validateForm(newProduct);

    if (validationError) {
      setErrorMessage(validationError);
      return;
    }

    try {
      setSaving(true);
      setErrorMessage("");

      const response = await fetch("/api/products", {
        method: "POST",
        headers: {
          "Content-Type": "application/json",
        },
        body: JSON.stringify({
          name: newProduct.name.trim(),
          category: newProduct.category,
          pack: newProduct.pack,
          mrp: Number(newProduct.mrp || 0),
          price: Number(newProduct.price || 0),
          stock: Number(newProduct.stock || 0),
          image: newProduct.image.trim(),
          description: newProduct.description.trim(),
          bestSeller: newProduct.bestSeller,
          active: newProduct.active,
        }),
      });

      const data = await getResponseData(response);

      if (!response.ok) {
        throw new Error(
          data?.error || "Failed to add product"
        );
      }

      const created = data?.product || data;

      setProducts((current) => [
        created,
        ...current,
      ]);

      setNewProduct(emptyForm);

      alert("Product Added Successfully");
    } catch (error) {
      console.error(error);

      setErrorMessage(
        error instanceof Error
          ? error.message
          : "Failed to add product"
      );
    } finally {
      setSaving(false);
    }
  }

  function openEdit(product: Product) {
    setEditingProduct(product);

    setEditForm({
      name: product.name || "",
      category: product.category || "Vegetables",
      pack: product.pack || "Piece",
      mrp: String(product.mrp ?? ""),
      price: String(product.price ?? ""),
      stock: String(product.stock ?? ""),
      image: product.image || "",
      description: product.description || "",
      bestSeller: product.bestSeller === true,
      active: product.active !== false,
    });

    setErrorMessage("");
  }

  function closeEdit() {
    setEditingProduct(null);
    setEditForm(emptyForm);
  }

  async function saveEdit() {
    if (!editingProduct) return;

    const validationError = validateForm(editForm);

    if (validationError) {
      setErrorMessage(validationError);
      return;
    }

    try {
      setSaving(true);
      setErrorMessage("");

      const response = await fetch(
        `/api/products/${editingProduct.id}`,
        {
          method: "PATCH",
          headers: {
            "Content-Type": "application/json",
          },
          body: JSON.stringify({
            name: editForm.name.trim(),
            category: editForm.category,
            pack: editForm.pack,
            mrp: Number(editForm.mrp || 0),
            price: Number(editForm.price || 0),
            stock: Number(editForm.stock || 0),
            image: editForm.image.trim(),
            description: editForm.description.trim(),
            bestSeller: editForm.bestSeller,
            active: editForm.active,
          }),
        }
      );

      const data = await getResponseData(response);

      if (!response.ok) {
        throw new Error(
          data?.error || "Failed to update product"
        );
      }

      setProducts((current) =>
        current.map((product) =>
          product.id === editingProduct.id
            ? data?.product || data
            : product
        )
      );

      closeEdit();

      alert("Product Updated Successfully");
    } catch (error) {
      console.error(error);

      setErrorMessage(
        error instanceof Error
          ? error.message
          : "Failed to update product"
      );
    } finally {
      setSaving(false);
    }
  }

  async function toggleBestSeller(product: Product) {
    try {
      setErrorMessage("");

      const response = await fetch(
        `/api/products/${product.id}`,
        {
          method: "PATCH",
          headers: {
            "Content-Type": "application/json",
          },
          body: JSON.stringify({
            bestSeller: product.bestSeller !== true,
          }),
        }
      );

      const data = await getResponseData(response);

      if (!response.ok) {
        throw new Error(
          data?.error ||
            "Failed to update Best Seller"
        );
      }

      setProducts((current) =>
        current.map((item) =>
          item.id === product.id
            ? data?.product || data
            : item
        )
      );
    } catch (error) {
      console.error(error);

      setErrorMessage(
        error instanceof Error
          ? error.message
          : "Failed to update Best Seller"
      );
    }
  }

  async function toggleActive(product: Product) {
    try {
      setErrorMessage("");

      const response = await fetch(
        `/api/products/${product.id}`,
        {
          method: "PATCH",
          headers: {
            "Content-Type": "application/json",
          },
          body: JSON.stringify({
            active: product.active === false,
          }),
        }
      );

      const data = await getResponseData(response);

      if (!response.ok) {
        throw new Error(
          data?.error ||
            "Failed to update status"
        );
      }

      setProducts((current) =>
        current.map((item) =>
          item.id === product.id
            ? data?.product || data
            : item
        )
      );
    } catch (error) {
      console.error(error);

      setErrorMessage(
        error instanceof Error
          ? error.message
          : "Failed to update status"
      );
    }
  }

  async function deleteProduct(product: Product) {
    const confirmed = window.confirm(
      `Delete "${product.name}"?`
    );

    if (!confirmed) return;

    try {
      setErrorMessage("");

      const response = await fetch(
        `/api/products/${product.id}`,
        {
          method: "DELETE",
        }
      );

      const data = await getResponseData(response);

      if (!response.ok) {
        throw new Error(
          data?.error || "Failed to delete product"
        );
      }

      setProducts((current) =>
        current.filter(
          (item) => item.id !== product.id
        )
      );
    } catch (error) {
      console.error(error);

      setErrorMessage(
        error instanceof Error
          ? error.message
          : "Failed to delete product"
      );
    }
  }

  function handleNewImage(
    e: React.ChangeEvent<HTMLInputElement>
  ) {
    const file = e.target.files?.[0];

    if (!file) return;

    const reader = new FileReader();

    reader.onloadend = () => {
      setNewProduct((current) => ({
        ...current,
        image: reader.result as string,
      }));
    };

    reader.readAsDataURL(file);
  }

  function handleEditImage(
    e: React.ChangeEvent<HTMLInputElement>
  ) {
    const file = e.target.files?.[0];

    if (!file) return;

    const reader = new FileReader();

    reader.onloadend = () => {
      setEditForm((current) => ({
        ...current,
        image: reader.result as string,
      }));
    };

    reader.readAsDataURL(file);
  }

  const categories = useMemo(() => {
    const values = products
      .map((product) => product.category)
      .filter(Boolean) as string[];

    return [
      "All",
      ...Array.from(new Set(values)),
    ];
  }, [products]);

  const filteredProducts = useMemo(() => {
    const keyword = search
      .toLowerCase()
      .trim();

    return products.filter((product) => {
      const matchesSearch =
        !keyword ||
        product.name
          ?.toLowerCase()
          .includes(keyword) ||
        product.category
          ?.toLowerCase()
          .includes(keyword) ||
        product.pack
          ?.toLowerCase()
          .includes(keyword);

      const matchesCategory =
        categoryFilter === "All" ||
        product.category === categoryFilter;

      const matchesStatus =
        statusFilter === "All" ||
        (statusFilter === "Active"
          ? product.active !== false
          : product.active === false);

      return (
        matchesSearch &&
        matchesCategory &&
        matchesStatus
      );
    });
  }, [
    products,
    search,
    categoryFilter,
    statusFilter,
  ]);

  const totalProducts = products.length;

  const activeProducts = products.filter(
    (product) => product.active !== false
  ).length;

  const bestSellers = products.filter(
    (product) => product.bestSeller === true

"use client";

export const dynamic = "force-dynamic";

import { useState } from "react";

export default function ProductUploadPage() {
  const [name, setName] = useState("");
  const [price, setPrice] = useState("");
  const [stock, setStock] = useState("");
  const [pack, setPack] = useState("");
  const [image, setImage] = useState("");

  function handleImage(
    e: React.ChangeEvent<HTMLInputElement>
  ) {
    const file = e.target.files?.[0];

    if (!file) return;

    const reader = new FileReader();

    reader.onload = () => {
      setImage(
        reader.result as string
      );
    };

    reader.readAsDataURL(file);
  }

  function saveProduct() {
    if (!name || !price) {
      alert(
        "Name and Price Required"
      );
      return;
    }

    const products = JSON.parse(
      localStorage.getItem(
        "freshcut-products"
      ) || "[]"
    );

    products.unshift({
      id: Date.now(),
      name,
      price: Number(price),
      stock,
      pack,
      image,
    });

    localStorage.setItem(
      "freshcut-products",
      JSON.stringify(products)
    );

    alert(
      "Product Saved Successfully"
    );

    setName("");
    setPrice("");
    setStock("");
    setPack("");
    setImage("");
  }

  return (
    <div className="min-h-screen bg-gray-100 p-6">

      <div className="max-w-5xl mx-auto">

"use client";

export const dynamic = "force-dynamic";

import { useEffect, useState } from "react";

export default function ProfitLossPage() {
  const [revenue, setRevenue] = useState(0);
  const [expenses, setExpenses] = useState(0);
  const [purchases, setPurchases] = useState(0);

  useEffect(() => { loadData(); }, []);

  function loadData() {
    try {
      const orders = JSON.parse(localStorage.getItem("freshcut-orders") || "[]");
      const expensesData = JSON.parse(localStorage.getItem("freshcut-expenses") || "[]");
      const purchasesData = JSON.parse(localStorage.getItem("freshcut-purchases") || "[]");

      setRevenue(orders.reduce((sum:number,item:any) => sum + Number(item.total || 0), 0));
      setExpenses(expensesData.reduce((sum:number,item:any) => sum + Number(item.amount || 0), 0));
      setPurchases(purchasesData.reduce((sum:number,item:any) => sum + Number(item.amount || 0), 0));
    } catch {}
  }

  const cost = expenses + purchases;
  const profit = revenue - cost;

  return (
    <div className="min-h-screen bg-[#f5f7f7] p-5 md:p-7">
      <div className="mx-auto max-w-[1500px]">
        <Header title="Profit & Loss" subtitle="Business revenue, expenses and purchase analysis." />
        <div className="grid gap-4 md:grid-cols-2 xl:grid-cols-4">
          <Kpi title="Revenue" value={`â‚¹${revenue}`} green />
          <Kpi title="Expenses" value={`â‚¹${expenses}`} red />
          <Kpi title="Purchases" value={`â‚¹${purchases}`} />
          <Kpi title="Net Profit" value={`â‚¹${profit}`} green={profit >= 0} red={profit < 0} />
        </div>
        <div className="mt-6 rounded-2xl border border-slate-200 bg-white p-6 shadow-sm">
          <h2 className="text-lg font-extrabold text-[#123b38]">Financial Summary</h2>
          <div className="mt-5 space-y-4">
            <Row title="Total Revenue" value={revenue} />
            <Row title="Total Expenses" value={expenses} />
            <Row title="Total Purchases" value={purchases} />
            <div className="border-t pt-4"><Row title="Net Profit" value={profit} bold /></div>
          </div>
        </div>
      </div>
    </div>
  );
}
function Header({title,subtitle}:any){return <div className="mb-7"><p className="text-xs font-bold uppercase tracking-[.18em] text-emerald-700">Fresh2Cook Admin</p><h1 className="mt-1 text-3xl font-extrabold text-[#123b38] md:text-4xl">{title}</h1><p className="mt-1 text-sm text-slate-500">{subtitle}</p></div>}
function Kpi({title,value,green,red}:any){return <div className={`rounded-2xl border p-6 shadow-sm ${green ? "border-emerald-100 bg-emerald-50" : red ? "border-red-100 bg-red-50" : "border-slate-200 bg-white"}`}><p className="text-sm font-semibold text-slate-500">{title}</p><p className="mt-2 text-3xl font-extrabold text-[#123b38]">{value}</p></div>}
function Row({title,value,bold}:any){return <div className={`flex justify-between ${bold ? "text-xl font-extrabold" : "text-sm"}`}><span className="text-slate-600">{title}</span><strong className={value >= 0 ? "text-[#123b38]" : "text-red-600"}>â‚¹{value}</strong></div>}

export default function PurchasesPage() {

  const [vendor, setVendor] = useState("");
  const [item, setItem] = useState("");
  const [quantity, setQuantity] = useState("");
  const [amount, setAmount] = useState("");

  useEffect(() => {
    loadPurchases();
  }, []);

  function loadPurchases() {
    try {
      setPurchases(
        JSON.parse(localStorage.getItem("freshcut-purchases") || "[]")
      );
    } catch {
      setPurchases([]);
    }
  }

  function addPurchase() {
    if (!vendor || !item || !quantity || !amount) {
      alert("Fill All Fields");
      return;
    }

    const purchase = {
      id: Date.now(),
      vendor,
      item,
      quantity,
      amount,
      date: new Date().toLocaleDateString(),
    };

    const updated = [purchase, ...purchases];

    localStorage.setItem(
      "freshcut-purchases",
      JSON.stringify(updated)
    );

    setPurchases(updated);
    setVendor("");
    setItem("");
    setQuantity("");
    setAmount("");

    alert("Purchase Added Successfully");
  }

  function deletePurchase(id: number) {
    if (!confirm("Delete Purchase?")) return;

    const updated = purchases.filter((purchase) => purchase.id !== id);

    localStorage.setItem(
      "freshcut-purchases",
      JSON.stringify(updated)
    );

    setPurchases(updated);
  }

  const totalPurchase = purchases.reduce(
    (sum, purchase) => sum + Number(purchase.amount || 0),
    0
  );

  return (
    <div className="min-h-screen bg-[#f5f7f7] p-5 md:p-7">

              Enter supplier and purchase details.
            </p>
