"use client";

export const dynamic = "force-dynamic";

import { useEffect, useState } from "react";

export default function ReviewsPage() {
  const [reviews, setReviews] = useState<any[]>([]);
  const [customer, setCustomer] = useState("");
  const [rating, setRating] = useState("5");
  const [review, setReview] = useState("");

  useEffect(() => {
    loadReviews();
  }, []);

  function loadReviews() {
    try {
      setReviews(
        JSON.parse(localStorage.getItem("freshcut-reviews") || "[]")
      );
    } catch {
      setReviews([]);
    }
  }

  function addReview() {
    if (!customer.trim() || !review.trim()) {
      alert("Fill All Fields");
      return;
    }

    const newReview = {
      id: Date.now(),
      customer: customer.trim(),
      rating,
      review: review.trim(),
      date: new Date().toLocaleDateString(),
    };

    const updated = [newReview, ...reviews];

    localStorage.setItem("freshcut-reviews", JSON.stringify(updated));
    setReviews(updated);
    setCustomer("");
    setRating("5");
    setReview("");
  }

  function deleteReview(id: number) {
    if (!confirm("Delete Review?")) return;

    const updated = reviews.filter((item) => item.id !== id);

    localStorage.setItem("freshcut-reviews", JSON.stringify(updated));
    setReviews(updated);
  }

  const averageRating = reviews.length
    ? (
        reviews.reduce(
          (sum, item) => sum + Number(item.rating || 0),
          0
        ) / reviews.length
      ).toFixed(1)
    : "0.0";

  return (
    <div className="min-h-screen bg-[#f5f7f7] p-5 md:p-7">
      <div className="mx-auto max-w-[1600px]">
        <div className="mb-7">
          <p className="text-xs font-bold uppercase tracking-[0.18em] text-emerald-700">
            Fresh2Cook Admin
          </p>
          <h1 className="mt-1 text-3xl font-extrabold text-[#123b38] md:text-4xl">
            Customer Reviews
          </h1>
          <p className="mt-1 text-sm text-slate-500">
            Manage customer feedback and ratings.
          </p>
        </div>

        <div className="mb-7 grid gap-4 sm:grid-cols-2">
          <div className="rounded-2xl border border-slate-200 bg-white p-5 shadow-sm">
            <p className="text-sm font-semibold text-slate-500">
              Total Reviews
            </p>
            <p className="mt-2 text-3xl font-extrabold text-[#123b38]">
              {reviews.length}
            </p>
          </div>

          <div className="rounded-2xl border border-amber-100 bg-amber-50 p-5 shadow-sm">
            <p className="text-sm font-semibold text-amber-700">
              Average Rating
            </p>
            <p className="mt-2 text-3xl font-extrabold text-amber-800">
              {averageRating} / 5
            </p>
          </div>
        </div>

        <div className="mb-7 rounded-2xl border border-slate-200 bg-white p-6 shadow-sm">
          <h2 className="text-lg font-extrabold text-[#123b38]">
            Add Customer Review
          </h2>

          <div className="mt-5 grid gap-4 md:grid-cols-3">
            <input
              value={customer}
              onChange={(e) => setCustomer(e.target.value)}
              placeholder="Customer Name"
              className="rounded-xl border border-slate-300 px-4 py-3 text-sm outline-none focus:border-emerald-600"
            />

            <select
              value={rating}
              onChange={(e) => setRating(e.target.value)}
              className="rounded-xl border border-slate-300 px-4 py-3 text-sm outline-none focus:border-emerald-600"
            >
              <option value="5">â˜…â˜…â˜…â˜…â˜… â€” 5 Stars</option>
              <option value="4">â˜…â˜…â˜…â˜…â˜† â€” 4 Stars</option>
              <option value="3">â˜…â˜…â˜…â˜†â˜† â€” 3 Stars</option>
              <option value="2">â˜…â˜…â˜†â˜†â˜† â€” 2 Stars</option>
              <option value="1">â˜…â˜†â˜†â˜†â˜† â€” 1 Star</option>
            </select>

            <button
              onClick={addReview}
              className="rounded-xl bg-[#063f3d] px-6 py-3 text-sm font-bold text-white hover:bg-[#0a514d]"
            >
              + Add Review
            </button>
          </div>

          <textarea
            value={review}
            onChange={(e) => setReview(e.target.value)}
            placeholder="Customer Review"

                {item.review}

              >
                Delete Review

          ))}

"use client";

export const dynamic = "force-dynamic";

import { useEffect, useMemo, useState } from "react";

type Rider = {
  id: number;
  name: string;
  mobile: string;
  vehicle: string;
  approvalStatus: string;
};

export default function RiderApprovalsPage() {
  const [riders, setRiders] = useState<Rider[]>([]);
  const [loading, setLoading] = useState(true);
  const [search, setSearch] = useState("");

  async function loadRiders() {
    try {
      setLoading(true);

      const res = await fetch("/api/admin-rider-approvals", {
        cache: "no-store",
      });

      const data = await res.json();

      setRiders(
        Array.isArray(data)
          ? data
          : Array.isArray(data?.riders)
          ? data.riders
          : Array.isArray(data?.data)
          ? data.data
          : []
      );
    } catch (error) {
      console.error(error);
      setRiders([]);
    } finally {
      setLoading(false);
    }
  }

  async function updateStatus(riderId: number, status: string) {
    try {
      const res = await fetch("/api/admin-rider-approvals", {
        method: "POST",
        headers: {
          "Content-Type": "application/json",
        },
        body: JSON.stringify({
          riderId,
          status,
        }),
      });

      const data = await res.json();

      if (!res.ok || !data.success) {
        throw new Error(data?.error || "Status update failed");
      }

      await loadRiders();
    } catch (error: any) {
      console.error(error);
      alert(error?.message || "Status update failed");
    }
  }

  useEffect(() => {
    loadRiders();
  }, []);

  const filtered = useMemo(() => {
    const q = search.toLowerCase().trim();

    if (!q) return riders;

    return riders.filter((rider) =>
      `${rider.name} ${rider.mobile} ${rider.vehicle} ${rider.approvalStatus}`
        .toLowerCase()
        .includes(q)
    );
  }, [riders, search]);

  const pending = riders.filter(
    (r) => r.approvalStatus === "Pending"
  ).length;

  const approved = riders.filter(
    (r) => r.approvalStatus === "Approved"
  ).length;

  const rejected = riders.filter(
    (r) => r.approvalStatus === "Rejected"
  ).length;

  return (
    <div className="min-h-screen bg-[#f5f7f8] p-4 md:p-6">
      <div className="mx-auto max-w-[1500px] space-y-6">

        <div className="flex flex-col gap-4 md:flex-row md:items-center md:justify-between">
          <div>
            <p className="text-sm font-semibold uppercase tracking-wider text-[#159447]">
              Rider Management
            </p>
            <h1 className="mt-1 text-3xl font-bold text-[#123b39]">
              Rider Approvals
            </h1>
            <p className="mt-1 text-sm text-gray-500">
              Review and manage delivery partner approval status.
            </p>
          </div>

          <button
            onClick={loadRiders}
            className="rounded-xl bg-[#063f3d] px-5 py-3 text-sm font-semibold text-white hover:bg-[#0a504c]"
          >
            â†» Refresh
          </button>
        </div>

        <div className="grid grid-cols-2 gap-4 lg:grid-cols-4">
          <div className="rounded-2xl bg-white p-5 shadow-sm border border-gray-100">
            <p className="text-xs uppercase font-semibold text-gray-400">Total</p>
            <p className="mt-2 text-3xl font-bold text-[#123b39]">{riders.length}</p>
          </div>

          <div className="rounded-2xl bg-white p-5 shadow-sm border border-gray-100">
            <p className="text-xs uppercase font-semibold text-gray-400">Pending</p>
            <p className="mt-2 text-3xl font-bold text-orange-500">{pending}</p>
          </div>

          <div className="rounded-2xl bg-white p-5 shadow-sm border border-gray-100">
            <p className="text-xs uppercase font-semibold text-gray-400">Approved</p>
            <p className="mt-2 text-3xl font-bold text-green-600">{approved}</p>
          </div>

          <div className="rounded-2xl bg-white p-5 shadow-sm border border-gray-100">
            <p className="text-xs uppercase font-semibold text-gray-400">Rejected</p>
            <p className="mt-2 text-3xl font-bold text-red-500">{rejected}</p>
          </div>
        </div>

        <div className="rounded-2xl bg-white border border-gray-100 shadow-sm overflow-hidden">
          <div className="flex flex-col gap-3 border-b border-gray-100 p-5 md:flex-row md:items-center md:justify-between">
            <div>
              <h2 className="text-lg font-bold text-[#123b39]">
                Approval Queue
              </h2>
              <p className="text-sm text-gray-500">
                {filtered.length} rider(s)
              </p>
            </div>

            <input
              value={search}
              onChange={(e) => setSearch(e.target.value)}
              placeholder="Search rider..."
              className="w-full rounded-xl border border-gray-200 bg-gray-50 px-4 py-3 text-sm outline-none focus:border-[#159447] md:w-80"
            />
          </div>

          {loading ? (
            <div className="p-12 text-center text-gray-500">
              Loading approvals...
            </div>
          ) : filtered.length === 0 ? (
            <div className="p-12 text-center text-gray-500">
              No riders found.
            </div>
          ) : (
            <div className="overflow-x-auto">
              <table className="w-full min-w-[800px]">
                <thead className="bg-[#f8faf9]">
                  <tr>
                    <th className="p-4 text-left text-xs uppercase text-gray-400">Rider</th>
                    <th className="p-4 text-left text-xs uppercase text-gray-400">Mobile</th>
                    <th className="p-4 text-left text-xs uppercase text-gray-400">Vehicle</th>
                    <th className="p-4 text-left text-xs uppercase text-gray-400">Status</th>
                    <th className="p-4 text-left text-xs uppercase text-gray-400">Action</th>
                  </tr>

                          {rider.approvalStatus}

                      </td>

                      <td className="p-4">
                        <div className="flex flex-wrap gap-2">

          : []

  );

"use client";

export const dynamic = "force-dynamic";

import { useEffect, useState } from "react";

export default function StoresPage() {
  const [stores, setStores] = useState<any[]>([]);
  const [storeName, setStoreName] = useState("");
  const [city, setCity] = useState("");
  const [manager, setManager] = useState("");
  const [search, setSearch] = useState("");

  useEffect(() => {
    loadStores();
  }, []);

  function loadStores() {
    try {
      const data = JSON.parse(
        localStorage.getItem("freshcut-stores") || "[]"
      );
      setStores(Array.isArray(data) ? data : []);
    } catch {
      setStores([]);
    }
  }

  function addStore() {
    if (!storeName.trim() || !city.trim()) {
      alert("Fill Required Fields");
      return;
    }

    const newStore = {
      id: Date.now(),
      storeName: storeName.trim(),
      city: city.trim(),
      manager: manager.trim(),
      sales: 0,
      inventory: 0,
      status: "Active",
    };

    const updated = [newStore, ...stores];

    localStorage.setItem(
      "freshcut-stores",
      JSON.stringify(updated)
    );

    setStores(updated);
    setStoreName("");
    setCity("");
    setManager("");
  }

  function updateSales(id: number) {
    const updated = stores.map((store) =>
      store.id === id
        ? { ...store, sales: store.sales + 1000 }
        : store
    );

    localStorage.setItem(
      "freshcut-stores",
      JSON.stringify(updated)
    );

    setStores(updated);
  }

  function updateInventory(id: number) {
    const updated = stores.map((store) =>
      store.id === id
        ? { ...store, inventory: store.inventory + 50 }
        : store
    );

    localStorage.setItem(
      "freshcut-stores",
      JSON.stringify(updated)
    );

    setStores(updated);
  }

  const totalSales = stores.reduce(
    (sum, store) => sum + Number(store.sales || 0),
    0
  );

  const totalInventory = stores.reduce(
    (sum, store) => sum + Number(store.inventory || 0),
    0
  );

  const filtered = stores.filter((store) =>
    `${store.storeName || ""} ${store.city || ""} ${store.manager || ""}`
      .toLowerCase()
      .includes(search.toLowerCase())
  );

  return (
    <div className="min-h-screen bg-[#f5f7f8] p-4 md:p-6">
      <div className="mx-auto max-w-[1500px] space-y-6">

        <div className="flex flex-col gap-4 md:flex-row md:items-center md:justify-between">
          <div>
            <p className="text-sm font-semibold uppercase tracking-wider text-[#159447]">
              Business Network
            </p>
            <h1 className="mt-1 text-3xl font-bold text-[#123b39]">
              Store Management
            </h1>
            <p className="mt-1 text-sm text-gray-500">
              Manage Fresh2Cook stores, sales and inventory.
            </p>
          </div>

          <button
            onClick={loadStores}
            className="rounded-xl bg-[#063f3d] px-5 py-3 text-sm font-semibold text-white hover:bg-[#0a504c]"
          >
            â†» Refresh
          </button>
        </div>

        <div className="grid grid-cols-2 gap-4 lg:grid-cols-3">
          <div className="rounded-2xl bg-white p-5 border border-gray-100 shadow-sm">
            <p className="text-xs uppercase font-semibold text-gray-400">
              Total Stores
            </p>
            <p className="mt-2 text-3xl font-bold text-[#123b39]">
              {stores.length}
            </p>
          </div>

          <div className="rounded-2xl bg-white p-5 border border-gray-100 shadow-sm">
            <p className="text-xs uppercase font-semibold text-gray-400">
              Total Sales
            </p>
            <p className="mt-2 text-3xl font-bold text-green-600">
              â‚¹{totalSales}
            </p>
          </div>

          <div className="rounded-2xl bg-white p-5 border border-gray-100 shadow-sm">
            <p className="text-xs uppercase font-semibold text-gray-400">
              Total Inventory
            </p>
            <p className="mt-2 text-3xl font-bold text-blue-600">
              {totalInventory}
            </p>
          </div>
        </div>

        <div className="rounded-2xl bg-white border border-gray-100 p-5 shadow-sm">
          <h2 className="text-lg font-bold text-[#123b39]">
            Add New Store
          </h2>

          <div className="mt-4 grid gap-4 md:grid-cols-3">
            <input
              placeholder="Store Name"
              value={storeName}
              onChange={(e) => setStoreName(e.target.value)}
              className="rounded-xl border border-gray-200 bg-gray-50 px-4 py-3 text-sm outline-none focus:border-[#159447]"
            />

            <input
              placeholder="City"
              value={city}
              onChange={(e) => setCity(e.target.value)}
              className="rounded-xl border border-gray-200 bg-gray-50 px-4 py-3 text-sm outline-none focus:border-[#159447]"
            />

            <input
              placeholder="Manager"
              value={manager}
              onChange={(e) => setManager(e.target.value)}
              className="rounded-xl border border-gray-200 bg-gray-50 px-4 py-3 text-sm outline-none focus:border-[#159447]"
            />
          </div>

          <button
            onClick={addStore}
            className="mt-4 rounded-xl bg-[#159447] px-6 py-3 text-sm font-bold text-white hover:bg-[#117b3b]"
          >
            + Add Store
          </button>

==================== D:\D Drive\Desktop\CRM\FreshCut-CRM-Professional-Starter\app\admin\roles\page.tsx ====================

"use client";

export const dynamic = "force-dynamic";

import { useEffect, useState } from "react";

const permissions = [
  ["dashboard", "Dashboard"],
  ["orders", "Orders"],
  ["products", "Products"],
  ["customers", "Customers"],
  ["reports", "Reports"],
];

export default function RolesPage() {
  const [roles, setRoles] = useState<any[]>([]);
  const [roleName, setRoleName] = useState("");

  useEffect(() => {
    loadRoles();
  }, []);

  function loadRoles() {
    try {
      setRoles(JSON.parse(localStorage.getItem("freshcut-roles") || "[]"));
    } catch {
      setRoles([]);
    }
  }

  function addRole() {
    if (!roleName.trim()) {
      alert("Enter Role Name");
      return;
    }

    const role = {
      id: Date.now(),
      name: roleName.trim(),
      dashboard: true,
      orders: true,
      products: true,
      customers: true,
      reports: false,
    };

    const updated = [role, ...roles];
    localStorage.setItem("freshcut-roles", JSON.stringify(updated));
    setRoles(updated);
    setRoleName("");
  }

  function togglePermission(id: number, field: string) {
    const updated = roles.map((role) =>
      role.id === id
        ? { ...role, [field]: !role[field] }
        : role
    );

    localStorage.setItem("freshcut-roles", JSON.stringify(updated));
    setRoles(updated);
  }

  function deleteRole(id: number) {
    if (!confirm("Delete Role?")) return;

    const updated = roles.filter((role) => role.id !== id);
    localStorage.setItem("freshcut-roles", JSON.stringify(updated));
    setRoles(updated);
  }

  return (
    <div className="min-h-screen bg-[#f5f7f7] p-5 md:p-7">
      <div className="mx-auto max-w-[1600px]">
        <div className="mb-7">
          <p className="text-xs font-bold uppercase tracking-[0.18em] text-emerald-700">
            Fresh2Cook Admin
          </p>
          <h1 className="mt-1 text-3xl font-extrabold text-[#123b38] md:text-4xl">
            Role Management
          </h1>
          <p className="mt-1 text-sm text-slate-500">
            Create roles and control access to admin modules.
          </p>
        </div>

        <div className="mb-7 rounded-2xl border border-slate-200 bg-white p-6 shadow-sm">
          <h2 className="text-lg font-extrabold text-[#123b38]">
            Create New Role
          </h2>

          <div className="mt-5 flex flex-col gap-3 md:flex-row">
            <input
              value={roleName}
              onChange={(e) => setRoleName(e.target.value)}
              placeholder="Role Name"
              className="flex-1 rounded-xl border border-slate-300 px-4 py-3 text-sm outline-none focus:border-emerald-600"
            />

            <button
              onClick={addRole}
              className="rounded-xl bg-[#063f3d] px-8 py-3 text-sm font-bold text-white hover:bg-[#0a514d]"
            >
              + Add Role
            </button>
          </div>
        </div>

        <div className="grid gap-5">
          {roles.map((role) => (
            <div
              key={role.id}
              className="rounded-2xl border border-slate-200 bg-white p-6 shadow-sm"
            >
              <div className="flex flex-col gap-4 border-b border-slate-100 pb-5 md:flex-row md:items-center md:justify-between">
                <div>
                  <h2 className="text-xl font-extrabold text-[#123b38]">
                    {role.name}
                  </h2>
                  <p className="mt-1 text-xs text-slate-500">
                    Configure module permissions
                  </p>
                </div>

                <button
                  onClick={() => deleteRole(role.id)}
                  className="rounded-xl bg-red-50 px-5 py-2.5 text-sm font-bold text-red-700 hover:bg-red-100"
                >
                  Delete Role
                </button>
              </div>

              <div className="mt-5 grid gap-3 sm:grid-cols-2 lg:grid-cols-5">
                {permissions.map(([field, label]) => (
                  <label
                    key={field}
                    className={`flex cursor-pointer items-center gap-3 rounded-xl border p-4 ${
                      role[field]
                        ? "border-emerald-200 bg-emerald-50"
                        : "border-slate-200 bg-slate-50"
                    }`}
                  >
                    <input
                      type="checkbox"
                      checked={!!role[field]}
                      onChange={() =>
                        togglePermission(role.id, field)
                      }
                      className="h-4 w-4 accent-emerald-600"
                    />

                    <span
                      className={`text-sm font-bold ${
                        role[field]
                          ? "text-emerald-800"
                          : "text-slate-500"
                      }`}
                    >
                      {label}
                    </span>
                  </label>
                ))}
              </div>
            </div>
          ))}

          {!roles.length && (
            <div className="rounded-2xl border border-dashed border-slate-300 bg-white p-12 text-center text-sm text-slate-500">
              No roles created yet.
            </div>
          )}
        </div>
      </div>
    </div>
  );
}

"use client";

export const dynamic = "force-dynamic";

import { useEffect, useState } from "react";

export default function SalaryPage() {
  const [staff, setStaff] = useState<any[]>([]);
  const [salaryData, setSalaryData] = useState<any[]>([]);

  useEffect(() => {
    try {
      setStaff(JSON.parse(localStorage.getItem("freshcut-staff") || "[]"));
      setSalaryData(JSON.parse(localStorage.getItem("freshcut-salary") || "[]"));
    } catch {
      setStaff([]);
      setSalaryData([]);
    }
  }, []);

  function updateSalary(employee: any, amount: string) {
    const updated = salaryData.filter((s) => s.staffId !== employee.id);

    updated.push({
      staffId: employee.id,
      name: employee.name,
      role: employee.role,
      salary: amount,
    });

    setSalaryData(updated);
    localStorage.setItem("freshcut-salary", JSON.stringify(updated));
  }

  function getSalary(id: number) {
    return salaryData.find((s) => s.staffId === id)?.salary || "";
  }

  const totalSalary = salaryData.reduce(
    (sum, item) => sum + Number(item.salary || 0),
    0
  );

  return (
    <div className="min-h-screen bg-[#f5f7f7] p-5 md:p-7">
      <div className="mx-auto max-w-[1600px]">
        <div className="mb-7">
          <p className="text-xs font-bold uppercase tracking-[0.18em] text-emerald-700">
            Fresh2Cook Admin
          </p>
          <h1 className="mt-1 text-3xl font-extrabold text-[#123b38] md:text-4xl">
            Salary Management
          </h1>
          <p className="mt-1 text-sm text-slate-500">
            Manage monthly staff salary records.
          </p>
        </div>

        <div className="mb-7 rounded-2xl border border-emerald-100 bg-emerald-50 p-6 shadow-sm">
          <p className="text-sm font-bold text-emerald-700">
            Monthly Salary Budget
          </p>
          <p className="mt-2 text-4xl font-extrabold text-[#123b38]">
            â‚¹{totalSalary.toLocaleString("en-IN")}
          </p>
        </div>

        <div className="grid gap-5 md:grid-cols-2">
          {staff.map((employee) => (
            <div
              key={employee.id}
              className="rounded-2xl border border-slate-200 bg-white p-6 shadow-sm"
            >
              <div className="flex items-start justify-between">
                <div>
                  <h2 className="text-xl font-extrabold text-[#123b38]">
                    {employee.name}
                  </h2>
                  <p className="mt-1 text-sm text-slate-500">
                    {employee.role}
                  </p>
                  <p className="mt-1 text-sm text-slate-500">
                    {employee.mobile || employee.phone || "â€”"}
                  </p>
                </div>

                <span className="rounded-full bg-blue-50 px-3 py-1 text-xs font-bold text-blue-700">
                  SALARY
                </span>
              </div>

              <input
                type="number"
                placeholder="Monthly Salary"
                defaultValue={getSalary(employee.id)}
                onBlur={(e) => updateSalary(employee, e.target.value)}
                className="mt-5 w-full rounded-xl border border-slate-300 px-4 py-3 text-sm outline-none focus:border-emerald-600"
              />
            </div>
          ))}

          {!staff.length && (
            <div className="rounded-2xl border border-dashed border-slate-300 bg-white p-12 text-center text-sm text-slate-500 md:col-span-2">
              No staff members available.
            </div>
          )}
        </div>
      </div>
    </div>
  );

"use client";

export const dynamic = "force-dynamic";

import { useEffect, useState } from "react";

export default function AnalyticsPage() {
  const [stats, setStats] = useState({
    orders: 0,
    revenue: 0,
    customers: 0,
    products: 0,
  });

  useEffect(() => {
    loadAnalytics();
  }, []);

  function loadAnalytics() {
    try {
      const orders = JSON.parse(localStorage.getItem("freshcut-orders") || "[]");
      const products = JSON.parse(localStorage.getItem("freshcut-products") || "[]");

      const revenue = orders.reduce(
        (sum: number, order: any) =>
          sum + Number(order.total || order.amount || 0),
        0
      );

      const customers = new Set(
        orders.map((o: any) => o.phone).filter(Boolean)
      ).size;

      setStats({
        orders: orders.length,
        revenue,
        customers,
        products: products.length,
      });
    } catch {
      setStats({ orders: 0, revenue: 0, customers: 0, products: 0 });
    }
  }

  const averageOrder =
    stats.orders > 0 ? Math.round(stats.revenue / stats.orders) : 0;

  const conversion =
    stats.customers > 0
      ? Math.round((stats.orders / stats.customers) * 10) / 10
      : 0;

  return (
    <div className="min-h-screen bg-[#f5f7f7] p-5 md:p-7">
      <div className="mx-auto max-w-[1600px]">
        <div className="mb-7 flex flex-col gap-4 md:flex-row md:items-center md:justify-between">
          <div>
            <p className="text-xs font-bold uppercase tracking-[0.18em] text-emerald-700">
              Fresh2Cook Admin
            </p>
            <h1 className="mt-1 text-3xl font-extrabold text-[#123b38] md:text-4xl">
              Sales Analytics
            </h1>
            <p className="mt-1 text-sm text-slate-500">
              Key performance indicators from current business records.
            </p>
          </div>

          <button
            onClick={loadAnalytics}
            className="w-fit rounded-xl bg-[#063f3d] px-5 py-3 text-sm font-bold text-white hover:bg-[#0a514d]"
          >
            â†» Refresh
          </button>
        </div>

        <div className="mb-7 grid gap-4 sm:grid-cols-2 xl:grid-cols-4">
          {[
            ["Orders", stats.orders, "text-[#123b38]", "bg-slate-50"],
            ["Revenue", `â‚¹${stats.revenue.toLocaleString("en-IN")}`, "text-emerald-700", "bg-emerald-50"],
            ["Customers", stats.customers, "text-blue-700", "bg-blue-50"],
            ["Products", stats.products, "text-violet-700", "bg-violet-50"],
          ].map(([title, value, color, bg]) => (
            <div key={String(title)} className={`rounded-2xl border border-slate-200 ${bg} p-5 shadow-sm`}>
              <p className="text-sm font-semibold text-slate-500">{title}</p>
              <p className={`mt-2 text-3xl font-extrabold ${color}`}>{value}</p>
            </div>
          ))}
        </div>

        <div className="grid gap-6 md:grid-cols-2">
          <div className="rounded-2xl border border-slate-200 bg-white p-7 shadow-sm">
            <p className="text-sm font-bold text-slate-500">Average Order Value</p>
            <p className="mt-3 text-5xl font-extrabold text-emerald-700">
              â‚¹{averageOrder.toLocaleString("en-IN")}
            </p>
            <p className="mt-3 text-sm text-slate-500">
              Calculated from total revenue and recorded orders.
            </p>
          </div>

          <div className="rounded-2xl border border-slate-200 bg-white p-7 shadow-sm">
            <p className="text-sm font-bold text-slate-500">Orders / Customer</p>
            <p className="mt-3 text-5xl font-extrabold text-blue-700">
              {conversion}x

            <p className="mt-3 text-sm text-slate-500">
              Based on current order and customer records.

"use client";

export const dynamic = "force-dynamic";

import { useEffect, useState } from "react";

type Settings = {
  businessName: string;
  phone: string;
  email: string;
  address: string;
  deliveryCharge: string;
  minOrder: string;
};

export default function SettingsPage() {
  const [settings, setSettings] = useState<Settings>({
    businessName: "Fresh2Cook",
    phone: "9811001901",
    email: "info@freshcut.com",
    address: "New Delhi",
    deliveryCharge: "40",
    minOrder: "199",
  });

  useEffect(() => {
    try {
      const data = localStorage.getItem("freshcut-settings");
      if (data) setSettings(JSON.parse(data));
    } catch {
      // keep defaults
    }
  }, []);

  function update(key: keyof Settings, value: string) {
    setSettings((current) => ({
      ...current,
      [key]: value,
    }));
  }

  function saveSettings() {
    localStorage.setItem("freshcut-settings", JSON.stringify(settings));
    alert("Settings Saved Successfully");
  }

  return (
    <div className="min-h-screen bg-[#f5f7f7] p-5 md:p-7">
      <div className="mx-auto max-w-[1200px]">
        <div className="mb-7">
          <p className="text-xs font-bold uppercase tracking-[0.18em] text-emerald-700">
            Fresh2Cook Admin
          </p>
          <h1 className="mt-1 text-3xl font-extrabold text-[#123b38] md:text-4xl">
            System Settings
          </h1>
          <p className="mt-1 text-sm text-slate-500">
            Manage core business and delivery configuration.
          </p>
        </div>

        <div className="rounded-2xl border border-slate-200 bg-white p-6 shadow-sm md:p-8">
          <div className="mb-7 border-b border-slate-100 pb-5">
            <h2 className="text-lg font-extrabold text-[#123b38]">
              Business Configuration
            </h2>
            <p className="mt-1 text-sm text-slate-500">
              Update the information used across the system.
            </p>
          </div>

          <div className="grid gap-5 md:grid-cols-2">
            <Field
              label="Business Name"
              value={settings.businessName}
              onChange={(value) => update("businessName", value)}
            />

            <Field
              label="Mobile Number"
              value={settings.phone}
              onChange={(value) => update("phone", value)}
            />

            <Field
              label="Email Address"
              value={settings.email}
              onChange={(value) => update("email", value)}
            />

            <Field
              label="Delivery Charge"
              value={settings.deliveryCharge}
              onChange={(value) => update("deliveryCharge", value)}
            />

            <Field
              label="Minimum Order Value"
              value={settings.minOrder}
              onChange={(value) => update("minOrder", value)}
            />

            <div className="md:col-span-2">
              <label className="mb-2 block text-sm font-bold text-slate-600">
                Business Address
              </label>
              <textarea
                value={settings.address}
                onChange={(e) => update("address", e.target.value)}
                rows={4}
                className="w-full rounded-xl border border-slate-300 px-4 py-3 text-sm outline-none focus:border-emerald-600"
              />
            </div>
          </div>

          <button
            onClick={saveSettings}
            className="mt-7 rounded-xl bg-[#063f3d] px-10 py-3 text-sm font-bold text-white hover:bg-[#0a514d]"
          >
            Save Settings
          </button>
        </div>
      </div>
    </div>
  );
}

function Field({
  label,
  value,
  onChange,
}: {
  label: string;
  value: string;
  onChange: (value: string) => void;
}) {
  return (
    <div>
      <label className="mb-2 block text-sm font-bold text-slate-600">
        {label}
      </label>
      <input
        value={value}
        onChange={(e) => onChange(e.target.value)}
        className="w-full rounded-xl border border-slate-300 px-4 py-3 text-sm outline-none focus:border-emerald-600"
      />
    </div>
  );
}

"use client";

export const dynamic = "force-dynamic";

import { useEffect, useState } from "react";

export default function StaffPage() {
  const [staff, setStaff] = useState<any[]>([]);
  const [name, setName] = useState("");
  const [phone, setPhone] = useState("");
  const [role, setRole] = useState("");

  useEffect(() => {
    loadStaff();
  }, []);

  function loadStaff() {
    try {
      setStaff(
        JSON.parse(localStorage.getItem("freshcut-staff") || "[]")
      );
    } catch {
      setStaff([]);
    }
  }

  function addStaff() {
    if (!name || !phone || !role) {
      alert("Fill All Fields");
      return;
    }

    const member = {
      id: Date.now(),
      name,
      phone,
      role,
      status: "Active",
      joiningDate: new Date().toLocaleDateString(),
    };

    const updated = [member, ...staff];

    localStorage.setItem("freshcut-staff", JSON.stringify(updated));
    setStaff(updated);

    setName("");
    setPhone("");
    setRole("");

    alert("Staff Added Successfully");
  }

  function toggleStatus(id: number) {
    const updated = staff.map((item) =>
      item.id === id
        ? {
            ...item,
            status: item.status === "Active" ? "Inactive" : "Active",
          }
        : item
    );

    localStorage.setItem("freshcut-staff", JSON.stringify(updated));
    setStaff(updated);
  }

  function deleteStaff(id: number) {
    if (!confirm("Delete Staff?")) return;

    const updated = staff.filter((item) => item.id !== id);

    localStorage.setItem("freshcut-staff", JSON.stringify(updated));
    setStaff(updated);
  }

  const activeStaff = staff.filter((item) => item.status === "Active").length;

  return (

            <p className="mt-2 text-3xl font-extrabold text-[#123b38]">
              {staff.length}
            </p>
          </div>

          <div className="rounded-2xl border border-emerald-100 bg-emerald-50 p-5 shadow-sm">
            <p className="text-sm font-semibold text-emerald-700">Active Staff</p>

    loadInventory();

        localStorage.getItem("freshcut-inventory") || "[]"
      );

        data.filter((item: any) => Number(item.stock) <= 10)
      );

      setItems([]);

"use client";

export const dynamic = "force-dynamic";

import { useEffect, useState } from "react";

export default function SubscriptionsPage() {
  const [subscriptions, setSubscriptions] =
    useState<any[]>([]);

  const [customer, setCustomer] =
    useState("");

  const [phone, setPhone] =
    useState("");

  const [plan, setPlan] =
    useState("");

  useEffect(() => {
    loadSubscriptions();
  }, []);

  function loadSubscriptions() {
    const data = JSON.parse(
      localStorage.getItem(
        "freshcut-subscriptions"
      ) || "[]"
    );

    setSubscriptions(data);
  }

  function addSubscription() {
    if (
      !customer ||
      !phone ||
      !plan
    ) {
      alert(
        "Fill All Fields"
      );
      return;
    }

    const subscription = {
      id: Date.now(),
      customer,
      phone,
      plan,
      status: "Active",
      startDate:
        new Date().toLocaleDateString(),
    };

    const updated = [
      subscription,
      ...subscriptions,
    ];

    localStorage.setItem(
      "freshcut-subscriptions",
      JSON.stringify(updated)
    );

    setSubscriptions(updated);

    setCustomer("");
    setPhone("");
    setPlan("");

    alert(
      "Subscription Added Successfully"
    );
  }

  function toggleStatus(
    id: number
  ) {
    const updated =
      subscriptions.map(
        (item) =>
          item.id === id
            ? {
                ...item,
                status:
                  item.status ===
                  "Active"
                    ? "Paused"
                    : "Active",
              }
            : item
      );

    localStorage.setItem(
      "freshcut-subscriptions",
      JSON.stringify(updated)
    );

    setSubscriptions(updated);
  }

  function deleteSubscription(
    id: number
  ) {
    if (
      !confirm(

      !name ||

export default function Page(){

  useState<any>();

 const [delivery,setDelivery] =
  useState<any>();

 const [push,setPush] =
  useState<any>();

 useEffect(()=>{

  fetch("/api/tracking/rider-location")
   .then(r=>r.json())
   .then(setRider);

  fetch("/api/tracking/delivery-status")
   .then(r=>r.json())
   .then(setDelivery);

  fetch("/api/push/status")
   .then(r=>r.json())
   .then(setPush);

 },[]);

 return(

  <div className="p-6">

   <h1 className="text-4xl font-bold mb-6">
    Tracking Center
   </h1>

   <div className="grid md:grid-cols-3 gap-4">

    <div className="bg-white p-6 rounded-xl shadow">

      <div>{rider?.rider?.name}</div>
      <div>{rider?.rider?.status}</div>
    </div>

    <div className="bg-white p-6 rounded-xl shadow">
      Delivery
      <div>{delivery?.status}</div>
      <div>{delivery?.eta}</div>
    </div>

    <div className="bg-white p-6 rounded-xl shadow">
      Push Engine
      <div>{push?.pushNotifications}</div>
    </div>

  </div>

 );

"use client";

export const dynamic = "force-dynamic";

import { useEffect, useState } from "react";

export default function WhatsAppAutomationPage() {
  const [rules, setRules] =
    useState<any[]>([]);

  useEffect(() => {
    loadRules();
  }, []);

  function loadRules() {
    const saved =
      JSON.parse(
        localStorage.getItem(
          "freshcut-whatsapp-rules"
        ) || "[]"
      );

    if (saved.length > 0) {
      setRules(saved);
      return;
    }

    const defaultRules = [
      {
        id: 1,
        name:
          "Birthday Wishes",
        enabled: true,
        template:
          "ÃƒÂ°Ã…Â¸Ã…Â½Ã¢â‚¬Â° Happy Birthday! Fresh2Cook ki taraf se aapko dher sari shubhkamnaye.",
      },
      {
        id: 2,
        name:
          "Reorder Reminder",
        enabled: true,
        template:
          "ÃƒÂ°Ã…Â¸Ã‚Â¥Ã‚Â¬ Aapka regular order due hai. Fresh vegetables order karein.",
      },
      {
        id: 3,
        name:
          "Cart Abandonment",
        enabled: true,
        template:
          "ÃƒÂ°Ã…Â¸Ã¢â‚¬ÂºÃ¢â‚¬â„¢ Aapke cart me items pending hain. Order complete karein.",
      },
      {
        id: 4,
        name:
          "Subscription Renewal",
        enabled: true,
        template:
          "ÃƒÂ°Ã…Â¸Ã¢â‚¬Å“Ã‚Â¦ Aapki subscription renew hone wali hai.",
      },
    ];

    setRules(
      defaultRules
    );

    localStorage.setItem(
      "freshcut-whatsapp-rules",
      JSON.stringify(
        defaultRules
      )
    );
  }

  function toggleRule(
    id: number
  ) {
    const updated =
      rules.map(
        (rule: any) =>
          rule.id === id
            ? {
                ...rule,
                enabled:
                  !rule.enabled,
              }
            : rule
      );

    setRules(updated);

    localStorage.setItem(
      "freshcut-whatsapp-rules",
      JSON.stringify(
        updated
      )
    );
  }

  function runNow(
    name: string
  ) {
    alert(
      `${name} Campaign Triggered`
    );
  }

  const activeRules =
    rules.filter(
      (r: any) =>
        r.enabled
    ).length;

  return (
    <div className="min-h-screen bg-gray-100 p-6">

      <div className="max-w-7xl mx-auto">

        <h1 className="text-4xl font-bold mb-8">
          WhatsApp Automation Engine
        </h1>

        <div className="grid md:grid-cols-3 gap-4 mb-8">

          <div className="bg-white p-6 rounded-3xl shadow">

            <p>
              Total Rules
            </p>

            <h2 className="text-3xl font-bold">
              {rules.length}
            </h2>

          </div>

          <div className="bg-white p-6 rounded-3xl shadow">

            <p>
              Active Rules
            </p>

            <h2 className="text-3xl font-bold text-green-600">
              {activeRules}
            </h2>

          </div>

          <div className="bg-white p-6 rounded-3xl shadow">

            <p>
              Today's Triggers
            </p>

            <h2 className="text-3xl font-bold text-blue-600">
              47
            </h2>

          </div>

        </div>

        <div className="space-y-4">

          {rules.map(
            (rule: any) => (
              <div
                key={rule.id}
                className="bg-white rounded-3xl shadow p-6"
              >

                <div className="flex flex-col md:flex-row md:justify-between gap-4">

                  <div>

                    <h2 className="text-xl font-bold">
                      {rule.name}
                    </h2>

                    <p className="mt-2 text-gray-600">
                      {rule.template}
                    </p>

                    <p className="mt-3">

                      Status:

                      <span
                        className={`ml-2 font-bold ${
                          rule.enabled
                            ? "text-green-600"
                            : "text-red-600"
                        }`}
                      >
                        {rule.enabled
                          ? "Active"
                          : "Disabled"}
                      </span>

                    </p>

                  </div>

                  <div className="flex gap-3">

                    <button
                      onClick={() =>
                        toggleRule(
                          rule.id
                        )
                      }
                      className="bg-yellow-500 text-white px-4 py-2 rounded-xl"
                    >
                      {rule.enabled
                        ? "Disable"
                        : "Enable"}
                    </button>

                    <button
                      onClick={() =>
                        runNow(
                          rule.name
                        )
                      }
                      className="bg-green-600 text-white px-4 py-2 rounded-xl"
                    >
                      Run Now
                    </button>

                  </div>

                </div>

              </div>

  );

"use client";

export const dynamic = "force-dynamic";

import { useEffect, useState } from "react";

export default function WhatsAppCampaignPage() {
  const [campaigns, setCampaigns] =
    useState<any[]>([]);

  const [title, setTitle] =
    useState("");

  const [message, setMessage] =
    useState("");

  useEffect(() => {
    loadCampaigns();
  }, []);

  function loadCampaigns() {
    const data = JSON.parse(
      localStorage.getItem(
        "freshcut-whatsapp-campaigns"
      ) || "[]"
    );

    setCampaigns(data);
  }

  function createCampaign() {
    if (
      !title ||
      !message
    ) {
      alert(
        "Fill All Fields"
      );
      return;
    }

    const updated = [
      {
        id: Date.now(),
        title,
        message,
        status: "Draft",
        createdAt:
          new Date().toLocaleDateString(),
      },
      ...campaigns,
    ];

    localStorage.setItem(
      "freshcut-whatsapp-campaigns",
      JSON.stringify(updated)
    );

    setTitle("");
    setMessage("");

    loadCampaigns();
  }

  function sendCampaign(
    id: number
  ) {
    const updated =
      campaigns.map(
        (item: any) =>
          item.id === id
            ? {
                ...item,
                status: "Sent",
              }
            : item
      );

    localStorage.setItem(
      "freshcut-whatsapp-campaigns",
      JSON.stringify(updated)
    );

    loadCampaigns();

    alert(
      "Campaign Sent Successfully"
    );
  }

  function deleteCampaign(
    id: number
  ) {
    const updated =
      campaigns.filter(
        (item: any) =>
          item.id !== id
      );

    localStorage.setItem(
      "freshcut-whatsapp-campaigns",
      JSON.stringify(updated)
    );

    loadCampaigns();
  }

  return (
    <div className="min-h-screen bg-gray-100 p-6">

      <div className="max-w-7xl mx-auto">

        <h1 className="text-4xl font-bold mb-8">
          WhatsApp Campaigns
        </h1>

        <div className="bg-white rounded-3xl shadow p-6 mb-8">

          <h2 className="text-2xl font-bold mb-4">
            Create Campaign
          </h2>

          <div className="space-y-4">

            <input
              value={title}
              onChange={(e) =>
                setTitle(
                  e.target.value
                )
              }
              placeholder="Campaign Title"
              className="w-full border p-3 rounded-xl"
            />

            <textarea
              value={message}
              onChange={(e) =>
                setMessage(
                  e.target.value
                )
              }
              placeholder="WhatsApp Message"
              rows={5}
              className="w-full border p-3 rounded-xl"
            />

            <button
              onClick={
                createCampaign
              }
              className="bg-green-600 text-white px-8 py-3 rounded-xl font-bold"
            >
              Create Campaign
            </button>

          </div>

        </div>

        <div className="space-y-4">

          {campaigns.map(
            (campaign: any) => (
              <div
                key={campaign.id}
                className="bg-white rounded-3xl shadow p-6"
              >

                <div className="flex flex-col md:flex-row md:justify-between gap-4">

                  <div>

                    <h2 className="text-xl font-bold">
                      {campaign.title}
                    </h2>

                    <p className="mt-2 text-gray-600">
                      {campaign.message}
                    </p>

                    <p className="mt-3 font-bold text-blue-600">
                      {campaign.status}
                    </p>

                  </div>

                  <div className="flex gap-2 flex-wrap">

                    <button
                      onClick={() =>
                        sendCampaign(
                          campaign.id
                        )
                      }
                      className="bg-green-600 text-white px-4 py-2 rounded-xl"
                    >
                      Send
                    </button>

                    <button
                      onClick={() =>
                        deleteCampaign(
                          campaign.id
                        )
                      }
                      className="bg-red-600 text-white px-4 py-2 rounded-xl"
                    >
                      Delete
                    </button>

                  </div>

                </div>

              </div>
            )
          )}

        </div>

      </div>

    </div>
  );
}

      }`}
    >
      {icon}
      <span className="font-bold">{text}</span>
    </Link>
  );
}

className={
status==="Delivered"
? "px-2 py-1 rounded-full bg-green-100 text-green-700"
: status==="Pending"
? "px-2 py-1 rounded-full bg-yellow-100 text-yellow-700"
: status==="Ready"
? "px-2 py-1 rounded-full bg-purple-100 text-purple-700"
: "px-2 py-1 rounded-full bg-blue-100 text-blue-700"
}
>
{status}
</span>
  </span>

</td>
    </tr>
  );
}

function Activity({ text }: any) {

        <Clock3 size={18} />

==================== D:\D Drive\Desktop\CRM\FreshCut-CRM-Professional-Starter\app\api\admin-assign-order\route.ts ====================

import { NextResponse } from "next/server";
import { prisma } from "@/lib/prisma";

export async function GET() {
  try {
    const orders = await prisma.order.findMany({
      where: {
        status: {
          notIn: [
            "Delivered",
            "Cancelled",
            "Assigned To Rider",
            "Assigned",
          ],
        },
      },
      orderBy: {
        id: "desc",
      },
    });

    const riders =
      await prisma.deliveryBoy.findMany({
        orderBy: {
          id: "desc",
        },
      });

    return NextResponse.json({
      success: true,
      orders,
      riders,
    });
  } catch (error: any) {
    console.error(
      "ADMIN ASSIGN GET ERROR:",
      error
    );

    return NextResponse.json(
      {
        success: false,
        error:
          error?.message ||
          "Failed To Load Data",
      },
      {
        status: 500,
      }
    );
  }
}

export async function POST(
  req: Request
) {
  try {
    const body = await req.json();

    const orderId = Number(
      body?.orderId
    );

    const riderId = Number(
      body?.riderId
    );

    if (
      !Number.isInteger(orderId) ||
      orderId <= 0
    ) {
      return NextResponse.json(
        {
          success: false,
          error: "Valid Order ID required",
        },
        {
          status: 400,
        }
      );
    }

    if (
      !Number.isInteger(riderId) ||
      riderId <= 0
    ) {
      return NextResponse.json(
        {
          success: false,
          error: "Valid Rider ID required",
        },
        {
          status: 400,
        }
      );
    }

    const order =
      await prisma.order.findUnique({
        where: {
          id: orderId,
        },
      });

    if (!order) {
      return NextResponse.json(
        {
          success: false,
          error: "Order Not Found",
        },
        {
          status: 404,
        }
      );
    }

    const rider =
      await prisma.deliveryBoy.findUnique({
        where: {
          id: riderId,
        },
      });

    if (!rider) {
      return NextResponse.json(
        {
          success: false,
          error: "Rider Not Found",
        },
        {
          status: 404,
        }
      );
    }

    const existing =
      await prisma.deliveryAssignment.findFirst(
        {
          where: {
            orderId,
          },
        }
      );

    if (existing) {
      return NextResponse.json(
        {
          success: false,
          error: "Order Already Assigned",
        },
        {
          status: 409,
        }
      );
    }

    const assignment =
      await prisma.deliveryAssignment.create({
        data: {
          orderId,
          deliveryBoyId:
            riderId,

          /*
           * OTP is NOT generated at assignment.
           * It will be generated only at delivery.
           */
          otp: "",

          status:
            "Pending Acceptance",

          assignedAt:
            new Date(),

          pickupDeadline:
            new Date(
              Date.now() +
                3 * 60 * 1000
            ),

          earnings: 25,
        },
      });

    await prisma.order.update({
      where: {
        id: orderId,
      },
      data: {
        status:
          "Assigned To Rider",

        deliveryOtp: null,
      },
    });

    return NextResponse.json({
      success: true,
      assignment,
      message:
        "Order assigned to rider. Delivery OTP will be generated only at delivery.",
    });
  } catch (error: any) {
    console.error(
      "ADMIN ASSIGN POST ERROR:",
      error
    );

    return NextResponse.json(
      {
        success: false,
        error:
          error?.message ||
          "Internal Server Error",
      },
      {
        status: 500,
      }
    );
  }
}



==================== D:\D Drive\Desktop\CRM\FreshCut-CRM-Professional-Starter\app\api\admin-auto-dispatch\route.ts ====================

import { NextResponse } from "next/server";
import { prisma } from "@/lib/prisma";

type Rider = {
  id: number;
  latitude: number | null;
  longitude: number | null;
  status: string;
};

function distance(
  lat1: number,
  lon1: number,
  lat2: number,
  lon2: number
) {
  const dLat = ((lat2 - lat1) * Math.PI) / 180;
  const dLon = ((lon2 - lon1) * Math.PI) / 180;

  const a =
    Math.sin(dLat / 2) ** 2 +
    Math.cos((lat1 * Math.PI) / 180) *
      Math.cos((lat2 * Math.PI) / 180) *
      Math.sin(dLon / 2) ** 2;

  return (
    6371 *
    2 *
    Math.atan2(
      Math.sqrt(a),
      Math.sqrt(1 - a)
    )
  );
}

function otp() {
  return Math.floor(
    1000 + Math.random() * 9000
  ).toString();
}

export async function POST(req: Request) {
  try {
    const body = await req.json();

    const orderId = Number(body.orderId);
    const latitude = Number(body.latitude);
    const longitude = Number(body.longitude);

    const riders: Rider[] =
      await prisma.deliveryBoy.findMany({
        where: {
          status: "Available",
        },
      });

    if (!riders.length) {
      return NextResponse.json(
        {
          error: "No Rider Available",
        },
        {
          status: 400,
        }
      );
    }

    const ranked = riders
      .filter(
        (rider: Rider) =>
          rider.latitude !== null &&
          rider.longitude !== null
      )
      .map((rider: Rider) => ({
        rider,
        distance: distance(
          latitude,
          longitude,
          rider.latitude as number,
          rider.longitude as number
        ),
      }))
      .sort(
        (
          a: {
            rider: Rider;
            distance: number;
          },
          b: {
            rider: Rider;
            distance: number;
          }
        ) => a.distance - b.distance
      );

    const selected = ranked[0];

    if (!selected) {
      return NextResponse.json(
        {
          error: "No GPS Rider Found",
        },
        {
          status: 400,
        }
      );
    }

    const assignment =
      await prisma.deliveryAssignment.create({
        data: {
          orderId,
          deliveryBoyId:
            selected.rider.id,
          otp: otp(),
          status:
            "Pending Acceptance",
        },
      });

    return NextResponse.json({
      success: true,
      assignment,
      rider: selected.rider,
      distance:
        selected.distance.toFixed(2),
    });
  } catch (error) {
    console.error(
      "AUTO DISPATCH ERROR",
      error
    );

    return NextResponse.json(
      {
        error: "Dispatch Failed",
      },
      {
        status: 500,
      }
    );
  }
}

import { NextResponse } from "next/server";
import { prisma } from "@/lib/prisma";

export async function GET() {
  try {
    const riders =
      await prisma.deliveryBoy.findMany();

    const deliveredOrders =
      await prisma.deliveryAssignment.count({
        where: {
          status: "Delivered",
        },
      });

    const pendingOrders =
      await prisma.deliveryAssignment.count({
        where: {
          status: {
            not: "Delivered",
          },
        },
      });

    const revenue =
      deliveredOrders * 40;

    return NextResponse.json({
      totalRiders:
        riders.length,

      deliveredOrders,

      pendingOrders,

      revenue,

      riders,
    });
  } catch (error) {
    console.error(error);

    return NextResponse.json(
      {
        error:
          "Failed To Load Analytics",
      },
      {
        status: 500,
      }
    );
  }
}

==================== D:\D Drive\Desktop\CRM\FreshCut-CRM-Professional-Starter\app\api\admin-delivery-control-tower\route.ts ====================

import { NextResponse } from "next/server";
import { prisma } from "@/lib/prisma";

export async function GET() {
  try {
    const totalRiders =
      await prisma.deliveryBoy.count();

    const onlineRiders =
      await prisma.deliveryBoy.count({
        where: {
          status: {
            in: [
              "Online",
              "On Delivery",
              "Available",
            ],
          },
        },
      });

    const activeOrders =
      await prisma.deliveryAssignment.count({
        where: {
          status: {
            in: [
              "Pending Acceptance",
              "Accepted",
              "Picked Up",
              "Out For Delivery",
            ],
          },
        },
      });

    const completedOrders =
      await prisma.deliveryAssignment.count({
        where: {
          status: "Delivered",
        },
      });

    const delayedOrders =
      await prisma.deliveryAssignment.count({
        where: {
          status: {
            in: [
              "Pending Acceptance",
              "Accepted",
            ],
          },
          assignedAt: {
            lte: new Date(
              Date.now() -
                30 *
                  60 *
                  1000
            ),
          },
        },
      });

    const totalRevenue =
      await prisma.deliveryBoy.aggregate({
        _sum: {
          earnings: true,
        },
      });

    const riders =
      await prisma.deliveryBoy.findMany({
        orderBy: {
          lastSeen: "desc",
        },
        take: 10,
      });

    const latestOrders =
      await prisma.deliveryAssignment.findMany(
        {
          orderBy: {
            assignedAt:
              "desc",
          },
          take: 15,
        }
      );

    return NextResponse.json({
      success: true,

      summary: {
        totalRiders,
        onlineRiders,
        activeOrders,
        completedOrders,
        delayedOrders,

        totalEarnings:
          totalRevenue._sum
            .earnings || 0,
      },

      riders,
      latestOrders,
    });
  } catch (error) {
    console.error(
      "CONTROL TOWER ERROR",
      error
    );

    return NextResponse.json(
      {
        error:
          "Failed To Load Control Tower",
      },
      {
        status: 500,
      }
    );
  }
}

import { NextResponse } from "next/server";
import { prisma } from "@/lib/prisma";

export async function GET() {
  try {

    const [
      totalRiders,
      onlineRiders,
      totalOrders,
      deliveredOrders,
      pendingOrders,
      assignments,
      pendingAssignments,
      acceptedAssignments,
      deliveredAssignments
    ] = await Promise.all([

      prisma.deliveryBoy.count(),

      prisma.deliveryBoy.count({
        where: {
          status: "Online",
        },
      }),

      prisma.order.count(),

      prisma.order.count({
        where: {
          status: "Delivered",
        },
      }),

      prisma.order.count({
        where: {
          status: {
            notIn: [
              "Delivered",
              "Cancelled",
            ],
          },
        },
      }),

      prisma.deliveryAssignment.count(),

      prisma.deliveryAssignment.count({
        where: {
          status:
            "Pending Acceptance",
        },
      }),

      prisma.deliveryAssignment.count({
        where: {
          status:
            "Accepted",
        },
      }),

      prisma.deliveryAssignment.count({
        where: {
          status:
            "Delivered",
        },
      }),

    ]);

    return NextResponse.json({
      success: true,

      totalRiders,
      onlineRiders,

      totalOrders,
      deliveredOrders,
      pendingOrders,

      assignments,
      pendingAssignments,
      acceptedAssignments,
      deliveredAssignments,
    });

  } catch (error: any) {

    console.error(
      "DELIVERY DASHBOARD ERROR",
      error
    );

    return NextResponse.json(
      {
        success: false,
        error: error?.message ?? "Internal Server Error",
      },
      {
        status: 500,
      }
    );
  }
}

==================== D:\D Drive\Desktop\CRM\FreshCut-CRM-Professional-Starter\app\api\admin-delivery-performance\route.ts ====================

import { NextResponse } from "next/server";
import { prisma } from "@/lib/prisma";

type Assignment = {
  status: string;
  lateDelivery: boolean | null;
};

export async function GET() {
  try {
    const assignments: Assignment[] =
      await prisma.deliveryAssignment.findMany();

    const total =
      assignments.length;

    const delivered =
      assignments.filter(
        (x: Assignment) =>
          x.status ===
          "Delivered"
      ).length;

    const late =
      assignments.filter(
        (x: Assignment) =>
          Boolean(
            x.lateDelivery
          )
      ).length;

    const sla =
      total > 0
        ? Number(
            (
              ((total - late) /
                total) *
              100
            ).toFixed(2)
          )
        : 100;

    return NextResponse.json({
      total,
      delivered,
      late,
      sla,
    });
  } catch (error) {
    console.error(error);

    return NextResponse.json(
      {
        error:
          "Failed To Load Performance",
      },
      {
        status: 500,
      }
    );
  }
}

==================== D:\D Drive\Desktop\CRM\FreshCut-CRM-Professional-Starter\app\api\admin-delivery-riders\route.ts ====================

import { NextResponse } from "next/server";
import { prisma } from "@/lib/prisma";

type Rider = {
  id: number;
  name: string;
};

export async function GET() {
  try {
    const riders: Rider[] =
      await prisma.deliveryBoy.findMany({
        orderBy: {
          name: "asc",
        },
      });

    const data =
      await Promise.all(
        riders.map(
          async (rider: Rider) => {
            const activeOrder =
              await prisma.deliveryAssignment.findFirst(
                {
                  where: {
                    deliveryBoyId:
                      rider.id,
                    status: {
                      in: [
                        "Pending Acceptance",
                        "Accepted",
                        "Picked Up",
                        "Out For Delivery",
                      ],
                    },
                  },
                  orderBy: {
                    assignedAt:
                      "desc",
                  },
                }
              );

            const todayDeliveries =
              await prisma.deliveryAssignment.count(
                {
                  where: {
                    deliveryBoyId:
                      rider.id,
                    status:
                      "Delivered",
                    deliveredAt: {
                      gte: new Date(
                        new Date().setHours(
                          0,
                          0,
                          0,
                          0
                        )
                      ),
                    },
                  },
                }
              );

            return {
              ...rider,

              currentOrder:
                activeOrder?.orderId ||
                null,

              currentStatus:
                activeOrder?.status ||
                "Idle",

              todayDeliveries,
            };
          }
        )
      );

    return NextResponse.json(
      data
    );
  } catch (error) {
    console.error(
      "ADMIN DELIVERY RIDERS ERROR",
      error
    );

    return NextResponse.json(
      {
        error:
          "Failed To Load Riders",
      },
      {
        status: 500,
      }
    );
  }
}



==================== D:\D Drive\Desktop\CRM\FreshCut-CRM-Professional-Starter\app\api\admin-delivery-sla\route.ts ====================

import { NextResponse } from "next/server";
import { prisma } from "@/lib/prisma";

type Assignment = {
  status: string;
  lateDelivery: boolean | null;
  adminAlert: boolean | null;
};

export async function GET() {
  try {
    const now = new Date();

    const pickupBreaches =
      await prisma.deliveryAssignment.updateMany({
        where: {
          status: "Pending Acceptance",
          pickupDeadline: {
            lt: now,
          },
          lateDelivery: false,
        },
        data: {
          lateDelivery: true,
          adminAlert: true,
        },
      });

    const deliveryBreaches =
      await prisma.deliveryAssignment.updateMany({
        where: {
          status: {
            not: "Delivered",
          },
          deliveryDeadline: {
            lt: now,
          },
          lateDelivery: false,
        },
        data: {
          lateDelivery: true,
          adminAlert: true,
        },
      });

    const assignments: Assignment[] =
      await prisma.deliveryAssignment.findMany({
        orderBy: {
          assignedAt: "desc",
        },
      });

    const total =
      assignments.length;

    const delivered =
      assignments.filter(
        (a: Assignment) =>
          a.status === "Delivered"
      ).length;

    const late =
      assignments.filter(
        (a: Assignment) =>
          a.lateDelivery === true
      ).length;

    const activeAlerts =
      assignments.filter(
        (a: Assignment) =>
          a.adminAlert === true
      ).length;

    const sla =
      total > 0
        ? Number(
            (
              ((total - late) /
                total) *
              100
            ).toFixed(2)
          )
        : 100;

    return NextResponse.json({
      success: true,
      total,
      delivered,
      late,
      activeAlerts,
      pickupBreaches:
        pickupBreaches.count,
      deliveryBreaches:
        deliveryBreaches.count,
      sla,
    });
  } catch (error) {
    console.error(
      "DELIVERY SLA ERROR:",
      error
    );

    return NextResponse.json(
      {
        success: false,
        error:
          "Failed To Load SLA",
      },
      {
        status: 500,
      }
    );
  }
}



==================== D:\D Drive\Desktop\CRM\FreshCut-CRM-Professional-Starter\app\api\admin-fleet-ai\route.ts ====================

import { NextResponse } from "next/server";
import { prisma } from "@/lib/prisma";

export async function GET() {
  try {
    const [
      riders,
      assignments,
      orders,
    ] = await Promise.all([
      prisma.deliveryBoy.findMany(),
      prisma.deliveryAssignment.findMany(),
      prisma.order.findMany(),
    ]);

    const onlineRiders =
      riders.filter(
        (r) => r.status === "Online"
      ).length;

    const lateAssignments =
      assignments.filter(
        (a) => a.lateDelivery
      ).length;

    const deliveredOrders =
      orders.filter(
        (o) =>
          o.status ===
          "Delivered"
      ).length;

    const pendingOrders =
      orders.filter(
        (o) =>
          o.status !==
            "Delivered" &&
          o.status !==
            "Cancelled"
      ).length;

    const fleetScore =
      riders.reduce(
        (sum, r) =>
          sum +
          r.completedDeliveries,
        0
      );

    return NextResponse.json({
      success: true,
      onlineRiders,
      lateAssignments,
      deliveredOrders,
      pendingOrders,
      fleetScore,
    });
  } catch (error: any) {
    return NextResponse.json(
      {
        success: false,
        error: error?.message,
      },
      { status: 500 }
    );
  }
}

==================== D:\D Drive\Desktop\CRM\FreshCut-CRM-Professional-Starter\app\api\admin-nearby-rider\route.ts ====================

import { NextResponse } from "next/server";
import { prisma } from "@/lib/prisma";

function calculateDistance(
  lat1: number,
  lon1: number,
  lat2: number,
  lon2: number
) {
  const R = 6371;

  const dLat =
    ((lat2 - lat1) * Math.PI) / 180;

  const dLon =
    ((lon2 - lon1) * Math.PI) / 180;

  const a =
    Math.sin(dLat / 2) *
      Math.sin(dLat / 2) +
    Math.cos((lat1 * Math.PI) / 180) *
      Math.cos((lat2 * Math.PI) / 180) *
      Math.sin(dLon / 2) *
      Math.sin(dLon / 2);

  const c =
    2 *
    Math.atan2(
      Math.sqrt(a),
      Math.sqrt(1 - a)
    );

  return R * c;
}

export async function GET(
  req: Request
) {
  try {
    const { searchParams } =
      new URL(req.url);

    const latitude = Number(
      searchParams.get("latitude")
    );

    const longitude = Number(
      searchParams.get("longitude")
    );

    const riders =
      await prisma.deliveryBoy.findMany({
        where: {
          status: "Available",
        },
      });

    const nearby = riders
      .filter(
        (r: any) =>
          r.latitude != null &&
          r.longitude != null
      )
      .map((rider: any) => ({
        ...rider,
        distance:
          calculateDistance(
            latitude,
            longitude,
            rider.latitude,
            rider.longitude
          ),
      }))
      .sort(
        (a: any, b: any) =>
          a.distance - b.distance
      );

    return NextResponse.json(
      nearby
    );
  } catch (error) {
    console.error(
      "NEARBY RIDER ERROR",
      error
    );

    return NextResponse.json(
      {
        error:
          "Failed To Load Riders",
      },
      {
        status: 500,
      }
    );
  }
}

import { NextResponse } from "next/server";
import { prisma } from "@/lib/prisma";

export async function GET() {
  try {
    const riders =
      await prisma.deliveryBoy.findMany({
        orderBy: {
          createdAt: "desc",
        },
      });

    const summary = {
      total:
        riders.length,

      approved:
        riders.filter(
          (r: any) =>
            r.approvalStatus ===
            "Approved"
        ).length,

      pending:
        riders.filter(
          (r: any) =>
            r.approvalStatus ===
            "Pending"
        ).length,

      rejected:
        riders.filter(
          (r: any) =>
            r.approvalStatus ===
            "Rejected"
        ).length,
    };

    return NextResponse.json({
      success: true,
      summary,
      riders,
    });
  } catch (error) {
    console.error(
      "RIDER APPROVAL GET ERROR:",
      error
    );

    return NextResponse.json(
      {
        success: false,
        error:
          "Failed To Load Riders",
      },
      {
        status: 500,
      }
    );
  }
}

export async function POST(
  req: Request
) {
  try {
    const body =
      await req.json();

    const riderId =
      Number(
        body.riderId
      );

    const status =
      String(
        body.status || ""
      );

    if (!riderId) {
      return NextResponse.json(
        {
          success: false,
          error:
            "Rider ID Required",
        },
        {
          status: 400,
        }
      );
    }

    if (
      ![
        "Approved",
        "Pending",
        "Rejected",
      ].includes(status)
    ) {
      return NextResponse.json(
        {
          success: false,
          error:
            "Invalid Status",
        },
        {
          status: 400,
        }
      );
    }

    const rider =
      await prisma.deliveryBoy.findUnique(
        {
          where: {
            id: riderId,
          },
        }
      );

    if (!rider) {
      return NextResponse.json(
        {
          success: false,
          error:
            "Rider Not Found",
        },
        {
          status: 404,
        }
      );
    }

    const updatedRider =
      await prisma.deliveryBoy.update(
        {
          where: {
            id: riderId,
          },
          data: {
            approvalStatus:
              status,
          },
        }
      );

    return NextResponse.json({
      success: true,
      message:
        `Rider ${status} Successfully`,
      rider:
        updatedRider,
    });
  } catch (error) {
    console.error(
      "RIDER APPROVAL POST ERROR:",
      error
    );

    return NextResponse.json(
      {
        success: false,
        error:
          "Failed To Update Rider Status",
      },
      {
        status: 500,
      }
    );
  }
}

import { NextResponse } from "next/server";
import { prisma } from "@/lib/prisma";

export async function GET() {
  try {
    const riders =
      await prisma.deliveryBoy.findMany({
        orderBy: {
          completedDeliveries:
            "desc",
        },
      });

    const leaderboard =
      riders.map(
        (rider, index) => ({
          rank:
            index + 1,

          id:
            rider.id,

          name:
            rider.name,

          mobile:
            rider.mobile,

          rating:
            rider.rating,

          deliveries:
            rider.completedDeliveries,

          earnings:
            rider.earnings,

          status:
            rider.status,

          badge:
            rider.rating >=
            4.8
              ? "Ã°Å¸Â¥â€¡ Elite"
              : rider.rating >=
                4.5
              ? "Ã°Å¸Â¥Ë† Pro"
              : rider.rating >=
                4
              ? "Ã°Å¸Â¥â€° Active"
              : "Ã¢Â­Â New",

          performance:
            rider.completedDeliveries >
            300
              ? "Excellent"
              : rider.completedDeliveries >
                150
              ? "Good"
              : "Average",
        })
      );

    const topRider =
      leaderboard[0] ||
      null;

    const highestRating =
      [...leaderboard].sort(
        (a, b) =>
          b.rating -
          a.rating
      )[0] || null;

    const highestEarning =
      [...leaderboard].sort(
        (a, b) =>
          b.earnings -
          a.earnings
      )[0] || null;

    return NextResponse.json({
      success: true,

      summary: {
        totalRiders:
          riders.length,

        topRider,

        highestRating,

        highestEarning,
      },

      leaderboard,
    });
  } catch (error) {
    console.error(
      "LEADERBOARD ERROR",
      error
    );

    return NextResponse.json(
      {
        error:
          "Failed To Load Leaderboard",
      },
      {
        status: 500,
      }
    );
  }
}

import { NextResponse } from "next/server";
import { prisma } from "@/lib/prisma";

export async function GET() {

 try {

  const products =
   await prisma.product.findMany();

  const totalProducts =
   products.length;

  const totalStock =
   products.reduce(
    (sum:any,p:any)=>
      sum + Number(p.stock || 0),
    0
   );

  return NextResponse.json({
   success:true,
   totalProducts,
   totalStock
