==================== D:\D Drive\Desktop\CRM\FreshCut-CRM-Professional-Starter\app\api\auth\staff-login\route.ts ====================

import { NextResponse } from "next/server";
import { prisma } from "@/lib/prisma";
import { setSessionCookie, verifyPassword } from "@/lib/auth";

const ALLOWED_ROLES = ["SUPER_ADMIN", "PROCESSING"] as const;
type AllowedRole = (typeof ALLOWED_ROLES)[number];

export async function POST(req: Request) {
  try {
    const body = await req.json();

    const mobile = String(body?.mobile || "").replace(/\D/g, "");
    const password = String(body?.password || "");
    const role = String(body?.role || "") as AllowedRole;

    if (!/^\d{10}$/.test(mobile)) {
      return NextResponse.json(
        {
          success: false,
          message: "Enter a valid 10-digit mobile number.",
        },
        { status: 400 }
      );
    }

    if (!ALLOWED_ROLES.includes(role)) {
      return NextResponse.json(
        {
          success: false,
          message: "Invalid staff role.",
        },
        { status: 400 }
      );
    }

    if (!password) {
      return NextResponse.json(
        {
          success: false,
          message: "Password is required.",
        },
        { status: 400 }
      );
    }

    const staff = await prisma.staffUser.findFirst({
      where: {
        mobile,
        role,
        active: true,
      },
    });

    if (!staff) {
      const count = await prisma.staffUser.count({
        where: { role },
      });

      return NextResponse.json(
        {
          success: false,
          code: count === 0 ? "NO_ACCOUNT" : "INVALID_LOGIN",
          message:
            count === 0
              ? "No account exists for this role yet. Create the first account."
              : "Invalid mobile number or password.",
        },
        { status: 401 }
      );
    }

    if (!verifyPassword(password, staff.passwordHash)) {
      return NextResponse.json(
        {
          success: false,
          message: "Invalid mobile number or password.",
        },
        { status: 401 }
      );
    }

    const response = NextResponse.json({
      success: true,
      role: staff.role,
      staff: {
        id: staff.id,
        name: staff.name,
        mobile: staff.mobile,
      },
    });

    setSessionCookie(response, {
      kind: "staff",
      id: staff.id,
      role: staff.role,
      name: staff.name,
      mobile: staff.mobile,
    });

    return response;
  } catch (error) {
    console.error("STAFF LOGIN ERROR:", error);

    return NextResponse.json(
      {
        success: false,
        message: "Login failed.",
      },
      { status: 500 }
    );
  }
}





==================== D:\D Drive\Desktop\CRM\FreshCut-CRM-Professional-Starter\app\api\auth\staff-setup\route.ts ====================

import { NextResponse } from "next/server";
import { prisma } from "@/lib/prisma";
import { hashPassword } from "@/lib/auth";

const ALLOWED_ROLES = ["SUPER_ADMIN", "PROCESSING"] as const;
type AllowedRole = (typeof ALLOWED_ROLES)[number];

export async function POST(req: Request) {
  try {
    const body = await req.json();

    const name = String(body?.name || "").trim();
    const mobile = String(body?.mobile || "").replace(/\D/g, "");
    const password = String(body?.password || "");
    const role = String(body?.role || "") as AllowedRole;

    if (!name || name.length < 2) {
      return NextResponse.json(
        {
          success: false,
          message: "Enter a valid name.",
        },
        { status: 400 }
      );
    }

    if (!/^\d{10}$/.test(mobile)) {
      return NextResponse.json(
        {
          success: false,
          message: "Enter a valid 10-digit mobile number.",
        },
        { status: 400 }
      );
    }

    if (!password || password.length < 4) {
      return NextResponse.json(
        {
          success: false,
          message: "Password must be at least 4 characters.",
        },
        { status: 400 }
      );
    }

    if (!ALLOWED_ROLES.includes(role)) {
      return NextResponse.json(
        {
          success: false,
          message: "Invalid staff role.",
        },
        { status: 400 }
      );
    }

    const roleCount = await prisma.staffUser.count({
      where: { role },
    });

    if (roleCount > 0) {
      return NextResponse.json(
        {
          success: false,
          message: "The first account for this role already exists.",
        },
        { status: 409 }
      );
    }

    const existingMobile = await prisma.staffUser.findUnique({
      where: { mobile },
    });

    if (existingMobile) {
      return NextResponse.json(
        {
          success: false,
          message: "This mobile number is already in use.",
        },
        { status: 409 }
      );
    }

    const staff = await prisma.staffUser.create({
      data: {
        name,
        mobile,
        passwordHash: hashPassword(password),
        role,
      },
    });

    return NextResponse.json({
      success: true,
      staff: {
        id: staff.id,
        name: staff.name,
        mobile: staff.mobile,
        role: staff.role,
      },
    });
  } catch (error) {
    console.error("STAFF SETUP ERROR:", error);

    return NextResponse.json(
      {
        success: false,
        message: "Unable to create account.",
      },
      { status: 500 }
    );
  }
}





==================== D:\D Drive\Desktop\CRM\FreshCut-CRM-Professional-Starter\app\api\auto-reassign-orders\route.ts ====================

import { NextResponse } from "next/server";
import { prisma } from "@/lib/prisma";

export async function GET() {
  try {
    const now = new Date();

    const expiredAssignments =
      await prisma.deliveryAssignment.findMany({
        where: {
          status: {
            in: [
              "Pending Acceptance",
              "Assigned",
            ],
          },

          pickupDeadline: {
            not: null,
            lt: now,
          },
        },

        orderBy: {
          assignedAt: "asc",
        },
      });

    const results: any[] = [];

    for (const assignment of expiredAssignments) {
      const currentRider =
        await prisma.deliveryBoy.findUnique({
          where: {
            id: assignment.deliveryBoyId,
          },
        });

      const nextRider =
        await prisma.deliveryBoy.findFirst({
          where: {
            approvalStatus:
              "Approved",

            id: {
              not:
                assignment.deliveryBoyId,
            },

            status: {
              in: [
                "Online",
                "Available",
                "Active",
              ],
            },
          },

          orderBy: {
            completedDeliveries:
              "desc",
          },
        });

      if (nextRider) {
        await prisma.deliveryAssignment.update({
          where: {
            id: assignment.id,
          },

          data: {
            deliveryBoyId:
              nextRider.id,

            status:
              "Pending Acceptance",

            assignedAt:
              new Date(),

            pickupDeadline:
              new Date(
                Date.now() +
                  180 * 1000
              ),

            autoReassigned:
              true,

            reassignedAt:
              new Date(),

            adminAlert:
              true,

            alertSent:
              true,

            reassignedCount:
              assignment.reassignedCount +
              1,
          },
        });

        if (currentRider) {
          await prisma.deliveryBoy.update({
            where: {
              id: currentRider.id,
            },

            data: {
              rating:
                currentRider.rating > 1
                  ? currentRider.rating -
                    0.2
                  : 1,
            },
          });
        }

        results.push({
          assignmentId:
            assignment.id,

          orderId:
            assignment.orderId,

          previousRider:
            currentRider?.name,

          newRider:
            nextRider.name,

          action:
            "AUTO_REASSIGNED",
        });
      } else {
        await prisma.deliveryAssignment.update({
          where: {
            id: assignment.id,
          },

          data: {
            adminAlert: true,
            alertSent: true,
          },
        });

        results.push({
          assignmentId:
            assignment.id,

          orderId:
            assignment.orderId,

          action:
            "ADMIN_ALERT_ONLY",

          message:
            "No Approved Rider Available",
        });
      }
    }

    return NextResponse.json({
      success: true,

      checked:
        expiredAssignments.length,

      processed:
        results.length,

      results,
    });
  } catch (error) {
    console.error(
      "AUTO REASSIGN ERROR",
      error
    );

    return NextResponse.json(
      {
        success: false,

        error:
          "Auto Reassign Failed",
      },
      {
        status: 500,
      }
    );
  }
}

==================== D:\D Drive\Desktop\CRM\FreshCut-CRM-Professional-Starter\app\api\create-order\route.ts ====================

import { NextResponse } from "next/server";
import { prisma } from "@/lib/prisma";

function generateOTP() {
  return Math.floor(
    1000 + Math.random() * 9000
  ).toString();
}

export async function POST(
  req: Request
) {
  try {
    const body = await req.json();

    const order =
      await prisma.order.create({
        data: {
          customer:
            body.customer ||
            "Customer",

          phone:
            body.phone || "",

          address:
            body.address || "",

          amount:
            Number(
              body.amount || 0
            ),

          latitude:
            body.latitude || null,

          longitude:
            body.longitude || null,

          status:
            "Assigned",
        },
      });

    const availableRiders =
      await prisma.deliveryBoy.findMany({
        where: {
          approvalStatus:
            "Approved",

          status: {
            in: [
              "Online",
              "Available",
              "Active"
            ]
          }
        },

        orderBy: {
          completedDeliveries:
            "asc",
        },
      });

    if (
      availableRiders.length === 0
    ) {
      return NextResponse.json(
        {
          success: false,
          error:
            "No Online Rider Available",
        },
        {
          status: 400,
        }
      );
    }

    const rider =
      availableRiders[0];

    const otp =
      generateOTP();

    const pickupDeadline =
      new Date(
        Date.now() +
          3 * 60 * 1000
      );

    const assignment =
      await prisma.deliveryAssignment.create(
        {
          data: {
            orderId:
              order.id,

            deliveryBoyId:
              rider.id,

            otp,

            status:
              "Pending Acceptance",

            assignedAt:
              new Date(),

            pickupDeadline,

            earnings:
              25,

            reassignedCount:
              0,

            autoReassigned:
              false,

            adminAlert:
              false,

            alertSent:
              false,
          },
        }
      );

    return NextResponse.json({
      success: true,
      order,
      assignment,
      rider,
      pickupDeadline,
      message:
        "Order Auto Assigned",
    });
  } catch (error) {
    console.error(
      "CREATE ORDER ERROR",
      error
    );

    return NextResponse.json(
      {
        success: false,
        error:
          "Failed To Create Order",
      },
      {
        status: 500,
      }
    );
  }
}

import { NextResponse } from "next/server";
import { prisma } from "@/lib/prisma";

export async function GET() {
  try {
    const feedback = await prisma.customerFeedback.findMany({
      orderBy: {
        id: "desc",
      },
    });

    return NextResponse.json(feedback, {
      status: 200,
    });
  } catch (error) {
    console.error(
      "GET FEEDBACK ERROR:",
      error
    );

    return NextResponse.json(
      {
        error:
          error instanceof Error
            ? error.message
            : "Failed to load feedback",
      },
      {
        status: 500,
      }
    );
  }
}

export async function POST(req: Request) {
  try {
    const body = await req.json();

    const customer = String(
      body?.name || ""
    ).trim();

    const phone = String(
      body?.phone || ""
    ).trim();

    const rating = Number(
      body?.rating
    );

    const comment = String(
      body?.review || ""
    ).trim();

    if (!customer) {
      return NextResponse.json(
        {
          error: "Name is required.",
        },
        {
          status: 400,
        }
      );
    }

    if (!phone) {
      return NextResponse.json(
        {
          error:
            "Mobile number is required.",
        },
        {
          status: 400,
        }
      );
    }

    if (
      !Number.isInteger(rating) ||
      rating < 1 ||
      rating > 5
    ) {
      return NextResponse.json(
        {
          error:
            "Rating must be between 1 and 5.",
        },
        {
          status: 400,
        }
      );
    }

    if (!comment) {
      return NextResponse.json(
        {
          error: "Review is required.",
        },
        {
          status: 400,
        }
      );
    }

    const feedback =
      await prisma.customerFeedback.create({
        data: {
          customer,
          phone,
          rating,
          comment,
        },
      });

    return NextResponse.json(
      {
        success: true,
        feedback,
      },
      {
        status: 201,
      }
    );
  } catch (error) {
    console.error(
      "CREATE FEEDBACK ERROR:",
      error
    );

    return NextResponse.json(
      {
        error:
          error instanceof Error
            ? error.message
            : "Failed to save feedback",
      },
      {
        status: 500,
      }
    );
  }
}

==================== D:\D Drive\Desktop\CRM\FreshCut-CRM-Professional-Starter\app\api\dashboard\top-customers\route.ts ====================

import { NextResponse } from "next/server";
import { prisma } from "@/lib/prisma";

export async function GET() {
  const orders =
    await prisma.order.findMany();

  const map =
    new Map<
      string,
      number
    >();

  orders.forEach(
    (item: any) => {
      const current =
        map.get(
          item.customer
        ) || 0;

      map.set(
        item.customer,
        current +
          item.amount
      );
    }
  );

  const result =
    Array.from(
      map.entries()
    )
      .map(
        ([customer, total]) => ({
          customer,
          total,
        })
      )
      .sort(
        (a, b) =>
          b.total -
          a.total
      )
      .slice(0, 10);

  return NextResponse.json(
    result
  );
}

==================== D:\D Drive\Desktop\CRM\FreshCut-CRM-Professional-Starter\app\api\delivery-accept\route.ts ====================

import { NextResponse } from "next/server";
import { prisma } from "@/lib/prisma";

export async function POST(
  req: Request
) {
  try {
    const body = await req.json();

    const assignmentId =
      Number(
        body.assignmentId
      );

    const action =
      body.action;

    if (!assignmentId) {
      return NextResponse.json(
        {
          error:
            "Assignment ID Required",
        },
        {
          status: 400,
        }
      );
    }

    const assignment =
      await prisma.deliveryAssignment.findUnique(
        {
          where: {
            id:
              assignmentId,
          },
        }
      );

    if (!assignment) {
      return NextResponse.json(
        {
          error:
            "Assignment Not Found",
        },
        {
          status: 404,
        }
      );
    }

    if (
      action ===
      "accept"
    ) {
      const updated =
        await prisma.deliveryAssignment.update(
          {
            where: {
              id:
                assignmentId,
            },
            data: {
              status:
                "Accepted",

              acceptedAt:
                new Date(),
            },
          }
        );

      await prisma.deliveryBoy.update(
        {
          where: {
            id:
              assignment.deliveryBoyId,
          },
          data: {
            status:
              "Busy",
          },
        }
      );

      return NextResponse.json({
        success: true,
        message:
          "Order Accepted",
        assignment:
          updated,
      });
    }

    if (
      action ===
      "reject"
    ) {
      const updated =
        await prisma.deliveryAssignment.update(
          {
            where: {
              id:
                assignmentId,
            },
            data: {
              status:
                "Rejected",
            },
          }
        );

      await prisma.deliveryBoy.update(
        {
          where: {
            id:
              assignment.deliveryBoyId,
          },
          data: {
            status:
              "Available",
          },
        }
      );

      return NextResponse.json({
        success: true,
        message:
          "Order Rejected",
        assignment:
          updated,
      });
    }

    return NextResponse.json(
      {
        error:
          "Invalid Action",
      },
      {
        status: 400,
      }
    );
  } catch (error) {
    console.error(
      "DELIVERY ACCEPT ERROR",
      error
    );

    return NextResponse.json(
      {
        error:
          "Failed To Process Request",
      },
      {
        status: 500,
      }
    );
  }
}



==================== D:\D Drive\Desktop\CRM\FreshCut-CRM-Professional-Starter\app\api\delivery-accept-order\route.ts ====================

import { NextResponse } from "next/server";
import { prisma } from "@/lib/prisma";

export async function POST(req: Request) {
  try {
    const body = await req.json();
    const assignmentId = Number(body?.assignmentId);

    if (!assignmentId) {
      return NextResponse.json(
        { success: false, error: "Assignment ID Required" },
        { status: 400 }
      );
    }

    const assignment = await prisma.deliveryAssignment.findUnique({
      where: { id: assignmentId },
    });

    if (!assignment) {
      return NextResponse.json(
        { success: false, error: "Assignment Not Found" },
        { status: 404 }
      );
    }

    if (assignment.status !== "Pending Acceptance") {
      return NextResponse.json(
        {
          success: false,
          error: `Order is already ${assignment.status}`,
        },
        { status: 400 }
      );
    }

    const updated = await prisma.deliveryAssignment.update({
      where: { id: assignmentId },
      data: {
        status: "Accepted",
        acceptedAt: new Date(),
        adminAlert: false,
        alertSent: false,
      },
    });

    await prisma.deliveryBoy.update({
      where: { id: assignment.deliveryBoyId },
      data: { status: "Busy" },
    });

    const order = await prisma.order.findUnique({
      where: { id: assignment.orderId },
    });

    const rider = await prisma.deliveryBoy.findUnique({
      where: { id: assignment.deliveryBoyId },
    });

    return NextResponse.json({
      success: true,
      assignmentId,
      assignment: updated,
      customerNotification: order
        ? {
            customer: order.customer,
            phone: order.phone,
            message: `Fresh2Cook: Your order is on the way. Rider ${rider?.name || ""} (${rider?.mobile || ""}) has accepted your order. Your packet left for delivery ðŸšš`,
          }
        : null,
      message: "Order Accepted Successfully",
    });
  } catch (error: any) {
    console.error("DELIVERY ACCEPT ERROR:", error);

    return NextResponse.json(
      {
        success: false,
        error: error?.message || "Failed To Accept Order",
      },
      { status: 500 }
    );
  }
}

==================== D:\D Drive\Desktop\CRM\FreshCut-CRM-Professional-Starter\app\api\delivery-assignment-status\route.ts ====================

import { NextResponse } from "next/server";
import { prisma } from "@/lib/prisma";

const ALLOWED_STATUSES = [
  "Pending Acceptance",
  "Accepted",
  "Picked Up",
  "Out For Delivery",
  "Otp Sent",
  "Delivered",
  "Rejected",
];

export async function POST(req: Request) {
  try {
    const body = await req.json();

    const assignmentId = Number(body?.assignmentId);
    const status = String(body?.status || "").trim();

    if (!assignmentId || !status) {
      return NextResponse.json(
        {
          success: false,
          error: "Assignment ID and Status Required",
        },
        { status: 400 }
      );
    }

    if (!ALLOWED_STATUSES.includes(status)) {
      return NextResponse.json(
        {
          success: false,
          error: "Invalid Delivery Status",
        },
        { status: 400 }
      );
    }

    const assignment = await prisma.deliveryAssignment.findUnique({
      where: { id: assignmentId },
    });

    if (!assignment) {
      return NextResponse.json(
        { success: false, error: "Assignment Not Found" },
        { status: 404 }
      );
    }

    const data: any = { status };

    if (status === "Accepted") {
      data.acceptedAt = new Date();
    }

    if (status === "Picked Up") {
      data.pickedAt = new Date();
    }

    if (status === "Delivered") {
      data.deliveredAt = new Date();
      data.earnings = 25;
    }

    const updated = await prisma.deliveryAssignment.update({
      where: { id: assignmentId },
      data,
    });

    if (status === "Delivered") {
      await prisma.order.update({
        where: { id: assignment.orderId },
        data: {
          status: "Delivered",
          deliveryOtp: null,
        },
      });

      await prisma.deliveryBoy.update({
        where: { id: assignment.deliveryBoyId },
        data: {
          status: "Available",
          completedDeliveries: { increment: 1 },
          earnings: { increment: 25 },
        },
      });
    }

    return NextResponse.json({
      success: true,
      assignment: updated,
    });
  } catch (error: any) {
    console.error("ASSIGNMENT STATUS ERROR:", error);

    return NextResponse.json(
      {
        success: false,
        error: error?.message || "Failed To Update Status",
      },
      { status: 500 }
    );
  }
}

import { NextResponse } from "next/server";
import { prisma } from "@/lib/prisma";

function generateOtp() {
  return Math.floor(
    1000 + Math.random() * 9000
  ).toString();
}

export async function POST(
  req: Request
) {
  try {
    const body =
      await req.json();

    const orderId = Number(
      body.orderId
    );

    const riderId = Number(
      body.riderId
    );

    if (
      !orderId ||
      !riderId
    ) {
      return NextResponse.json(
        {
          success: false,
          error:
            "Order and Rider required",
        },
        { status: 400 }
      );
    }

    const otp =
      generateOtp();

    const assignment =
      await prisma.deliveryAssignment.create({
        data: {
          orderId,
          deliveryBoyId:
            riderId,
          otp,
          status:
            "Pending Acceptance",
        },
      });

    await prisma.order.update({
      where: {
        id: orderId,
      },
      data: {
        deliveryOtp:
          otp,
        status:
          "Assigned To Rider",
      },
    });

    return NextResponse.json({
      success: true,
      assignment,
    });
  } catch (error: any) {
    console.error(error);

    return NextResponse.json(
      {
        success: false,
        error:
          error?.message ||
          "Assignment failed",
      },
      { status: 500 }
    );
  }
}

==================== D:\D Drive\Desktop\CRM\FreshCut-CRM-Professional-Starter\app\api\delivery-assignments\route.ts ====================

import { NextResponse } from "next/server";
import { prisma } from "@/lib/prisma";

export async function GET() {
  try {
    const assignments =
      await prisma.deliveryAssignment.findMany({
        orderBy: {
          id: "desc",
        },
      });

    const orderIds = [
      ...new Set(
        assignments.map(
          (item) => item.orderId
        )
      ),
    ];

    const riderIds = [
      ...new Set(
        assignments.map(
          (item) => item.deliveryBoyId
        )
      ),
    ];

    const orders =
      orderIds.length > 0
        ? await prisma.order.findMany({
            where: {
              id: {
                in: orderIds,
              },
            },
            select: {
              id: true,
              customer: true,
              phone: true,
              address: true,
              amount: true,
              status: true,
              createdAt: true,
              deliveryOtp: true,
            },
          })
        : [];

    const riders =
      riderIds.length > 0
        ? await prisma.deliveryBoy.findMany({
            where: {
              id: {
                in: riderIds,
              },
            },
            select: {
              id: true,
              name: true,
              mobile: true,
              vehicle: true,
              status: true,
            },
          })
        : [];

    const orderMap = new Map(
      orders.map((order) => [
        order.id,
        order,
      ])
    );

    const riderMap = new Map(
      riders.map((rider) => [
        rider.id,
        rider,
      ])
    );

    const cleaned = assignments.map(
      (assignment) => {
        const order =
          orderMap.get(
            assignment.orderId
          );

        const rider =
          riderMap.get(
            assignment.deliveryBoyId
          );

        return {
          ...assignment,

          otp:
            assignment.status ===
            "Otp Sent"
              ? assignment.otp
              : null,

          order: order
            ? {
                id: order.id,
                customer:
                  order.customer,
                phone:
                  order.phone,
                address:
                  order.address,
                amount:
                  order.amount,
                status:
                  order.status,
                createdAt:
                  order.createdAt,
                deliveryOtp:
                  assignment.status ===
                  "Otp Sent"
                    ? order.deliveryOtp
                    : null,
              }
            : null,

          deliveryBoy: rider
            ? {
                id: rider.id,
                name: rider.name,
                mobile:
                  rider.mobile,
                vehicle:
                  rider.vehicle,
                status:
                  rider.status,
              }
            : null,
        };
      }
    );

    return NextResponse.json({
      success: true,
      assignments: cleaned,
    });
  } catch (error) {
    console.error(
      "DELIVERY ASSIGNMENTS ERROR:",
      error
    );

    return NextResponse.json(
      {
        success: false,
        error:
          error instanceof Error
            ? error.message
            : "Failed To Load Assignments",
      },
      {
        status: 500,
      }
    );
  }
}



==================== D:\D Drive\Desktop\CRM\FreshCut-CRM-Professional-Starter\app\api\delivery-auto-assign\route.ts ====================

import { NextResponse } from "next/server";
import { prisma } from "@/lib/prisma";

export async function POST() {
  try {
    const limitTime = new Date(
      Date.now() - 3 * 60 * 1000
    );

    const expiredAssignments =
      await prisma.deliveryAssignment.findMany({
        where: {
          status: "Pending Acceptance",
          assignedAt: {
            lte: limitTime,
          },
        },
      });

    let reassigned = 0;

    for (const assignment of expiredAssignments) {
      const currentRiderId =
        assignment.deliveryBoyId;

      const nextRider =
        await prisma.deliveryBoy.findFirst({
          where: {
            status: "Available",
            id: {
              not: currentRiderId,
            },
          },
          orderBy: {
            rating: "desc",
          },
        });

      if (!nextRider) continue;

      await prisma.deliveryAssignment.update({
        where: {
          id: assignment.id,
        },
        data: {
          deliveryBoyId:
            nextRider.id,

          assignedAt:
            new Date(),

          reassignedCount:
            assignment.reassignedCount + 1,

          autoReassigned: true,

          reassignedAt:
            new Date(),
        },
      });

      reassigned++;
    }

    return NextResponse.json({
      success: true,
      reassigned,
    });
  } catch (error) {
    console.error(
      "AUTO REASSIGN ERROR",
      error
    );

    return NextResponse.json(
      {
        error:
          "Auto Reassign Failed",
      },
      {
        status: 500,
      }
    );
  }
}

import { NextResponse } from "next/server";
import { prisma } from "@/lib/prisma";

export async function GET() {
  try {
    const riders =
      await prisma.deliveryBoy.count();

    const orders =
      await prisma.deliveryAssignment.count();

    const delivered =
      await prisma.deliveryAssignment.count({
        where: {
          status:
            "Delivered",
        },
      });

    const revenue =
      delivered * 40;

    const deliveryRate =
      orders > 0
        ? Number(
            (
              (delivered /
                orders) *
              100
            ).toFixed(2)
          )
        : 0;

    return NextResponse.json({
      success: true,
      riders,
      orders,
      delivered,
      revenue,
      deliveryRate,
      generatedAt:
        new Date(),
    });
  } catch {
    return NextResponse.json(
      {
        error:
          "Board Dashboard Failed",
      },
      {
        status: 500,
      }
    );
  }
}

          "Failed To Load Riders",
      },
      { status: 500 }
    );
  }

export async function POST(req: Request) {
  try {
    const body = await req.json();

    const name = String(body.name || "").trim();
    const mobile = String(body.mobile || "").trim();
    const vehicle = String(body.vehicle || "").trim();

    if (!name || !mobile || !vehicle) {
      return NextResponse.json(
        {
          success: false,
          error: "Name, mobile and vehicle are required",
        },
        { status: 400 }
      );
    }

    const existing = await prisma.deliveryBoy.findUnique({
      where: {
        mobile,
      },
    });

    if (existing) {
      return NextResponse.json(
        {
          success: false,
          error: "This mobile number is already registered",
        },
        { status: 409 }
      );
    }

    const rider = await prisma.deliveryBoy.create({
      data: {
        name,
        mobile,
        vehicle,
        status: "Available",
        approvalStatus: "Approved",
      },
    });

    return NextResponse.json({
      success: true,
      rider,
    });
  } catch (error: any) {
    console.error("CREATE RIDER ERROR:", error);

    return NextResponse.json(
      {
        success: false,
        error:
          error?.message ||
          "Failed To Create Delivery Boy",
      },
      { status: 500 }
    );
  }
}

==================== D:\D Drive\Desktop\CRM\FreshCut-CRM-Professional-Starter\app\api\delivery-change-password\route.ts ====================

import { NextResponse } from "next/server";
import { prisma } from "@/lib/prisma";

export async function POST(
  req: Request
) {
  try {
    const body = await req.json();

    const riderId = Number(
      body.riderId
    );

    const oldPassword =
      body.oldPassword;

    const newPassword =
      body.newPassword;

    if (
      !riderId ||
      !oldPassword ||
      !newPassword
    ) {
      return NextResponse.json(
        {
          error:
            "All fields are required",
        },
        {
          status: 400,
        }
      );
    }

    const rider =
      await prisma.deliveryBoy.findUnique(
        {
          where: {
            id: riderId,
          },
        }
      );

    if (!rider) {
      return NextResponse.json(
        {
          error:
            "Rider not found",
        },
        {
          status: 404,
        }
      );
    }

    if (
      rider.password !==
      oldPassword
    ) {
      return NextResponse.json(
        {
          error:
            "Current password is incorrect",
        },
        {
          status: 400,
        }
      );
    }

    await prisma.deliveryBoy.update(
      {
        where: {
          id: riderId,
        },
        data: {
          password:
            newPassword,
        },
      }
    );

    return NextResponse.json({
      success: true,
      message:
        "Password changed successfully",
    });
  } catch (error) {
    console.error(
      "CHANGE PASSWORD ERROR:",
      error
    );

    return NextResponse.json(
      {
        error:
          "Failed to change password",
      },
      {
        status: 500,
      }
    );
  }
}

==================== D:\D Drive\Desktop\CRM\FreshCut-CRM-Professional-Starter\app\api\delivery-complete\route.ts ====================

import { NextResponse } from "next/server";
import { prisma } from "@/lib/prisma";

export async function POST(req: Request) {
  try {
    const body = await req.json();

    const assignmentId = Number(body?.assignmentId);
    const otp = String(body?.otp || "").trim();

    if (!assignmentId || !otp) {
      return NextResponse.json(
        {
          success: false,
          error: "Assignment ID And OTP Required",
        },
        { status: 400 }
      );
    }

    const assignment = await prisma.deliveryAssignment.findUnique({
      where: { id: assignmentId },
    });

    if (!assignment) {
      return NextResponse.json(
        { success: false, error: "Assignment Not Found" },
        { status: 404 }
      );
    }

    if (assignment.status !== "Otp Sent") {
      return NextResponse.json(
        {
          success: false,
          error: "Delivery OTP is not active",
        },
        { status: 400 }
      );
    }

    if (assignment.otp !== otp) {
      return NextResponse.json(
        { success: false, error: "Invalid OTP" },
        { status: 400 }
      );
    }

    await prisma.deliveryAssignment.update({
      where: { id: assignmentId },
      data: {
        status: "Delivered",
        deliveredAt: new Date(),
        earnings: 25,
      },
    });

    await prisma.order.update({
      where: { id: assignment.orderId },
      data: {
        status: "Delivered",
        deliveryOtp: null,
      },
    });

    await prisma.deliveryBoy.update({
      where: { id: assignment.deliveryBoyId },
      data: {
        completedDeliveries: { increment: 1 },
        earnings: { increment: 25 },
        status: "Available",
      },
    });

    return NextResponse.json({
      success: true,
      earning: 25,
      message: "Delivery Completed Successfully",
    });
  } catch (error: any) {
    console.error("DELIVERY COMPLETE ERROR:", error);

    return NextResponse.json(
      {
        success: false,
        error: error?.message || "Delivery Failed",
      },
      { status: 500 }
    );
  }
}



==================== D:\D Drive\Desktop\CRM\FreshCut-CRM-Professional-Starter\app\api\delivery-control\route.ts ====================

import { NextResponse } from "next/server";
import { prisma } from "@/lib/prisma";

export async function GET() {
  try {
    const riders =
      await prisma.deliveryBoy.findMany({
        orderBy: {
          completedDeliveries: "desc",
        },
      });

    const assignments =
      await prisma.deliveryAssignment.findMany({
        orderBy: {
          assignedAt: "desc",
        },
      });

    return NextResponse.json({
      success: true,
      riders,
      assignments,
    });
  } catch (error) {
    console.error(
      "DELIVERY CONTROL GET ERROR:",
      error
    );

    return NextResponse.json(
      {
        success: false,
        error: "Failed To Load Delivery Data",
      },
      {
        status: 500,
      }
    );
  }
}

export async function POST(req: Request) {
  try {
    const body = await req.json();

    const orderId = Number(body?.orderId);
    const zoneId =
      body?.zoneId !== undefined &&
      body?.zoneId !== null &&
      body?.zoneId !== ""
        ? Number(body.zoneId)
        : null;

    if (!Number.isInteger(orderId) || orderId <= 0) {
      return NextResponse.json(
        {
          success: false,
          error: "Valid Order ID required",
        },
        {
          status: 400,
        }
      );
    }

    const existingAssignment =
      await prisma.deliveryAssignment.findFirst({
        where: {
          orderId,
        },
      });

    if (existingAssignment) {
      return NextResponse.json(
        {
          success: false,
          error: "Order Already Assigned",
        },
        {
          status: 409,
        }
      );
    }

    const availableRiders =
      await prisma.deliveryBoy.findMany({
        where: {
          approvalStatus: "Approved",
          status: {
            in: ["Online", "Available"],
          },
        },
        orderBy: [
          {
            completedDeliveries: "asc",
          },
          {
            rating: "desc",
          },
        ],
      });

    if (availableRiders.length === 0) {
      return NextResponse.json(
        {
          success: false,
          error: "No Online Rider Available",
        },
        {
          status: 400,
        }
      );
    }

    const selectedRider =
      availableRiders[0];

    const assignment =
      await prisma.deliveryAssignment.create({
        data: {
          orderId,
          deliveryBoyId:
            selectedRider.id,

          ...(zoneId !== null
            ? { zoneId }
            : {}),

          /*
           * OTP intentionally remains empty.
           * It will be generated only when
           * the rider starts the delivery OTP flow.
           */
          otp: "",

          status:
            "Pending Acceptance",

          assignedAt:
            new Date(),

          earnings: 25,
        },
      });

    await prisma.order.update({
      where: {
        id: orderId,
      },
      data: {
        status:
          "Assigned To Rider",

        deliveryOtp: null,
      },
    });

    return NextResponse.json({
      success: true,
      rider: {
        id: selectedRider.id,
        name: selectedRider.name,
        mobile: selectedRider.mobile,
        vehicle: selectedRider.vehicle,
      },
      assignment,
    });
  } catch (error) {
    console.error(
      "AUTO ASSIGN ERROR:",
      error
    );

    return NextResponse.json(
      {
        success: false,
        error:
          error instanceof Error
            ? error.message
            : "Assignment Failed",
      },
      {
        status: 500,
      }
    );
  }
}

import { NextResponse } from "next/server";

export async function GET() {
  return NextResponse.json({
    success: true,
    module: "Delivery Demand Engine",
    timestamp: new Date().toISOString(),

==================== D:\D Drive\Desktop\CRM\FreshCut-CRM-Professional-Starter\app\api\delivery-forgot-password\route.ts ====================

import { NextResponse } from "next/server";
import { prisma } from "@/lib/prisma";

export async function POST(
  req: Request
) {
  try {
    const body = await req.json();

    const mobile =
      body.mobile?.trim();

    const newPassword =
      body.newPassword?.trim();

    if (
      !mobile ||
      !newPassword
    ) {
      return NextResponse.json(
        {
          error:
            "Mobile and New Password are required",
        },
        {
          status: 400,
        }
      );
    }

    const rider =
      await prisma.deliveryBoy.findFirst(
        {
          where: {
            mobile,
          },
        }
      );

    if (!rider) {
      return NextResponse.json(
        {
          error:
            "Delivery Partner not found",
        },
        {
          status: 404,
        }
      );
    }

    await prisma.deliveryBoy.update(
      {
        where: {
          id: rider.id,
        },
        data: {
          password:
            newPassword,
        },
      }
    );

    return NextResponse.json({
      success: true,
      message:
        "Password Reset Successfully",
    });
  } catch (error) {
    console.error(
      "DELIVERY FORGOT PASSWORD ERROR:",
      error
    );

    return NextResponse.json(
      {
        error:
          "Failed to Reset Password",
      },
      {
        status: 500,
      }
    );
  }
}

==================== D:\D Drive\Desktop\CRM\FreshCut-CRM-Professional-Starter\app\api\delivery-infinity-dashboard\route.ts ====================

import { NextResponse } from "next/server";
import { prisma } from "@/lib/prisma";

export async function GET() {
  try {
    const totalOrders =
      await prisma.deliveryAssignment.count();

    const deliveredOrders =
      await prisma.deliveryAssignment.count({
        where: {
          status: "Delivered",
        },
      });

    const riders =
      await prisma.deliveryBoy.count();

    const infinityScore =
      totalOrders > 0
        ? Number(
            (
              (deliveredOrders /
                totalOrders) *
              100
            ).toFixed(2)
          )
        : 0;

    return NextResponse.json({
      success: true,
      totalOrders,
      deliveredOrders,
      riders,
      infinityScore,
      generatedAt:
        new Date(),
    });
  } catch {
    return NextResponse.json(
      {
        error:
          "Infinity Dashboard Failed",
      },
      {
        status: 500,
      }
    );
  }
}

==================== D:\D Drive\Desktop\CRM\FreshCut-CRM-Professional-Starter\app\api\delivery-live-status\route.ts ====================

import { NextResponse } from "next/server";
import { prisma } from "@/lib/prisma";

export async function GET() {
  try {
    const riders =
      await prisma.deliveryBoy.findMany({
        orderBy: {
          createdAt: "desc",
        },
      });

    const enrichedRiders =
      await Promise.all(
        riders.map(async (rider) => {
          const pendingOrders =
            await prisma.deliveryAssignment.count({
              where: {
                deliveryBoyId: rider.id,
                status: {
                  in: [
                    "Pending Acceptance",
                    "Assigned",
                  ],
                },
              },
            });

          const activeOrders =
            await prisma.deliveryAssignment.count({
              where: {
                deliveryBoyId: rider.id,
                status: {
                  in: [
                    "Accepted",
                    "Picked Up",
                  ],
                },
              },
            });

          const reassignments =
            await prisma.deliveryAssignment.count({
              where: {
                deliveryBoyId: rider.id,
                autoReassigned: true,
              },
            });

          return {
            ...rider,
            pendingOrders,
            activeOrders,
            reassignments,
          };
        })
      );

    const adminAlerts =
      await prisma.deliveryAssignment.findMany({
        where: {
          adminAlert: true,
        },
        orderBy: {
          assignedAt: "desc",
        },
        take: 10,
      });

    return NextResponse.json({
      riders: enrichedRiders,
      alerts: adminAlerts,
      onlineRiders:
        enrichedRiders.filter(
          (r) =>
            r.status === "Online" ||
            r.status === "Available"
        ).length,
    });
  } catch (error) {
    console.error(
      "LIVE STATUS ERROR",
      error
    );

    return NextResponse.json(
      {
        error:
          "Failed To Load Riders",
      },
      {
        status: 500,
      }
    );
  }
}

==================== D:\D Drive\Desktop\CRM\FreshCut-CRM-Professional-Starter\app\api\delivery-location\route.ts ====================

import { NextResponse } from "next/server";
import { prisma } from "@/lib/prisma";

export async function POST(
  req: Request
) {
  try {
    const body = await req.json();

    const riderId = Number(
      body.riderId
    );

    if (!riderId) {
      return NextResponse.json(
        {
          error:
            "Rider ID Required",
        },
        {
          status: 400,
        }
      );
    }

    const rider =
      await prisma.deliveryBoy.findUnique(
        {
          where: {
            id: riderId,
          },
        }
      );

    if (!rider) {
      return NextResponse.json(
        {
          error:
            "Rider Not Found",
        },
        {
          status: 404,
        }
      );
    }

    await prisma.deliveryBoy.update(
      {
        where: {
          id: riderId,
        },

        data: {
          latitude:
            Number(
              body.latitude || 0
            ),

          longitude:
            Number(
              body.longitude || 0
            ),

          speed:
            Number(
              body.speed || 0
            ),

          lastSeen:
            new Date(),

          status:
            "Online",
        },
      }
    );

    return NextResponse.json({
      success: true,
      message:
        "Location Updated",
    });
  } catch (error) {
    console.error(
      "LOCATION UPDATE ERROR:",
      error
    );

    return NextResponse.json(
      {
        error:
          "Failed To Update Location",
      },
      {
        status: 500,
      }
    );
  }
}

export async function GET() {
  try {
    const riders =
      await prisma.deliveryBoy.findMany(
        {
          select: {
            id: true,
            name: true,
            mobile: true,
            vehicle: true,
            status: true,
            latitude: true,
            longitude: true,
            speed: true,
            lastSeen: true,
            rating: true,
            completedDeliveries: true,
          },
        }
      );

    return NextResponse.json(
      riders
    );
  } catch (error) {
    console.error(
      "GET LOCATION ERROR:",
      error
    );

    return NextResponse.json(
      {
        error:
          "Failed To Load Locations",
      },
      {
        status: 500,
      }
    );
  }
}

==================== D:\D Drive\Desktop\CRM\FreshCut-CRM-Professional-Starter\app\api\delivery-login\route.ts ====================

import { NextResponse } from "next/server";
import { prisma } from "@/lib/prisma";

export async function POST(
  req: Request
) {
  try {
    const body =
      await req.json();

    const rider =
      await prisma.deliveryBoy.findFirst({
        where: {
          mobile:
            body.mobile,
        },
      });

    if (!rider) {
      return NextResponse.json(
        {
          success: false,
          message:
            "Mobile number not found",
        },
        {
          status: 404,
        }
      );
    }

    if (
      rider.approvalStatus !==
      "Approved"
    ) {
      return NextResponse.json(
        {
          success: false,
          message:
            "Your account is pending admin approval",
        },
        {
          status: 403,
        }
      );
    }

    if (
      rider.password !==
      body.password
    ) {
      return NextResponse.json(
        {
          success: false,
          message:
            "Invalid password",
        },
        {
          status: 401,
        }
      );
    }

    await prisma.deliveryBoy.update({
      where: {
        id: rider.id,
      },
      data: {
        status: "Online",
        lastSeen:
          new Date(),
      },
    });

    return NextResponse.json({
      success: true,
      rider: {
        id: rider.id,
        name: rider.name,
        mobile:
          rider.mobile,
        vehicle:
          rider.vehicle,
        photo:
          rider.photo,
        rating:
          rider.rating,
        completedDeliveries:
          rider.completedDeliveries,
        earnings:
          rider.earnings,
      },
    });
  } catch (error) {
    console.error(
      "DELIVERY LOGIN ERROR",
      error
    );

    return NextResponse.json(
      {
        success: false,
        message:
          "Login failed",
      },
      {
        status: 500,
      }
    );
  }
}

import { NextResponse } from "next/server";
import { prisma } from "@/lib/prisma";

export async function GET() {
  try {
    const totalOrders =
      await prisma.deliveryAssignment.count();

    const deliveredOrders =
      await prisma.deliveryAssignment.count({
        where: {
          status: "Delivered",
        },
      });

    const pendingOrders =
      totalOrders -
      deliveredOrders;

    const neuralScore =
      totalOrders > 0
        ? Number(
            (
              (deliveredOrders /
                totalOrders) *
              100
            ).toFixed(2)
          )
        : 0;

    return NextResponse.json({
      success: true,
      totalOrders,
      deliveredOrders,
      pendingOrders,
      neuralScore,
      engineStatus:
        neuralScore >= 90
          ? "Excellent"
          : neuralScore >= 75
          ? "Good"
          : "Needs Attention",
    });
  } catch {
    return NextResponse.json(
      {
        error:
          "Neural Engine Failed",
      },
      {
        status: 500,
      }
    );
  }
}

==================== D:\D Drive\Desktop\CRM\FreshCut-CRM-Professional-Starter\app\api\delivery-otp\route.ts ====================

import { NextResponse } from "next/server";
import { prisma } from "@/lib/prisma";

function generateOTP() {
  return Math.floor(1000 + Math.random() * 9000).toString();
}

export async function POST(req: Request) {
  try {
    const body = await req.json();

    const orderId = Number(body?.orderId);
    const assignmentId = body?.assignmentId
      ? Number(body.assignmentId)
      : null;

    const assignment = assignmentId
      ? await prisma.deliveryAssignment.findUnique({
          where: { id: assignmentId },
        })
      : await prisma.deliveryAssignment.findFirst({
          where: { orderId },
        });

    if (!assignment) {
      return NextResponse.json(
        { success: false, error: "Assignment Not Found" },
        { status: 404 }
      );
    }

    if (!["Picked Up", "Out For Delivery", "Otp Sent"].includes(assignment.status)) {
      return NextResponse.json(
        {
          success: false,
          error: "OTP can be generated only when rider is delivering",
        },
        { status: 400 }
      );
    }

    const otp = generateOTP();

    await prisma.deliveryAssignment.update({
      where: { id: assignment.id },
      data: {
        otp,
        status: "Otp Sent",
      },
    });

    await prisma.order.update({
      where: { id: assignment.orderId },
      data: {
        deliveryOtp: otp,
        status: "Out For Delivery",
      },
    });

    const order = await prisma.order.findUnique({
      where: { id: assignment.orderId },
    });

    return NextResponse.json({
      success: true,
      customer: order?.customer || "",
      phone: order?.phone || "",
      message: "New OTP generated for customer",
      customerNotification: {
        customer: order?.customer || "",
        phone: order?.phone || "",
        message: `Fresh2Cook Delivery OTP: ${otp}. Please share this OTP with the rider after receiving your order.`,
      },
    });
  } catch (error: any) {
    console.error("DELIVERY OTP ERROR:", error);

    return NextResponse.json(
      {
        success: false,
        error: error?.message || "Failed To Generate OTP",
      },
      { status: 500 }
    );
  }
}

export async function PUT(req: Request) {
  try {
    const body = await req.json();

    const orderId = Number(body?.orderId);
    const otp = String(body?.otp || "").trim();

    if (!orderId || !otp) {
      return NextResponse.json(
        {
          success: false,
          error: "Order ID And OTP Required",
        },
        { status: 400 }
      );
    }

    const assignment = await prisma.deliveryAssignment.findFirst({
      where: { orderId },
    });

    if (!assignment || assignment.otp !== otp) {
      return NextResponse.json(
        {
          success: false,
          error: "Invalid OTP",
        },
        { status: 400 }
      );
    }

    return NextResponse.json({
      success: true,
      message: "OTP Verified Successfully",
    });
  } catch (error: any) {
    console.error("OTP VERIFY ERROR:", error);

    return NextResponse.json(
      {
        success: false,
        error: error?.message || "OTP Verification Failed",
      },
      { status: 500 }
    );
  }
}



==================== D:\D Drive\Desktop\CRM\FreshCut-CRM-Professional-Starter\app\api\delivery-overdue-alert\route.ts ====================

import { NextResponse } from "next/server";
import { prisma } from "@/lib/prisma";

export async function POST() {
  try {
    const twoHoursAgo =
      new Date(
        Date.now() -
          2 * 60 * 60 * 1000
      );

    const overdueOrders =
      await prisma.deliveryAssignment.findMany(
        {
          where: {
            status: {
              in: [
                "Assigned",
                "Accepted",
                "Out For Delivery",
              ],
            },

            assignedAt: {
              lte:
                twoHoursAgo,
            },
          },
        }
      );

    let alertCount = 0;

    for (const order of overdueOrders) {
      const rider =
        await prisma.deliveryBoy.findUnique(
          {
            where: {
              id:
                order.deliveryBoyId,
            },
          }
        );

      if (!rider) continue;

      const currentRating =
        Number(
          rider.rating || 5
        );

      const newRating =
        Math.max(
          1,
          currentRating -
            0.2
        );

      await prisma.deliveryBoy.update(
        {
          where: {
            id:
              rider.id,
          },

          data: {
            rating:
              Number(
                newRating.toFixed(
                  1
                )
              ),
          },
        }
      );

      await prisma.notification.create(
        {
          data: {
            title:
              "Late Delivery Alert",

            message: `Order #${order.orderId} delayed more than 2 hours. Rider: ${rider.name}`,

            read: false,
          },
        }
      );

      alertCount++;
    }

    return NextResponse.json({
      success: true,
      overdueOrders:
        overdueOrders.length,
      alertsCreated:
        alertCount,
      message: `${alertCount} overdue delivery alerts created`,
    });
  } catch (error) {
    console.error(
      "OVERDUE ALERT ERROR:",
      error
    );

    return NextResponse.json(
      {
        error:
          "Failed To Check Overdue Deliveries",
      },
      {
        status: 500,
      }
    );
  }
}

==================== D:\D Drive\Desktop\CRM\FreshCut-CRM-Professional-Starter\app\api\delivery-rating\route.ts ====================

import { NextResponse } from "next/server";
import { prisma } from "@/lib/prisma";

export async function POST(
  req: Request
) {
  try {
    const body =
      await req.json();

    const riderId =
      Number(
        body.riderId
      );

    const rating =
      Number(
        body.rating
      );

    if (
      !riderId ||
      !rating
    ) {
      return NextResponse.json(
        {
          error:
            "Rider ID And Rating Required",
        },
        {
          status: 400,
        }
      );
    }

    const rider =
      await prisma.deliveryBoy.findUnique({
        where: {
          id: riderId,
        },
      });

    if (!rider) {
      return NextResponse.json(
        {
          error:
            "Rider Not Found",
        },
        {
          status: 404,
        }
      );
    }

    const currentCompleted =
      rider.completedDeliveries ||
      0;

    const currentRating =
      Number(
        rider.rating || 5
      );

    const newRating =
      (
        (currentRating *
          currentCompleted +
          rating) /
        (currentCompleted + 1)
      ).toFixed(2);

    const updatedRider =
      await prisma.deliveryBoy.update({
        where: {
          id: riderId,
        },
        data: {
          rating:
            Number(
              newRating
            ),
        },
      });

    return NextResponse.json({
      success: true,
      rider:
        updatedRider,
      rating:
        updatedRider.rating,
    });
  } catch (error) {
    console.error(
      "DELIVERY RATING ERROR:",
      error
    );

    return NextResponse.json(
      {
        error:
          "Failed To Save Rating",
      },
      {
        status: 500,
      }
    );
  }
}

export async function GET() {
  try {
    const riders =
      await prisma.deliveryBoy.findMany({
        orderBy: {
          rating: "desc",
        },
      });

    return NextResponse.json(
      riders
    );
  } catch (error) {
    console.error(
      "GET RATINGS ERROR:",
      error
    );

    return NextResponse.json(
      {
        error:
          "Failed To Load Ratings",
      },
      {
        status: 500,
      }
    );
  }
}

==================== D:\D Drive\Desktop\CRM\FreshCut-CRM-Professional-Starter\app\api\delivery-reassign\route.ts ====================

import { NextResponse } from "next/server";
import { prisma } from "@/lib/prisma";

export async function POST() {
  try {
    const threeMinutesAgo =
      new Date(
        Date.now() -
          3 * 60 * 1000
      );

    const pendingAssignments =
      await prisma.deliveryAssignment.findMany(
        {
          where: {
            status:
              "Assigned",

            assignedAt: {
              lte:
                threeMinutesAgo,
            },
          },
        }
      );

    let reassignedCount = 0;

    for (const assignment of pendingAssignments) {
      const currentRider =
        assignment.deliveryBoyId;

      const riders =
        await prisma.deliveryBoy.findMany(
          {
            where: {
              status:
                "Online",
            },
          }
        );

      const availableRiders =
        riders.filter(
          (rider) =>
            rider.id !==
            currentRider
        );

      if (
        availableRiders.length ===
        0
      ) {
        continue;
      }

      const riderLoads =
        await Promise.all(
          availableRiders.map(
            async (rider) => {
              const activeOrders =
                await prisma.deliveryAssignment.count(
                  {
                    where: {
                      deliveryBoyId:
                        rider.id,
                      status: {
                        in: [
                          "Assigned",
                          "Accepted",
                        ],
                      },
                    },
                  }
                );

              return {
                rider,
                activeOrders,
              };
            }
          )
        );

      riderLoads.sort(
        (a, b) =>
          a.activeOrders -
          b.activeOrders
      );

      const nextRider =
        riderLoads[0]?.rider;

      if (!nextRider)
        continue;

      await prisma.deliveryAssignment.update(
        {
          where: {
            id:
              assignment.id,
          },

          data: {
            deliveryBoyId:
              nextRider.id,

            assignedAt:
              new Date(),

            status:
              "Assigned",
          },
        }
      );

      reassignedCount++;
    }

    return NextResponse.json({
      success: true,
      reassignedCount,
      message: `${reassignedCount} orders reassigned successfully`,
    });
  } catch (error) {
    console.error(
      "REASSIGN ERROR:",
      error
    );

    return NextResponse.json(
      {
        error:
          "Failed To Reassign Orders",
      },
      {
        status: 500,
      }
    );
  }
}

import { NextResponse } from "next/server";

          licenseFile:
            body.licenseFile,

          rcFile:
            body.rcFile,

          approvalStatus:
            "Pending",

          status:
            "Offline",
        },
      });

    return NextResponse.json({
      success: true,
      message:
        "Registration Submitted Successfully. Waiting For Admin Approval.",
      rider,
    });
  } catch (error) {
    console.error(
      "DELIVERY REGISTER ERROR",
      error
    );

    return NextResponse.json(
      {
        success: false,
        message:
          "Registration Failed",
      },
      {
        status: 500,
      }
    );
  }
}

import { NextResponse } from "next/server";
import { prisma } from "@/lib/prisma";

export async function GET(
  req: Request
) {
  try {
    const { searchParams } =
      new URL(req.url);

    const riderId = Number(
      searchParams.get(
        "riderId"
      )
    );

    if (!riderId) {
      return NextResponse.json(
        {
          success: false,
          error:
            "Rider ID Required",
        },
        {
          status: 400,
        }
      );
    }

    const rider =
      await prisma.deliveryBoy.findUnique(
        {
          where: {
            id: riderId,
          },
        }
      );

    if (!rider) {
      return NextResponse.json(
        {
          success: false,
          error:
            "Rider Not Found",
        },
        {
          status: 404,
        }
      );
    }

    const assignments =
      await prisma.deliveryAssignment.findMany(
        {
          where: {
            deliveryBoyId:
              riderId,
          },
          orderBy: {
            assignedAt:
              "desc",
          },
        }
      );

    const orders =
      await Promise.all(
        assignments.map(
          async (
            assignment
          ) => {
            const order =
              await prisma.order.findUnique(
                {
                  where: {
                    id:
                      assignment.orderId,
                  },
                }
              );

            return {
              assignmentId:
                assignment.id,

              orderId:
                assignment.orderId,

              otp:
                assignment.otp,

              status:
                assignment.status,

              assignedAt:
                assignment.assignedAt,

              acceptedAt:
                assignment.acceptedAt,

              pickedAt:
                assignment.pickedAt,

              deliveredAt:
                assignment.deliveredAt,

              pickupDeadline:
                assignment.pickupDeadline,

              deliveryDeadline:
                assignment.deliveryDeadline,

              earnings:
                assignment.earnings,

              lateDelivery:
                assignment.lateDelivery,

              customerRating:
                assignment.customerRating,

              customer:
                order?.customer ||
                "",

              phone:
                order?.phone ||
                "",

              address:
                order?.address ||
                "",

              amount:
                order?.amount ||
                0,

              latitude:
                order?.latitude,

              longitude:
                order?.longitude,

              orderStatus:
                order?.status ||
                "",
            };
          }
        )
      );

    const pending =
      orders.filter(
        (o) =>
          o.status ===
          "Pending Acceptance"
      ).length;

    const accepted =
      orders.filter(
        (o) =>
          o.status ===
          "Accepted"
      ).length;

    const pickedUp =
      orders.filter(
        (o) =>
          o.status ===
          "Picked Up"
      ).length;

    const delivered =
      orders.filter(
        (o) =>
          o.status ===
          "Delivered"
      ).length;

    return NextResponse.json({
      success: true,

      rider: {
        id:
          rider.id,
        name:
          rider.name,
        mobile:
          rider.mobile,
        status:
          rider.status,
      },

      summary: {
        total:
          orders.length,
        pending,
        accepted,
        pickedUp,
        delivered,
      },

      orders,
    });
  } catch (error) {
    console.error(
      "RIDER ORDERS ERROR:",
      error
    );

    return NextResponse.json(
      {
        success: false,
        error:
          "Failed To Load Orders",
      },
      {
        status: 500,
      }
    );
  }
}

==================== D:\D Drive\Desktop\CRM\FreshCut-CRM-Professional-Starter\app\api\delivery-verify\route.ts ====================

import { NextResponse } from "next/server";
import { prisma } from "@/lib/prisma";

export async function POST(req: Request) {
  try {
    const body = await req.json();

    const assignmentId = Number(body.assignmentId);
    const otp = String(body.otp);

    if (!assignmentId || !otp) {
      return NextResponse.json(
        {
          error: "Assignment ID and OTP required",
        },
        {
          status: 400,
        }
      );
    }

    const assignment =
      await prisma.deliveryAssignment.findUnique({
        where: {
          id: assignmentId,
        },
      });

    if (!assignment) {
      return NextResponse.json(
        {
          error: "Assignment not found",
        },
        {
          status: 404,
        }
      );
    }

    if (assignment.otp !== otp) {
      return NextResponse.json(
        {
          error: "Invalid OTP",
        },
        {
          status: 400,
        }
      );
    }

    return NextResponse.json({
      success: true,
      message: "OTP Verified",
    });
  } catch (error) {
    console.error(
      "DELIVERY VERIFY ERROR",
      error
    );

    return NextResponse.json(
      {
        error: "Verification Failed",
      },
      {
        status: 500,
      }
    );
  }
}

==================== D:\D Drive\Desktop\CRM\FreshCut-CRM-Professional-Starter\app\api\delivery-zone-performance\route.ts ====================

import { NextResponse } from "next/server";
import { prisma } from "@/lib/prisma";

export async function GET() {
  try {
    const orders = await prisma.order.findMany();

    const zones: Record<
      string,
      {
        totalOrders: number;
        deliveredOrders: number;
        revenue: number;
      }
    > = {};

    orders.forEach((order: any) => {
      const zone = "Default Zone";

      if (!zones[zone]) {
        zones[zone] = {
          totalOrders: 0,
          deliveredOrders: 0,
          revenue: 0,
        };
      }

      zones[zone].totalOrders += 1;

      if (order.status === "Delivered") {
        zones[zone].deliveredOrders += 1;
      }

      zones[zone].revenue += Number(order.amount || 0);
    });

    return NextResponse.json({
      success: true,
      zones,
    });
  } catch (error) {
    console.error(error);

    return NextResponse.json(
      {
        success: false,
        error: "Failed to load zone performance",
      },
      { status: 500 }
    );
  }
}

import { NextResponse } from "next/server";
import { prisma } from "@/lib/prisma";

export async function GET() {
  try {
    const zones =
      await prisma.deliveryZone.findMany({
        orderBy: {
          id: "asc",
        },
      });

    return NextResponse.json(zones);
  } catch (error) {
    return NextResponse.json(
      {
        error: "Failed To Load Zones",
      },
      {
        status: 500,
      }
    );
  }
}

export async function POST(
  req: Request
) {
  try {
    const body = await req.json();

    const zone =
      await prisma.deliveryZone.create({
        data: {
          zoneName:
            body.zoneName,
          sectors:
            body.sectors,
          charge: Number(
            body.charge
          ),
        },
      });

    return NextResponse.json(zone);
  } catch (error) {
    return NextResponse.json(
      {
        error: "Failed To Create Zone",
      },
      {
        status: 500,
      }
    );
  }
}

export async function PUT(
  req: Request
) {
  try {
    const body = await req.json();

    const zone =
      await prisma.deliveryZone.update({
        where: {
          id: Number(body.id),
        },
        data: {
          zoneName:
            body.zoneName,
          sectors:
            body.sectors,
          charge: Number(
            body.charge
          ),
        },
      });

    return NextResponse.json(zone);
  } catch (error) {
    return NextResponse.json(
      {
        error: "Failed To Update Zone",
      },
      {
        status: 500,
      }
    );
  }
}

export async function DELETE(
  req: Request
) {
  try {
    const body = await req.json();

    await prisma.deliveryZone.delete({
      where: {
        id: Number(body.id),
      },
    });

    return NextResponse.json({
      success: true,
    });
  } catch (error) {
    return NextResponse.json(
      {
        error: "Failed To Delete Zone",
      },
      {
        status: 500,
      }
    );
  }
}

==================== D:\D Drive\Desktop\CRM\FreshCut-CRM-Professional-Starter\app\api\fix-deadlines\route.ts ====================

import { NextResponse } from "next/server";
import { prisma } from "@/lib/prisma";

export async function GET() {

  const assignments =
    await prisma.deliveryAssignment.findMany({
      where: {
        pickupDeadline: null,
      },
    });

  for (const item of assignments) {

    await prisma.deliveryAssignment.update({
      where: {
        id: item.id,
      },

      data: {
        pickupDeadline:
          new Date(
            item.assignedAt.getTime() +
            180000
          ),
      },
    });
  }

  return NextResponse.json({
    success: true,
    fixed: assignments.length,
  });
}

      await prisma.order.count({
        where: {
          status: {
            notIn: [
              "Delivered",
              "Cancelled",
            ],
          },
        },
      });

      pending * 25;

      estimatedMinutes:
        prediction,
    });
  } catch (error: any) {
    return NextResponse.json(
      {
        success: false,
        error: error?.message,
      },
      { status: 500 }
    );
  }
}

==================== D:\D Drive\Desktop\CRM\FreshCut-CRM-Professional-Starter\app\api\fleet-profitability\route.ts ====================

import { NextResponse } from "next/server";
import { prisma } from "@/lib/prisma";

export async function GET() {
  try {
    const riders =
      await prisma.deliveryBoy.findMany();

    const totalRevenue =
      riders.reduce(
        (sum, r) =>
          sum + (r.earnings || 0),
        0
      );

    const estimatedCost =
      riders.length * 500;

    return NextResponse.json({
      success: true,
      revenue: totalRevenue,
      cost: estimatedCost,
      profit:
        totalRevenue -
        estimatedCost,
    });
  } catch (error:any) {
    return NextResponse.json(
      {
        success:false,
        error:error?.message
      },
      { status:500 }
    );
  }
}

==================== D:\D Drive\Desktop\CRM\FreshCut-CRM-Professional-Starter\app\api\fleet-rider-score\route.ts ====================

import { NextResponse } from "next/server";
import { prisma } from "@/lib/prisma";

export async function GET() {
  try {
    const riders =
      await prisma.deliveryBoy.findMany();

    const scores = riders.map((r) => {
      const score =
        (r.completedDeliveries * 2) +
        (r.rating * 10);

      return {
        id: r.id,
        name: r.name,
        score,
        deliveries:
          r.completedDeliveries,
        earnings: r.earnings,
        rating: r.rating,
      };
    });

    scores.sort(
      (a, b) => b.score - a.score
    );

    return NextResponse.json({
      success: true,
      riders: scores,
    });
  } catch (error: any) {
    return NextResponse.json(
      {
        success: false,
        error: error?.message,
      },
      { status: 500 }
    );
  }
}

      }

import { NextResponse } from "next/server";

  await prisma.deliveryAssignment.count();

 const late =
  await prisma.deliveryAssignment.count({
   where:{
    lateDelivery:true
   }
  });

 return NextResponse.json({
  success:true,
  totalAssignments:total,
  lateAssignments:late,
  slaPercent:
   total===0
   ?100
   :Math.round(

==================== D:\D Drive\Desktop\CRM\FreshCut-CRM-Professional-Starter\app\api\fleet-sla-monitor\route.ts ====================

import { NextResponse } from "next/server";
import { prisma } from "@/lib/prisma";

export async function GET() {
  try {
    const assignments =
      await prisma.deliveryAssignment.findMany();

    const late =
      assignments.filter(
        a => a.lateDelivery === true
      );

    return NextResponse.json({
      success: true,
      totalAssignments: assignments.length,
      lateAssignments: late.length,
      slaPercent:
        assignments.length === 0
          ? 100
          : Math.round(
              ((assignments.length - late.length) /
                assignments.length) *
                100
            ),
    });
  } catch (error: any) {
    return NextResponse.json(
      { success: false, error: error?.message },
      { status: 500 }
    );
  }
}

      await prisma.deliveryBoy.findMany({
        where: {
          status: "Online",

    const suggestions =
      riders
        .sort(

          riderId: r.id,
          riderName: r.name,
          deliveries:
            r.completedDeliveries,
          rating: r.rating,
        }));

    return NextResponse.json({
      success: true,
      suggestions,
    });
  } catch (error: any) {
    return NextResponse.json(
      {
        success: false,
        error: error?.message,
      },
      { status: 500 }
    );
  }
}

import { NextResponse } from "next/server";
import { prisma } from "@/lib/prisma";

export async function GET() {
  try {
    const riders =
      await prisma.deliveryBoy.findMany();

    const zones: Record<string, number> = {};

    riders.forEach((r) => {
      const zone =
        String(r.zoneId || 0);

      zones[zone] =
        (zones[zone] || 0) + 1;
    });

    return NextResponse.json({
      success: true,
      zones,
    });
  } catch (error: any) {
    return NextResponse.json(
      {
        success: false,
        error: error?.message,
      },
      { status: 500 }
    );
  }
}

      await prisma.deliveryBoy.findMany();

    const zones: Record<string, any> = {};

    riders.forEach((r) => {
      const zone =
        String(r.zoneId || 0);

      if (!zones[zone]) {
        zones[zone] = {
          zoneId: zone,
          riders: 0,
          online: 0,
        };
      }

      zones[zone].riders++;

      if (r.status === "Online") {
        zones[zone].online++;
      }
    });

    return NextResponse.json({
      success: true,
      zones: Object.values(zones),
    });
  } catch (error: any) {
    return NextResponse.json(
      { success: false, error: error?.message },
      { status: 500 }
    );
  }
}

export async function GET() {

      await prisma.deliveryBoy.findMany();

          rider.zoneId || 0;

    );

    return NextResponse.json({
      success: true,
      zones:
        Object.values(zones),
    });
  } catch (error: any) {
    return NextResponse.json(
      {
        success: false,
        error: error?.message,
      },
      { status: 500 }
    );
  }
}

==================== D:\D Drive\Desktop\CRM\FreshCut-CRM-Professional-Starter\app\api\order-auto-assign\route.ts ====================

import { NextResponse } from "next/server";
import { prisma } from "@/lib/prisma";

function generateOTP() {
  return Math.floor(
    1000 + Math.random() * 9000
  ).toString();
}

export async function POST(
  req: Request
) {
  try {
    const body = await req.json();

    const orderId = Number(
      body.orderId
    );

    if (!orderId) {
      return NextResponse.json(
        {
          error: "Order ID Required",
        },
        {
          status: 400,
        }
      );
    }

    const riders =
      await prisma.deliveryBoy.findMany({
        where: {
          status: "Available",
        },
      });

    if (!riders.length) {
      return NextResponse.json(
        {
          error:
            "No Rider Available",
        },
        {
          status: 400,
        }
      );
    }

    const riderStats =
      await Promise.all(
        riders.map(
          async (rider) => {
            const pending =
              await prisma.deliveryAssignment.count(
                {
                  where: {
                    deliveryBoyId:
                      rider.id,
                    status: {
                      not:
                        "Delivered",
                    },
                  },
                }
              );

            return {
              rider,
              pending,
            };
          }
        )
      );

    riderStats.sort(
      (a, b) => {
        if (
          a.pending !==
          b.pending
        ) {
          return (
            a.pending -
            b.pending
          );
        }

        return (
          b.rider.rating -
          a.rider.rating
        );
      }
    );

    const selected =
      riderStats[0];

    const assignment =
      await prisma.deliveryAssignment.create(
        {
          data: {
            orderId,
            deliveryBoyId:
              selected.rider.id,
            otp:
              generateOTP(),
            status:
              "Pending Acceptance",
          },
        }
      );

    return NextResponse.json({
      success: true,
      assignment,
      rider:
        selected.rider,
    });
  } catch (error) {
    console.error(
      "AUTO ASSIGN ERROR",
      error
    );

    return NextResponse.json(
      {
        error:
          "Failed To Assign Order",
      },
      {
        status: 500,
      }
    );
  }
}
