==================== D:\D Drive\Desktop\CRM\FreshCut-CRM-Professional-Starter\app\api\orders\[id]\route.ts ====================


==================== D:\D Drive\Desktop\CRM\FreshCut-CRM-Professional-Starter\app\api\orders\route.ts ====================

import { NextResponse } from "next/server";
import { prisma } from "@/lib/prisma";

const ORDER_STATUSES = [
  "Pending",
  "Confirmed",
  "Packed",
  "Out for Delivery",
  "Delivered",
  "Cancelled",
];

function generateOTP() {
  return Math.floor(
    1000 + Math.random() * 9000
  ).toString();
}

export async function GET() {
  try {
    const orders = await prisma.order.findMany({
      orderBy: {
        id: "desc",
      },
    });

    return NextResponse.json(orders);
  } catch (error) {
    console.error(
      "GET ORDERS ERROR:",
      error
    );

    return NextResponse.json(
      {
        error:
          error instanceof Error
            ? error.message
            : "Failed to load orders",
      },
      {
        status: 500,
      }
    );
  }
}

export async function POST(req: Request) {
  try {
    const body = await req.json();

    const customer = String(
      body?.customer || ""
    ).trim();

    const phone = String(
      body?.phone || ""
    ).trim();

    const address = String(
      body?.address || ""
    ).trim();

    const amount = Math.round(
      Number(body?.amount || 0)
    );

    const cartItems = Array.isArray(
      body?.items
    )
      ? body.items
      : [];

    if (!customer) {
      return NextResponse.json(
        {
          error:
            "Customer name is required",
        },
        {
          status: 400,
        }
      );
    }

    if (!phone) {
      return NextResponse.json(
        {
          error:
            "Customer phone is required",
        },
        {
          status: 400,
        }
      );
    }

    if (
      !Number.isFinite(amount) ||
      amount < 0
    ) {
      return NextResponse.json(
        {
          error:
            "Valid order amount is required",
        },
        {
          status: 400,
        }
      );
    }

    if (cartItems.length === 0) {
      return NextResponse.json(
        {
          error:
            "Order must contain at least one item",
        },
        {
          status: 400,
        }
      );
    }

    const deliveryOtp =
      generateOTP();

    const orderItems = cartItems
      .map((item: any) => {
        const productId = Number(
          item?.id || 0
        );

        const quantity = Math.max(
          1,
          Math.round(
            Number(item?.qty || 1)
          )
        );

        const price = Math.max(
          0,
          Math.round(
            Number(item?.price || 0)
          )
        );

        return {
          productId,
          productName: String(
            item?.name || "Product"
          ),
          quantity,
          price,
          total: price * quantity,
        };
      })
      .filter(
        (item: any) =>
          Number.isInteger(
            item.productId
          ) &&
          item.productId > 0 &&
          Number.isInteger(
            item.quantity
          ) &&
          item.quantity > 0
      );

    if (orderItems.length === 0) {
      return NextResponse.json(
        {
          error:
            "No valid products found in cart",
        },
        {
          status: 400,
        }
      );
    }

    const order =
      await prisma.order.create({
        data: {
          customer,
          phone,
          address,
          amount,
          status: "Pending",
          deliveryOtp,
        },
      });

    try {
      await prisma.orderItem.createMany({
        data: orderItems.map(
          (item: any) => ({
            orderId: order.id,
            productId: item.productId,
            productName:
              item.productName,
            quantity: item.quantity,
            price: item.price,
            total: item.total,
          })
        ),
      });
    } catch (itemError) {
      // If order items fail, remove the
      // parent order so we don't leave
      // an incomplete order behind.
      try {
        await prisma.order.delete({
          where: {
            id: order.id,
          },
        });
      } catch {}

      throw itemError;
    }

    return NextResponse.json(
      {
        success: true,
        order: {
          ...order,
          deliveryOtp,
        },
        deliveryOtp,
        items: orderItems,
        message:
          `Order Confirmed. Delivery OTP: ${deliveryOtp}`,
      },
      {
        status: 201,
      }
    );
  } catch (error) {
    console.error(
      "CREATE ORDER ERROR:",
      error
    );

    return NextResponse.json(
      {
        success: false,
        error:
          error instanceof Error
            ? error.message
            : "Failed to create order",
      },
      {
        status: 500,
      }
    );
  }
}

export async function PATCH(
  req: Request
) {
  try {
    const body = await req.json();

    const id = Number(
      body?.id
    );

    const status = String(
      body?.status || ""
    ).trim();

    if (!Number.isInteger(id)) {
      return NextResponse.json(
        {
          error:
            "Valid order ID is required",
        },
        {
          status: 400,
        }
      );
    }

    if (
      !ORDER_STATUSES.includes(
        status
      )
    ) {
      return NextResponse.json(
        {
          error:
            "Invalid order status",
        },
        {
          status: 400,
        }
      );
    }

    const existing =
      await prisma.order.findUnique({
        where: {
          id,
        },
      });

    if (!existing) {
      return NextResponse.json(
        {
          error:
            "Order not found",
        },
        {
          status: 404,
        }
      );
    }

    const updated =
      await prisma.order.update({
        where: {
          id,
        },
        data: {
          status,
        },
      });

    return NextResponse.json(
      updated
    );
  } catch (error) {
    console.error(
      "UPDATE ORDER ERROR:",
      error
    );

    return NextResponse.json(
      {
        error:
          error instanceof Error
            ? error.message
            : "Failed to update order",
      },
      {
        status: 500,
      }
    );
  }
}

export async function DELETE(
  req: Request
) {
  try {
    const body = await req.json();

    const id = Number(
      body?.id
    );

    if (!Number.isInteger(id)) {
      return NextResponse.json(
        {
          error:
            "Valid order ID is required",
        },
        {
          status: 400,
        }
      );
    }

    const existing =
      await prisma.order.findUnique({
        where: {
          id,
        },
      });

    if (!existing) {
      return NextResponse.json(
        {
          error:
            "Order not found",
        },
        {
          status: 404,
        }
      );
    }

    await prisma.orderItem.deleteMany({
      where: {
        orderId: id,
      },
    });

    await prisma.order.delete({
      where: {
        id,
      },
    });

    return NextResponse.json({
      success: true,
      id,
    });
  } catch (error) {
    console.error(
      "DELETE ORDER ERROR:",
      error
    );

    return NextResponse.json(
      {
        error:
          error instanceof Error
            ? error.message
            : "Failed to delete order",
      },
      {
        status: 500,
      }
    );
  }
}

==================== D:\D Drive\Desktop\CRM\FreshCut-CRM-Professional-Starter\app\api\processing\orders\route.backup.ts ====================

import { NextResponse } from "next/server";
import { prisma } from "@/lib/prisma";
import { getCurrentSession } from "@/lib/auth";

const STARTABLE_STATUSES = [
  "Pending",
  "Confirmed",
  "Paid",
  "Payment Received",
];

const TERMINAL_STATUSES = [
  "Delivered",
  "Cancelled",
];

type SessionLike = {
  kind?: string;
  role?: string;
  name?: string;
  mobile?: string;
  phone?: string;
  staffId?: number;
  id?: number;
  userId?: number;
};

async function getProcessingStaff() {
  const session =
    await getCurrentSession();

  const data =
    session as SessionLike | null;

  if (
    !data ||
    data.kind !== "staff" ||
    String(data.role).toUpperCase() !==
      "PROCESSING"
  ) {
    return null;
  }

  const candidateId = Number(
    data.staffId 
      data.id 
      data.userId 
      0
  );

  if (
    Number.isInteger(candidateId) &&
    candidateId > 0
  ) {
    const staff =
      await prisma.staffUser.findUnique({
        where: {
          id: candidateId,
        },
      });

    if (
      staff &&
      staff.active &&
      String(staff.role).toUpperCase() ===
        "PROCESSING"
    ) {
      return {
        session: data,
        staff,
      };
    }
  }

  const mobile =
    String(
      data.mobile 
        data.phone 
        ""
    ).trim();

  if (mobile) {
    const staff =
      await prisma.staffUser.findUnique({
        where: {
          mobile,
        },
      });

    if (
      staff &&
      staff.active &&
      String(staff.role).toUpperCase() ===
        "PROCESSING"
    ) {
      return {
        session: data,
        staff,
      };
    }
  }

  const name =
    String(
      data.name  ""
    ).trim();

  if (name) {
    const staff =
      await prisma.staffUser.findFirst({
        where: {
          name,
          active: true,
          role: "PROCESSING",
        },
      });

    if (staff) {
      return {
        session: data,
        staff,
      };
    }
  }

  return null;
}

async function buildOrders() {
  const orders =
    await prisma.order.findMany({
      where: {
        status: {
          notIn:
            TERMINAL_STATUSES,
        },
      },
      orderBy: {
        createdAt: "asc",
      },
    });

  const orderIds =
    orders.map(
      (order) => order.id
    );

  const orderItems =
    orderIds.length > 0
      ? await prisma.orderItem.findMany({
          where: {
            orderId: {
              in: orderIds,
            },
          },
          orderBy: {
            id: "asc",
          },
        })
      : [];

  const productIds = [
    ...new Set(
      orderItems.map(
        (item) =>
          item.productId
      )
    ),
  ];

  const products = await prisma.product.findMany({
    where: {
      id: {
        in: productIds,
      },
    },
    select: {
      id: true,
      name: true,
      pack: true,
    },
  });

  const productMap =
    new Map(
      products.map(
        (product) => [
          product.id,
          product,
        ]
      )
    );

  const itemsByOrder =
    new Map<number, any[]>();

  for (const item of orderItems) {
    const product =
      productMap.get(
        item.productId
      );

    const mapped = {
      id: item.id,
      productId:
        item.productId,
      productName:
        product?.name ||
        item.productName ||
        "Product",
      pack:
        product?.pack || "-",
      quantity:
        Number(
          item.quantity || 0
        ),
      price:
        Number(
          item.price || 0
        ),
      total:
        Number(
          item.total || 0
        ),
      packed:
        Boolean(item.packed),
    };

    const existing =
      itemsByOrder.get(
        item.orderId
      ) || [];

    existing.push(mapped);

    itemsByOrder.set(
      item.orderId,
      existing
    );
  }

  const processingIds = [
    ...new Set(
      orders
        .flatMap(
          (order) => [
            order.processingAcceptedById,
            order.processingPreparedById,
            order.processingCrossCheckedById,
            order.processingStickerById,
            order.processingPackagingById,
            order.processingDispatchedById,
          ]
        )
        .filter(
          (
            id
          ): id is number =>
            Number.isInteger(id)
        )
    ),
  ];

  const staff =
    processingIds.length > 0
      ? await prisma.staffUser.findMany({
          where: {
            id: {
              in: processingIds,
            },
          },
          select: {
            id: true,
            name: true,
          },
        })
      : [];

  const staffMap =
    new Map(
      staff.map(
        (person) => [
          person.id,
          person.name,
        ]
      )
    );

  return orders.map(
    (order) => ({
      ...order,

      acceptedByName:
        order.processingAcceptedById
          ? staffMap.get(
              order.processingAcceptedById
            ) || "Staff"
          : null,

      preparedByName:
        order.processingPreparedById
          ? staffMap.get(
              order.processingPreparedById
            ) || "Staff"
          : null,

      crossCheckedByName:
        order.processingCrossCheckedById
          ? staffMap.get(
              order.processingCrossCheckedById
            ) || "Staff"
          : null,

      stickerByName:
        order.processingStickerById
          ? staffMap.get(
              order.processingStickerById
            ) || "Staff"
          : null,

      packagingByName:
        order.processingPackagingById
          ? staffMap.get(
              order.processingPackagingById
            ) || "Staff"
          : null,

      dispatchedByName:
        order.processingDispatchedById
          ? staffMap.get(
              order.processingDispatchedById
            ) || "Staff"
          : null,

      items:
        itemsByOrder.get(
          order.id
        ) || [],
    })
  );
}

export async function GET() {
  try {
    const current =
      await getProcessingStaff();

    if (!current) {
      return NextResponse.json(
        {
          error:
            "Processing session expired. Please login again.",
        },
        { status: 401 }
      );
    }

    const orders =
      await buildOrders();

    return NextResponse.json({
      success: true,

      currentStaff: {
        id: current.staff.id,
        name: current.staff.name,
        mobile:
          current.staff.mobile,
      },

      orders,
    });
  } catch (error) {
    console.error(
      "PROCESSING GET ERROR:",
      error
    );

    return NextResponse.json(
      {
        error:
          error instanceof Error
            ? error.message
            : "Failed to load orders",
      },
      { status: 500 }
    );
  }
}

export async function PATCH(
  req: Request
) {
  try {
    const current =
      await getProcessingStaff();

    if (!current) {
      return NextResponse.json(
        {
          error:
            "Processing session expired. Please login again.",
        },
        { status: 401 }
      );
    }

    const body =
      await req.json();

    const action =
      String(
        body?.action || ""
      ).trim();

    const orderId =
      Number(
        body?.id
      );

    const now =
      new Date();

    /*
     * ======================================================
     * STEP 1 0 ACCEPT ORDER
     * ======================================================
     */

    if (
      action ===
      "accept"
    ) {
      if (
        !Number.isInteger(
          orderId
        ) ||
        orderId <= 0
      ) {
        return NextResponse.json(
          {
            error:
              "Valid order ID required",
          },
          { status: 400 }
        );
      }

      const deadline =
        new Date(
          now.getTime() +
            30 * 60 * 1000
        );

      /*
       * Atomic claim:
       * only first staff member can accept.
       */
      const claimed =
        await prisma.order.updateMany({
          where: {
            id: orderId,

            status: {
              in:
                STARTABLE_STATUSES,
            },

            processingAcceptedAt:
              null,
          },

          data: {
            status:
              "Processing",

            processingStep:
              1,

            processingAcceptedById:
              current.staff.id,

            processingAcceptedAt:
              now,

            processingStartedAt:
              now,

            processingDeadline:
              deadline,
          },
        });

      if (
        claimed.count === 0
      ) {
        return NextResponse.json(
          {
            error:
              "This order has already been accepted by another processing staff member.",
          },
          { status: 409 }
        );
      }

      return NextResponse.json({
        success: true,
        message:
          "Order accepted successfully",
      });
    }

    /*
     * ======================================================
     * STEP 2 0 PREPARE & PACK
     * ======================================================
     */

    if (
      action ===
      "prepare"
    ) {
      const order =
        await prisma.order.findUnique({
          where: {
            id: orderId,
          },
        });

      if (!order) {
        return NextResponse.json(
          {
            error:
              "Order not found",
          },
          { status: 404 }
        );
      }

      if (
        order.processingAcceptedById !==
        current.staff.id
      ) {
        return NextResponse.json(
          {
            error:
              "This order belongs to another processing staff member.",
          },
          { status: 403 }
        );
      }

      const items =
        await prisma.orderItem.findMany({
          where: {
            orderId,
          },
          select: {
            packed: true,
          },
        });

      if (
        items.length === 0
      ) {
        return NextResponse.json(
          {
            error:
              "No products found in this order.",
          },
          { status: 400 }
        );
      }

      const allPacked =
        items.every(
          (item) =>
            item.packed
        );

      if (!allPacked) {
        return NextResponse.json(
          {
            error:
              "All packing items must be checked before completing Prepare & Pack.",
          },
          { status: 400 }
        );
      }

      await prisma.order.update({
        where: {
          id: orderId,
        },
        data: {
          processingStep:
            2,

          processingPreparedById:
            current.staff.id,

          processingPreparedAt:
            now,
        },
      });

      return NextResponse.json({
        success: true,
        message:
          "Prepare & Pack completed",
      });
    }

    /*
     * ======================================================
     * STEP 3 0 CROSS CHECK
     * ======================================================
     */

    if (
      action ===
      "crossCheck"
    ) {
      const order =
        await prisma.order.findUnique({
          where: {
            id: orderId,
          },
        });

      if (!order) {
        return NextResponse.json(
          {
            error:
              "Order not found",
          },
          { status: 404 }
        );
      }

      if (
        order.processingAcceptedById !==
        current.staff.id
      ) {
        return NextResponse.json(
          {
            error:
              "Only the assigned processing staff can complete this order.",
          },
          { status: 403 }
        );
      }

      const crossChecked =
        body?.crossChecked ===
        true;

      const stickerChecked =
        body?.stickerChecked ===
        true;

      const packagingChecked =
        body?.packagingChecked ===
        true;

      if (
        !crossChecked ||
        !stickerChecked ||
        !packagingChecked
      ) {
        return NextResponse.json(
          {
            error:
              "Complete all three final checks first.",
          },
          { status: 400 }
        );
      }

      await prisma.order.update({
        where: {
          id: orderId,
        },
        data: {
          processingStep:
            3,

          processingCrossCheckedById:
            current.staff.id,

          processingCrossCheckedAt:
            now,

          processingStickerById:
            current.staff.id,

          processingStickerAt:
            now,

          processingPackagingById:
            current.staff.id,

          processingPackagingAt:
            now,
        },
      });

      return NextResponse.json({
        success: true,
        message:
          "Final cross-check completed",
      });
    }

    /*
     * ======================================================
     * STEP 4 0 SEND FOR DISPATCH
     * ======================================================
     */

    if (
  action ===
  "dispatch"
) {
  const order =
    await prisma.order.findUnique({
      where: {
        id: orderId,
      },
    });

  if (!order) {
    return NextResponse.json(
      {
        error:
          "Order not found",
      },
      { status: 404 }
    );
  }

  if (
    order.processingAcceptedById !==
    current.staff.id
  ) {
    return NextResponse.json(
      {
        error:
          "Only the assigned processing staff can dispatch this order.",
      },
      { status: 403 }
    );
  }

  if (
    order.processingStep < 3
  ) {
    return NextResponse.json(
      {
        error:
          "Complete all processing and cross-check steps first.",
      },
      { status: 400 }
    );
  }

  const existingAssignment =
    await prisma.deliveryAssignment.findFirst({
      where: {
        orderId,
      },
    });

  if (existingAssignment) {
    return NextResponse.json({
      success: true,
      message:
        "Order already assigned to rider",
    });
  }

  const rider =
    await prisma.deliveryBoy.findFirst({
      where: {
        approvalStatus:
          "Approved",

        status: {
          in: [
            "Online",
            "Available",
          ],
        },
      },

      orderBy: {
        completedDeliveries:
          "asc",
      },
    });

  if (!rider) {
    await prisma.order.update({
      where: {
        id: orderId,
      },
      data: {
        status:
          "Ready For Dispatch",

        processingStep:
          4,

        processingDispatchedById:
          current.staff.id,
      },
    });

    return NextResponse.json({
      success: true,
      message:
        "No rider available. Order moved to dispatch queue.",
    });
  }

  const otp =
    Math.floor(
      1000 +
      Math.random() * 9000
    ).toString();

  await prisma.deliveryAssignment.create({
    data: {
      orderId,
      deliveryBoyId:
        rider.id,
      otp,
      status:
        "Pending Acceptance",
      earnings: 25,
      assignedAt:
        new Date(),
    },
  });

  await prisma.order.update({
    where: {
      id: orderId,
    },
    data: {
      status:
        "Assigned To Rider",

      deliveryOtp:
        otp,

      processingStep:
        4,

      processingDispatchedById:
        current.staff.id,
    },
  });

  return NextResponse.json({
    success: true,
    riderId:
      rider.id,
    otp,
    message:
      "Order assigned to rider successfully",
  });
}
    }

    /*
     * ======================================================
     * PACKING ITEM CHECKBOX
     * ======================================================
     */

    if (
      action ===
      "packItem"
    ) {
      const itemId =
        Number(
          body?.itemId
        );

      const packed =
        body?.packed === true;

      if (
        !Number.isInteger(
          itemId
        )
      ) {
        return NextResponse.json(
          {
            error:
              "Valid item ID required",
          },
          { status: 400 }
        );
      }

      const item =
        await prisma.orderItem.findUnique({
          where: {
            id: itemId,
          },
          select: {
            id: true,
            orderId: true,
          },
        });

      if (!item) {
        return NextResponse.json(
          {
            error:
              "Item not found",
          },
          { status: 404 }
        );
      }

      const order =
        await prisma.order.findUnique({
          where: {
            id: item.orderId,
          },
          select: {
            processingAcceptedById:
              true,
          },
        });

      if (
        order?.processingAcceptedById !==
        current.staff.id
      ) {
        return NextResponse.json(
          {
            error:
              "Accept the order first.",
          },
          { status: 403 }
        );
      }

      await prisma.orderItem.update({
        where: {
          id: itemId,
        },
        data: {
          packed,
        },
      });

      return NextResponse.json({
        success: true,
      });
    }

    return NextResponse.json(
      {
        error:
          "Invalid action",
      },
      { status: 400 }
    );
  } catch (error) {
    console.error(
      "PROCESSING PATCH ERROR:",
      error
    );

    return NextResponse.json(
      {
        error:
          error instanceof Error
            ? error.message
            : "Processing action failed",
      },
      { status: 500 }
    );
  }
}

import { NextResponse } from "next/server";
import { prisma } from "@/lib/prisma";
import { getCurrentSession } from "@/lib/auth";

const STARTABLE_STATUSES = [
  "Pending",
  "Confirmed",
  "Paid",
  "Payment Received",
];

const TERMINAL_STATUSES = [
  "Delivered",
  "Cancelled",
];

type SessionLike = {
  kind?: string;
  role?: string;
  name?: string;
  mobile?: string;
  phone?: string;
  staffId?: number;
  id?: number;
  userId?: number;
};

async function getProcessingStaff() {
  const session = await getCurrentSession();
  const data = session as SessionLike | null;

  if (
    !data ||
    data.kind !== "staff" ||
    String(data.role).toUpperCase() !== "PROCESSING"
  ) {
    return null;
  }

  const candidateId = Number(
    data.staffId ?? data.id ?? data.userId ?? 0
  );

  if (Number.isInteger(candidateId) && candidateId > 0) {
    const staff = await prisma.staffUser.findUnique({
      where: { id: candidateId },
    });

    if (
      staff &&
      staff.active &&
      String(staff.role).toUpperCase() === "PROCESSING"
    ) {
      return { session: data, staff };
    }
  }

  const mobile = String(data.mobile ?? data.phone ?? "").trim();

  if (mobile) {
    const staff = await prisma.staffUser.findUnique({
      where: { mobile },
    });

    if (
      staff &&
      staff.active &&
      String(staff.role).toUpperCase() === "PROCESSING"
    ) {
      return { session: data, staff };
    }
  }

  const name = String(data.name ?? "").trim();

  if (name) {
    const staff = await prisma.staffUser.findFirst({
      where: {
        name,
        active: true,
        role: "PROCESSING",
      },
    });

    if (staff) {
      return { session: data, staff };
    }
  }

  return null;
}

async function buildOrders() {
  const orders = await prisma.order.findMany({
    where: {
      status: {
        notIn: TERMINAL_STATUSES,
      },
    },
    orderBy: {
      createdAt: "asc",
    },
  });

  const orderIds = orders.map((order) => order.id);

  const orderItems =
    orderIds.length > 0
      ? await prisma.orderItem.findMany({
          where: {
            orderId: {
              in: orderIds,
            },
          },
          orderBy: {
            id: "asc",
          },
        })
      : [];

  const productIds = [
    ...new Set(
      orderItems.map((item) => item.productId)
    ),
  ];

  const products =
    productIds.length > 0
      ? await prisma.product.findMany({
          where: {
            id: {
              in: productIds,
            },
          },
          select: {
            id: true,
            name: true,
            pack: true,
          },
        })
      : [];

  const productMap = new Map(
    products.map((product) => [
      product.id,
      product,
    ])
  );

  const itemsByOrder = new Map<number, any[]>();

  for (const item of orderItems) {
    const product = productMap.get(item.productId);

    const mapped = {
      id: item.id,
      productId: item.productId,
      productName:
        product?.name ||
        item.productName ||
        "Product",
      pack: product?.pack || "-",
      quantity: Number(item.quantity || 0),
      price: Number(item.price || 0),
      total: Number(item.total || 0),
      packed: Boolean(item.packed),
    };

    const existing =
      itemsByOrder.get(item.orderId) || [];

    existing.push(mapped);
    itemsByOrder.set(item.orderId, existing);
  }

  const processingIds = [
    ...new Set(
      orders
        .flatMap((order) => [
          order.processingAcceptedById,
          order.processingPreparedById,
          order.processingCrossCheckedById,
          order.processingStickerById,
          order.processingPackagingById,
          order.processingDispatchedById,
        ])
        .filter(
          (id): id is number =>
            Number.isInteger(id)
        )
    ),
  ];

  const staff =
    processingIds.length > 0
      ? await prisma.staffUser.findMany({
          where: {
            id: {
              in: processingIds,
            },
          },
          select: {
            id: true,
            name: true,
          },
        })
      : [];

  const staffMap = new Map(
    staff.map((person) => [
      person.id,
      person.name,
    ])
  );

  return orders.map((order) => ({
    ...order,

    acceptedByName:
      order.processingAcceptedById
        ? staffMap.get(
            order.processingAcceptedById
          ) || "Staff"
        : null,

    preparedByName:
      order.processingPreparedById
        ? staffMap.get(
            order.processingPreparedById
          ) || "Staff"
        : null,

    crossCheckedByName:
      order.processingCrossCheckedById
        ? staffMap.get(
            order.processingCrossCheckedById
          ) || "Staff"
        : null,

    stickerByName:
      order.processingStickerById
        ? staffMap.get(
            order.processingStickerById
          ) || "Staff"
        : null,

    packagingByName:
      order.processingPackagingById
        ? staffMap.get(
            order.processingPackagingById
          ) || "Staff"
        : null,

    dispatchedByName:
      order.processingDispatchedById
        ? staffMap.get(
            order.processingDispatchedById
          ) || "Staff"
        : null,

    items:
      itemsByOrder.get(order.id) || [],
  }));
}

export async function GET() {
  try {
    const current = await getProcessingStaff();

    if (!current) {
      return NextResponse.json(
        {
          error:
            "Processing session expired. Please login again.",
        },
        { status: 401 }
      );
    }

    const orders = await buildOrders();

    return NextResponse.json({
      success: true,
      currentStaff: {
        id: current.staff.id,
        name: current.staff.name,
        mobile: current.staff.mobile,
      },
      orders,
    });
  } catch (error) {
    console.error(
      "PROCESSING GET ERROR:",
      error
    );

    return NextResponse.json(
      {
        error:
          error instanceof Error
            ? error.message
            : "Failed to load orders",
      },
      { status: 500 }
    );
  }
}

export async function PATCH(req: Request) {
  try {
    const current = await getProcessingStaff();

    if (!current) {
      return NextResponse.json(
        {
          error:
            "Processing session expired. Please login again.",
        },
        { status: 401 }
      );
    }

    const body = await req.json();

    const action = String(
      body?.action || ""
    ).trim();

    const orderId = Number(body?.id);
    const now = new Date();

    /*
     * STEP 1 0 ACCEPT ORDER
     */
    if (action === "accept") {
      if (
        !Number.isInteger(orderId) ||
        orderId <= 0
      ) {
        return NextResponse.json(
          {
            error: "Valid order ID required",
          },
          { status: 400 }
        );
      }

      const deadline = new Date(
        now.getTime() + 30 * 60 * 1000
      );

      const claimed =
        await prisma.order.updateMany({
          where: {
            id: orderId,
            status: {
              in: STARTABLE_STATUSES,
            },
            processingAcceptedAt: null,
          },
          data: {
            status: "Processing",
            processingStep: 1,
            processingAcceptedById:
              current.staff.id,
            processingAcceptedAt: now,
            processingStartedAt: now,
            processingDeadline: deadline,
          },
        });

      if (claimed.count === 0) {
        return NextResponse.json(
          {
            error:
              "This order has already been accepted by another processing staff member.",
          },
          { status: 409 }
        );
      }

      return NextResponse.json({
        success: true,
        message: "Order accepted successfully",
      });
    }

    /*
     * STEP 2 0 PREPARE & PACK
     */
    if (action === "prepare") {
      const order =
        await prisma.order.findUnique({
          where: { id: orderId },
        });

      if (!order) {
        return NextResponse.json(
          { error: "Order not found" },
          { status: 404 }
        );
      }

      if (
        order.processingAcceptedById !==
        current.staff.id
      ) {
        return NextResponse.json(
          {
            error:
              "This order belongs to another processing staff member.",
          },
          { status: 403 }
        );
      }

      const items =
        await prisma.orderItem.findMany({
          where: { orderId },
          select: { packed: true },
        });

      if (items.length === 0) {
        return NextResponse.json(
          {
            error:
              "No products found in this order.",
          },
          { status: 400 }
        );
      }

      const allPacked = items.every(
        (item) => item.packed
      );

      if (!allPacked) {
        return NextResponse.json(
          {
            error:
              "All packing items must be checked before completing Prepare & Pack.",
          },
          { status: 400 }
        );
      }

      await prisma.order.update({
        where: { id: orderId },
        data: {
          processingStep: 2,
          processingPreparedById:
            current.staff.id,
          processingPreparedAt: now,
        },
      });

      return NextResponse.json({
        success: true,
        message: "Prepare & Pack completed",
      });
    }

    /*
     * STEP 3 0 FINAL CROSS CHECK
     */
    if (action === "crossCheck") {
      const order =
        await prisma.order.findUnique({
          where: { id: orderId },
        });

      if (!order) {
        return NextResponse.json(
          { error: "Order not found" },
          { status: 404 }
        );
      }

      if (
        order.processingAcceptedById !==
        current.staff.id
      ) {
        return NextResponse.json(
          {
            error:
              "Only the assigned processing staff can complete this order.",
          },
          { status: 403 }
        );
      }

      const crossChecked =
        body?.crossChecked === true;

      const stickerChecked =
        body?.stickerChecked === true;

      const packagingChecked =
        body?.packagingChecked === true;

      if (
        !crossChecked ||
        !stickerChecked ||
        !packagingChecked
      ) {
        return NextResponse.json(
          {
            error:
              "Complete all three final checks first.",
          },
          { status: 400 }
        );
      }

      await prisma.order.update({
        where: { id: orderId },
        data: {
          processingStep: 3,

          processingCrossCheckedById:
            current.staff.id,
          processingCrossCheckedAt: now,

          processingStickerById:
            current.staff.id,
          processingStickerAt: now,

          processingPackagingById:
            current.staff.id,
          processingPackagingAt: now,
        },
      });

      return NextResponse.json({
        success: true,
        message:
          "Final cross-check completed",
      });
    }

    /*
     * STEP 4 0 SEND FOR DISPATCH
     *
     * IMPORTANT:
     * OTP is NOT generated here.
     * Customer delivery OTP will be generated
     * only when rider reaches delivery stage.
     */
    if (action === "dispatch") {
      const order =
        await prisma.order.findUnique({
          where: { id: orderId },
        });

      if (!order) {
        return NextResponse.json(
          { error: "Order not found" },
          { status: 404 }
        );
      }

      if (
        order.processingAcceptedById !==
        current.staff.id
      ) {
        return NextResponse.json(
          {
            error:
              "Only the assigned processing staff can dispatch this order.",
          },
          { status: 403 }
        );
      }

      if (order.processingStep < 3) {
        return NextResponse.json(
          {
            error:
              "Complete all processing and cross-check steps first.",
          },
          { status: 400 }
        );
      }

      const existingAssignment =
        await prisma.deliveryAssignment.findFirst({
          where: { orderId },
        });

      if (existingAssignment) {
        return NextResponse.json({
          success: true,
          message:
            "Order already assigned to rider",
        });
      }

      const rider =
        await prisma.deliveryBoy.findFirst({
          where: {
            approvalStatus: "Approved",
            status: {
              in: ["Online", "Available"],
            },
          },
          orderBy: {
            completedDeliveries: "asc",
          },
        });

      if (!rider) {
        await prisma.order.update({
          where: { id: orderId },
          data: {
            status: "Ready For Dispatch",
            processingStep: 4,
            processingDispatchedById:
              current.staff.id,
          },
        });

        return NextResponse.json({
          success: true,
          message:
            "No rider available. Order moved to dispatch queue.",
        });
      }

      /*
       * DeliveryAssignment.otp is required by the
       * current Prisma schema, so it remains empty
       * until the rider starts the delivery OTP flow.
       *
       * No OTP is exposed to processing staff.
       */
      await prisma.deliveryAssignment.create({
        data: {
          orderId,
          deliveryBoyId: rider.id,
          otp: "",
          status: "Pending Acceptance",
          earnings: 25,
          assignedAt: now,
        },
      });

      await prisma.order.update({
        where: { id: orderId },
        data: {
          status: "Assigned To Rider",
          deliveryOtp: null,
          processingStep: 4,
          processingDispatchedById:
            current.staff.id,
        },
      });

      return NextResponse.json({
        success: true,
        riderId: rider.id,
        message:
          "Order assigned to rider successfully. Delivery OTP will be generated only at delivery.",
      });
    }

    /*
     * PACKING ITEM CHECKBOX
     */
    if (action === "packItem") {
      const itemId = Number(body?.itemId);
      const packed = body?.packed === true;

      if (!Number.isInteger(itemId)) {
        return NextResponse.json(
          {
            error: "Valid item ID required",
          },
          { status: 400 }
        );
      }

      const item =
        await prisma.orderItem.findUnique({
          where: { id: itemId },
          select: {
            id: true,
            orderId: true,
          },
        });

      if (!item) {
        return NextResponse.json(
          { error: "Item not found" },
          { status: 404 }
        );
      }

      const order =
        await prisma.order.findUnique({
          where: { id: item.orderId },
          select: {
            processingAcceptedById: true,
          },
        });

      if (
        order?.processingAcceptedById !==
        current.staff.id
      ) {
        return NextResponse.json(
          {
            error: "Accept the order first.",
          },
          { status: 403 }
        );
      }

      await prisma.orderItem.update({
        where: { id: itemId },
        data: { packed },
      });

      return NextResponse.json({
        success: true,
      });
    }

    return NextResponse.json(
      { error: "Invalid action" },
      { status: 400 }
    );
  } catch (error) {
    console.error(
      "PROCESSING PATCH ERROR:",
      error
    );

    return NextResponse.json(
      {
        error:
          error instanceof Error
            ? error.message
            : "Processing action failed",
      },
      { status: 500 }
    );
  }
}

import { NextResponse } from "next/server";
import { prisma } from "@/lib/prisma";

async function getProductImage(
  productName: string
) {
  try {
    const response = await fetch(
      `https://api.pexels.com/v1/search?query=${encodeURIComponent(
        productName
      )}&per_page=1`,
      {
        headers: {
          Authorization:
            process.env.PEXELS_API_KEY || "",
        },
      }
    );

    if (!response.ok) {
      return "";
    }

    const data = await response.json();

    if (
      data.photos &&
      data.photos.length > 0
    ) {
      return (
        data.photos[0]?.src?.large ||
        data.photos[0]?.src?.medium ||
        ""
      );
    }

    return "";
  } catch (error) {
    console.error(
      "PEXELS IMAGE ERROR:",
      error
    );

    return "";
  }
}

export async function GET() {
  try {
    const products =
      await prisma.product.findMany({
        orderBy: {
          id: "desc",
        },
      });

    return NextResponse.json(
      products
    );
  } catch (error) {
    console.error(
      "GET PRODUCTS ERROR:",
      error
    );

    return NextResponse.json(
      {
        error:
          "Failed to load products",
      },
      {
        status: 500,
      }
    );
  }
}

export async function POST(
  req: Request
) {
  try {
    const body = await req.json();

    let image =
      body.image?.trim() || "";

    if (!image) {
      image =
        await getProductImage(
          body.name
        );
    }

    const existing =
      await prisma.product.findFirst({
        where: {
          name: body.name,
        },
      });

    if (existing) {
      const updated =
        await prisma.product.update({
          where: {
            id: existing.id,
          },
          data: {
            category:
              body.category ||
              existing.category,

            pack:
              body.pack ||
              existing.pack,

            price: Number(
              body.price ||
                existing.price
            ),

            stock:
              Number(
                existing.stock
              ) +
              Number(
                body.stock || 0
              ),

            image:
              image ||
              existing.image,

            description:
              body.description ||
              existing.description,
          },
        });

      return NextResponse.json(
        updated
      );
    }

    const product =
      await prisma.product.create({
        data: {
          name: body.name,

          category:
            body.category ||
            "Vegetables",

          pack:
            body.pack ||
            "1 Pack",

          price: Number(
            body.price || 0
          ),

          stock: Number(
            body.stock || 0
          ),

          image,

          description:
            body.description || "",
        },
      });

    return NextResponse.json(
      product
    );
  } catch (error) {
    console.error(
      "PRODUCT CREATE ERROR:",
      error
    );

    return NextResponse.json(
      {
        error:
          "Failed to create product",
      },
      {
        status: 500,
      }
    );
  }
}

import { NextResponse } from "next/server";

    orderBy: {
      id: "desc",
    },
  });

  return NextResponse.json(data);
}

export async function POST(req: Request) {
  const body = await req.json();

  const item = await prisma.referral.create({
    data: {
      referrerName: body.referrerName,
      referrerPhone: body.referrerPhone,
      referredPhone: body.referredPhone,
      orderAmount: Number(body.orderAmount),
      creditEarned: Number(body.creditEarned),
      status: body.status || "Pending",
    },
  });

  return NextResponse.json(item);
}

==================== D:\D Drive\Desktop\CRM\FreshCut-CRM-Professional-Starter\app\api\rider-accept-order\route.ts ====================

import { NextResponse } from "next/server";
import { prisma } from "@/lib/prisma";

export async function POST(req: Request) {
  try {
    const body = await req.json();
    const assignmentId = Number(body?.assignmentId);

    if (!assignmentId) {
      return NextResponse.json(
        { success: false, error: "Assignment ID Required" },
        { status: 400 }
      );
    }

    const assignment = await prisma.deliveryAssignment.findUnique({
      where: { id: assignmentId },
    });

    if (!assignment) {
      return NextResponse.json(
        { success: false, error: "Assignment Not Found" },
        { status: 404 }
      );
    }

    if (assignment.status !== "Pending Acceptance") {
      return NextResponse.json(
        { success: false, error: `Order is already ${assignment.status}` },
        { status: 400 }
      );
    }

    const updated = await prisma.deliveryAssignment.update({
      where: { id: assignmentId },
      data: {
        status: "Accepted",
        acceptedAt: new Date(),
        adminAlert: false,
        alertSent: false,
      },
    });

    await prisma.deliveryBoy.update({
      where: { id: assignment.deliveryBoyId },
      data: { status: "Busy" },
    });

    const order = await prisma.order.findUnique({
      where: { id: assignment.orderId },
    });

    const rider = await prisma.deliveryBoy.findUnique({
      where: { id: assignment.deliveryBoyId },
    });

    return NextResponse.json({
      success: true,
      assignmentId,
      assignment: updated,
      customerNotification: order
        ? {
            customer: order.customer,
            phone: order.phone,
            message: `Fresh2Cook: Your order is on the way. Rider ${rider?.name || ""} (${rider?.mobile || ""}) has accepted your order. Your packet left for delivery ðŸšš`,
          }
        : null,
      message: "Order Accepted Successfully",
    });
  } catch (error: any) {
    console.error("RIDER ACCEPT ERROR:", error);

    return NextResponse.json(
      {
        success: false,
        error: error?.message || "Failed To Accept Order",
      },
      { status: 500 }
    );
  }
}

==================== D:\D Drive\Desktop\CRM\FreshCut-CRM-Professional-Starter\app\api\rider-complete-delivery\route.ts ====================

import { NextResponse } from "next/server";
import { prisma } from "@/lib/prisma";

export async function POST(request: Request) {
  try {
    const body = await request.json();

    const assignmentId = Number(body?.assignmentId);
    const otp = String(body?.otp || "").trim();

    if (!assignmentId || !otp) {
      return NextResponse.json(
        {
          success: false,
          error: "Assignment ID and OTP Required",
        },
        { status: 400 }
      );
    }

    const assignment = await prisma.deliveryAssignment.findUnique({
      where: { id: assignmentId },
    });

    if (!assignment) {
      return NextResponse.json(
        { success: false, error: "Assignment Not Found" },
        { status: 404 }
      );
    }

    if (assignment.status !== "Otp Sent") {
      return NextResponse.json(
        {
          success: false,
          error: "OTP is not active for this delivery",
        },
        { status: 400 }
      );
    }

    if (assignment.otp !== otp) {
      return NextResponse.json(
        { success: false, error: "Invalid OTP" },
        { status: 400 }
      );
    }

    const updated = await prisma.deliveryAssignment.update({
      where: { id: assignmentId },
      data: {
        status: "Delivered",
        deliveredAt: new Date(),
        earnings: 25,
      },
    });

    await prisma.order.update({
      where: { id: assignment.orderId },
      data: {
        status: "Delivered",
        deliveryOtp: null,
      },
    });

    await prisma.deliveryBoy.update({
      where: { id: assignment.deliveryBoyId },
      data: {
        status: "Available",
        completedDeliveries: {
          increment: 1,
        },
        earnings: {
          increment: 25,
        },
      },
    });

    return NextResponse.json({
      success: true,
      delivered: true,
      earning: 25,
      assignment: updated,
      message: "Delivery Completed Successfully",
    });
  } catch (error: any) {
    console.error("RIDER COMPLETE DELIVERY ERROR:", error);

    return NextResponse.json(
      {
        success: false,
        error: error?.message || "Delivery Failed",
      },
      { status: 500 }
    );
  }
}

==================== D:\D Drive\Desktop\CRM\FreshCut-CRM-Professional-Starter\app\api\rider-delivery-predictor\route.ts ====================

import { NextResponse } from "next/server";
import { prisma } from "@/lib/prisma";

export async function GET() {
  const total =
    await prisma.deliveryAssignment.count();

  const delivered =
    await prisma.deliveryAssignment.count({
      where: {
        status: "Delivered",
      },
    });

  const prediction =
    total === 0
      ? 0
      : Math.round(
          (delivered / total) * 100
        );

  return NextResponse.json({
    success: true,
    completionPrediction:
      prediction,
  });
}

==================== D:\D Drive\Desktop\CRM\FreshCut-CRM-Professional-Starter\app\api\rider-incentive-engine\route.ts ====================

import { NextResponse } from "next/server";
import { prisma } from "@/lib/prisma";

export async function GET() {
  try {
    const riders =
      await prisma.deliveryBoy.findMany();

    const incentives =
      riders.map((rider) => {
        const deliveries =
          rider.completedDeliveries || 0;

        let incentive = 0;

        if (deliveries >= 500)
          incentive = 5000;
        else if (
          deliveries >= 250
        )
          incentive = 1500;
        else if (
          deliveries >= 100
        )
          incentive = 500;

        return {
          riderId: rider.id,
          riderName:
            rider.name,
          deliveries,
          incentive,
        };
      });

    return NextResponse.json({
      success: true,
      incentives,
    });
  } catch (error) {
    return NextResponse.json(
      {
        error:
          "Failed To Load Incentives",
      },
      {
        status: 500,
      }
    );
  }
}

==================== D:\D Drive\Desktop\CRM\FreshCut-CRM-Professional-Starter\app\api\rider-orders\route.ts ====================

import { NextResponse } from "next/server";
import { prisma } from "@/lib/prisma";

export async function GET(req: Request) {
  try {
    const { searchParams } =
      new URL(req.url);

    const riderId = Number(
      searchParams.get("riderId")
    );

    if (!riderId) {
      return NextResponse.json(
        {
          success: false,
          error: "Rider ID required",
        },
        {
          status: 400,
        }
      );
    }

    const assignments =
      await prisma.deliveryAssignment.findMany({
        where: {
          deliveryBoyId: riderId,
        },
        orderBy: {
          assignedAt: "desc",
        },
      });

    const orderIds =
      assignments.map(
        (a) => a.orderId
      );

    const orders =
      orderIds.length > 0
        ? await prisma.order.findMany({
            where: {
              id: {
                in: orderIds,
              },
            },
          })
        : [];

    const orderMap = new Map(
      orders.map((o) => [o.id, o])
    );

    const result =
      assignments.map((a) => ({
        assignmentId: a.id,
        orderId: a.orderId,
        otp: a.otp,
        status: a.status,
        earnings: a.earnings,
        assignedAt: a.assignedAt,

        customer:
          orderMap.get(a.orderId)
            ?.customer || "",

        phone:
          orderMap.get(a.orderId)
            ?.phone || "",

        address:
          orderMap.get(a.orderId)
            ?.address || "",

        amount:
          orderMap.get(a.orderId)
            ?.amount || 0,
      }));

    return NextResponse.json({
      success: true,
      orders: result,
    });
  } catch (error: any) {
    console.error(
      "RIDER ORDERS ERROR",
      error
    );

    return NextResponse.json(
      {
        success: false,
        error: error?.message ?? "Internal Server Error",
      },
      {
        status: 500,
      }
    );
  }
}

==================== D:\D Drive\Desktop\CRM\FreshCut-CRM-Professional-Starter\app\api\rider-pickup-order\route.ts ====================

import { NextResponse } from "next/server";
import { prisma } from "@/lib/prisma";

export async function POST(req: Request) {
  try {
    const body = await req.json();
    const assignmentId = Number(body?.assignmentId);

    if (!assignmentId) {
      return NextResponse.json(
        { success: false, error: "Assignment ID Required" },
        { status: 400 }
      );
    }

    const assignment = await prisma.deliveryAssignment.findUnique({
      where: { id: assignmentId },
    });

    if (!assignment) {
      return NextResponse.json(
        { success: false, error: "Assignment Not Found" },
        { status: 404 }
      );
    }

    if (assignment.status !== "Accepted") {
      return NextResponse.json(
        {
          success: false,
          error: "Order must be Accepted before Pickup",
        },
        { status: 400 }
      );
    }

    const updated = await prisma.deliveryAssignment.update({
      where: { id: assignmentId },
      data: {
        status: "Picked Up",
        pickedAt: new Date(),
      },
    });

    await prisma.order.update({
      where: { id: assignment.orderId },
      data: { status: "Picked Up" },
    });

    return NextResponse.json({
      success: true,
      assignment: updated,
      message: "Order Picked Up Successfully",
    });
  } catch (error: any) {
    console.error("RIDER PICKUP ERROR:", error);

    return NextResponse.json(
      {
        success: false,
        error: error?.message || "Failed To Pickup Order",
      },
      { status: 500 }
    );
  }
}

==================== D:\D Drive\Desktop\CRM\FreshCut-CRM-Professional-Starter\app\api\rider-rating\route.ts ====================

import { NextResponse } from "next/server";
import { prisma } from "@/lib/prisma";

export async function POST(
  req: Request
) {
  try {
    const body =
      await req.json();

    const assignmentId =
      Number(
        body.assignmentId
      );

    const rating =
      Number(
        body.rating
      );

    if (
      !assignmentId
    ) {
      return NextResponse.json(
        {
          success: false,
          error:
            "Assignment ID Required",
        },
        {
          status: 400,
        }
      );
    }

    if (
      rating < 1 ||
      rating > 5
    ) {
      return NextResponse.json(
        {
          success: false,
          error:
            "Rating Must Be Between 1 And 5",
        },
        {
          status: 400,
        }
      );
    }

    const assignment =
      await prisma.deliveryAssignment.findUnique(
        {
          where: {
            id:
              assignmentId,
          },
        }
      );

    if (
      !assignment
    ) {
      return NextResponse.json(
        {
          success: false,
          error:
            "Assignment Not Found",
        },
        {
          status: 404,
        }
      );
    }

    if (
      assignment.status !==
      "Delivered"
    ) {
      return NextResponse.json(
        {
          success: false,
          error:
            "Order Not Delivered Yet",
        },
        {
          status: 400,
        }
      );
    }

    await prisma.deliveryAssignment.update(
      {
        where: {
          id:
            assignmentId,
        },
        data: {
          customerRating:
            rating,
        },
      }
    );

    const riderAssignments =
      await prisma.deliveryAssignment.findMany(
        {
          where: {
            deliveryBoyId:
              assignment.deliveryBoyId,
            customerRating: {
              not: null,
            },
          },
        }
      );

    const totalRatings =
      riderAssignments.reduce(
        (
          total,
          item
        ) =>
          total +
          (item.customerRating ||
            0),
        0
      );

    const averageRating =
      riderAssignments.length
        ? Number(
            (
              totalRatings /
              riderAssignments.length
            ).toFixed(1)
          )
        : 5;

    await prisma.deliveryBoy.update(
      {
        where: {
          id:
            assignment.deliveryBoyId,
        },
        data: {
          rating:
            averageRating,
        },
      }
    );

    return NextResponse.json({
      success: true,
      rating,
      averageRating,
      message:
        "Rating Submitted Successfully",
    });
  } catch (error) {
    console.error(
      "RIDER RATING ERROR:",
      error
    );

    return NextResponse.json(
      {
        success: false,
        error:
          "Failed To Submit Rating",
      },
      {
        status: 500,
      }
    );
  }
}



==================== D:\D Drive\Desktop\CRM\FreshCut-CRM-Professional-Starter\app\api\rider-register\route.ts ====================

import { NextResponse } from "next/server";
import { prisma } from "@/lib/prisma";

export async function POST(
  req: Request
) {
  try {
    const body =
      await req.json();

    const name =
      String(
        body.name || ""
      ).trim();

    const mobile =
      String(
        body.mobile || ""
      ).trim();

    const password =
      String(
        body.password || ""
      ).trim();

    const vehicle =
      String(
        body.vehicle || ""
      ).trim();

    if (
      !name ||
      !mobile ||
      !vehicle
    ) {
      return NextResponse.json(
        {
          success: false,
          error:
            "Name, Mobile And Vehicle Required",
        },
        {
          status: 400,
        }
      );
    }

    const existingRider =
      await prisma.deliveryBoy.findUnique(
        {
          where: {
            mobile,
          },
        }
      );

    if (
      existingRider
    ) {
      return NextResponse.json(
        {
          success: false,
          error:
            "Mobile Number Already Registered",
        },
        {
          status: 400,
        }
      );
    }

    const rider =
      await prisma.deliveryBoy.create(
        {
          data: {
            name,
            mobile,
            password,
            vehicle,

            address:
              body.address ||
              null,

            aadhaar:
              body.aadhaar ||
              null,

            photo:
              body.photo ||
              null,

            aadhaarFront:
              body.aadhaarFront ||
              null,

            aadhaarBack:
              body.aadhaarBack ||
              null,

            aadharFile:
              body.aadharFile ||
              null,

            licenseFile:
              body.licenseFile ||
              null,

            rcFile:
              body.rcFile ||
              null,

            approvalStatus:
              "Pending",

            status:
              "Offline",

            rating: 5,

            earnings: 0,

            completedDeliveries: 0,
          },
        }
      );

    return NextResponse.json({
      success: true,
      message:
        "Registration Submitted Successfully",

      rider: {
        id:
          rider.id,

        name:
          rider.name,

        mobile:
          rider.mobile,

        vehicle:
          rider.vehicle,

        approvalStatus:
          rider.approvalStatus,
      },
    });
  } catch (error) {
    console.error(
      "RIDER REGISTER ERROR:",
      error
    );

    return NextResponse.json(
      {
        success: false,
        error:
          "Registration Failed",
      },
      {
        status: 500,
      }
    );
  }
}

==================== D:\D Drive\Desktop\CRM\FreshCut-CRM-Professional-Starter\app\api\rider-start-delivery\route.ts ====================

import { NextResponse } from "next/server";
import { prisma } from "@/lib/prisma";

function generateOTP() {
  return Math.floor(1000 + Math.random() * 9000).toString();
}

export async function POST(request: Request) {
  try {
    const body = await request.json();
    const assignmentId = Number(body?.assignmentId);

    if (!assignmentId) {
      return NextResponse.json(
        { success: false, error: "Assignment ID Required" },
        { status: 400 }
      );
    }

    const assignment = await prisma.deliveryAssignment.findUnique({
      where: { id: assignmentId },
    });

    if (!assignment) {
      return NextResponse.json(
        { success: false, error: "Assignment Not Found" },
        { status: 404 }
      );
    }

    if (!["Accepted", "Picked Up"].includes(assignment.status)) {
      return NextResponse.json(
        {
          success: false,
          error: "Order must be accepted or picked up before delivery",
        },
        { status: 400 }
      );
    }

    const otp = generateOTP();

    const updated = await prisma.deliveryAssignment.update({
      where: { id: assignmentId },
      data: {
        status: "Otp Sent",
        otp,
      },
    });

    await prisma.order.update({
      where: { id: assignment.orderId },
      data: {
        deliveryOtp: otp,
        status: "Out For Delivery",
      },
    });

    const order = await prisma.order.findUnique({
      where: { id: assignment.orderId },
    });

    return NextResponse.json({
      success: true,
      assignmentId,
      status: updated.status,
      customerNotification: order
        ? {
            customer: order.customer,
            phone: order.phone,
            message: `Fresh2Cook Delivery OTP: ${otp}. Please share this OTP with the rider after receiving your order.`,
          }
        : null,
      message: "OTP sent to customer",
    });
  } catch (error: any) {
    console.error("START DELIVERY ERROR:", error);

    return NextResponse.json(
      {
        success: false,
        error: error?.message || "Failed To Start Delivery",
      },
      { status: 500 }
    );
  }
}

==================== D:\D Drive\Desktop\CRM\FreshCut-CRM-Professional-Starter\app\api\rider-success-engine\route.ts ====================

import { NextResponse } from "next/server";
import { prisma } from "@/lib/prisma";

export async function POST(
  req: Request
) {
  try {
    const body =
      await req.json();

    const assignmentId =
      Number(body.assignmentId);

    const otp =
      String(body.otp || "").trim();

    if (!assignmentId) {
      return NextResponse.json(
        {
          success: false,
          error:
            "Assignment ID required",
        },
        {
          status: 400,
        }
      );
    }

    const assignment =
      await prisma.deliveryAssignment.findUnique({
        where: {
          id: assignmentId,
        },
      });

    if (!assignment) {
      return NextResponse.json(
        {
          success: false,
          error:
            "Assignment not found",
        },
        {
          status: 404,
        }
      );
    }

    if (
      assignment.otp !== otp
    ) {
      return NextResponse.json(
        {
          success: false,
          error:
            "Invalid OTP",
        },
        {
          status: 400,
        }
      );
    }

    await prisma.deliveryAssignment.update({
      where: {
        id: assignmentId,
      },
      data: {
        status: "Delivered",
        deliveredAt:
          new Date(),
      },
    });

    await prisma.order.update({
      where: {
        id: assignment.orderId,
      },
      data: {
        status:
          "Delivered",
      },
    });

    await prisma.deliveryBoy.update({
      where: {
        id:
          assignment.deliveryBoyId,
      },
      data: {
        completedDeliveries: {
          increment: 1,
        },
        earnings: {
          increment:
            assignment.earnings,
        },
      },
    });

    return NextResponse.json({
      success: true,
      message:
        "Delivery completed successfully",
    });
  } catch (error: any) {
    console.error(
      "COMPLETE DELIVERY ERROR",
      error
    );

    return NextResponse.json(
      {
        success: false,
        error: error?.message ?? "Internal Server Error",
      },
      {
        status: 500,
      }
    );
  }
}

==================== D:\D Drive\Desktop\CRM\FreshCut-CRM-Professional-Starter\app\api\rider-toggle-status\route.ts ====================

import { NextResponse } from "next/server";
import { prisma } from "@/lib/prisma";

export async function POST(
  req: Request
) {
  try {
    const body =
      await req.json();

    const riderId =
      Number(
        body.riderId
      );

    const status =
      String(
        body.status || ""
      );

    if (
      !riderId
    ) {
      return NextResponse.json(
        {
          success: false,
          error:
            "Rider ID Required",
        },
        {
          status: 400,
        }
      );
    }

    if (
      ![
        "Online",
        "Offline",
      ].includes(
        status
      )
    ) {
      return NextResponse.json(
        {
          success: false,
          error:
            "Invalid Status",
        },
        {
          status: 400,
        }
      );
    }

    const rider =
      await prisma.deliveryBoy.findUnique(
        {
          where: {
            id:
              riderId,
          },
        }
      );

    if (
      !rider
    ) {
      return NextResponse.json(
        {
          success: false,
          error:
            "Rider Not Found",
        },
        {
          status: 404,
        }
      );
    }

    const updatedRider =
      await prisma.deliveryBoy.update(
        {
          where: {
            id:
              riderId,
          },
          data: {
            status,
            lastSeen:
              new Date(),
          },
        }
      );

    return NextResponse.json({
      success: true,
      message:
        `Rider ${status}`,
      rider: {
        id:
          updatedRider.id,
        name:
          updatedRider.name,
        status:
          updatedRider.status,
      },
    });
  } catch (error) {
    console.error(
      "TOGGLE STATUS ERROR:",
      error
    );

    return NextResponse.json(
      {
        success: false,
        error:
          "Failed To Update Status",
      },
      {
        status: 500,
      }
    );
  }
}

==================== D:\D Drive\Desktop\CRM\FreshCut-CRM-Professional-Starter\app\api\rider-verify-otp\route.ts ====================

import { NextResponse } from "next/server";
import { prisma } from "@/lib/prisma";

export async function POST(request: Request) {
  try {
    const body = await request.json();

    const assignmentId = Number(body?.assignmentId);
    const otp = String(body?.otp || "").trim();

    if (!assignmentId || !otp) {
      return NextResponse.json(
        {
          success: false,
          verified: false,
          error: "Assignment ID and OTP Required",
        },
        { status: 400 }
      );
    }

    const assignment = await prisma.deliveryAssignment.findUnique({
      where: { id: assignmentId },
    });

    if (!assignment) {
      return NextResponse.json(
        { success: false, verified: false, error: "Assignment Not Found" },
        { status: 404 }
      );
    }

    if (assignment.status !== "Otp Sent") {
      return NextResponse.json(
        {
          success: false,
          verified: false,
          error: "Please send delivery OTP first",
        },
        { status: 400 }
      );
    }

    const verified = assignment.otp === otp;

    if (!verified) {
      return NextResponse.json(
        {
          success: false,
          verified: false,
          error: "Invalid OTP",
        },
        { status: 400 }
      );
    }

    return NextResponse.json({
      success: true,
      verified: true,
      assignmentId,
      message: "OTP Verified Successfully",
    });
  } catch (error: any) {
    console.error("RIDER VERIFY OTP ERROR:", error);

    return NextResponse.json(
      {
        success: false,
        verified: false,
        error: error?.message || "OTP Verification Failed",
      },
      { status: 500 }
    );
  }
}

import { NextResponse } from "next/server";
import { prisma } from "@/lib/prisma";

export async function POST(req: Request) {
  try {
    const body = await req.json();

    const assignmentId = Number(body?.assignmentId);

    if (!assignmentId) {
      return NextResponse.json(
        { success: false, error: "Assignment ID Required" },
        { status: 400 }
      );
    }

    const assignment = await prisma.deliveryAssignment.findUnique({
      where: { id: assignmentId },
    });

    if (!assignment) {
      return NextResponse.json(

        { status: 404 }
      );
    }

    if (!["Picked Up", "Out For Delivery", "Otp Sent"].includes(assignment.status)) {
      return NextResponse.json(
        {
          success: false,

        },

      );

==================== D:\D Drive\Desktop\CRM\FreshCut-CRM-Professional-Starter\app\api\social\webhook\route.ts ====================

import { NextResponse } from "next/server";

export async function GET(req: Request) {
  const url = new URL(req.url);

  const mode = url.searchParams.get("hub.mode");
  const token = url.searchParams.get("hub.verify_token");
  const challenge = url.searchParams.get("hub.challenge");

  const verifyToken = process.env.WHATSAPP_VERIFY_TOKEN;

  if (
    mode === "subscribe" &&
    token &&
    verifyToken &&
    token === verifyToken
  ) {
    return new Response(challenge || "", {
      status: 200,
    });
  }

  return NextResponse.json(
    { error: "Webhook verification failed" },
    { status: 403 }
  );
}

export async function POST(req: Request) {
  try {
    const body = await req.json();

    console.log(
      "WhatsApp webhook:",
      JSON.stringify(body, null, 2)
    );

    return NextResponse.json({
      success: true,
    });
  } catch (error) {
    console.error("WhatsApp webhook error:", error);

    return NextResponse.json(
      { error: "Webhook processing failed" },
      { status: 500 }
    );
  }
}

import { NextResponse } from "next/server";
import { prisma } from "@/lib/prisma";

export async function GET(
  req: Request
) {
  try {
    const { searchParams } =
      new URL(req.url);

    const riderId = Number(
      searchParams.get(
        "riderId"
      )
    );

    if (!riderId) {
      return NextResponse.json(
        {
          success: false,
          error:
            "Rider ID Required",
        },
        {
          status: 400,
        }
      );
    }

    const rider =
      await prisma.deliveryBoy.findUnique(
        {
          where: {
            id: riderId,
          },
        }
      );

    if (!rider) {
      return NextResponse.json(
        {
          success: false,
          error:
            "Rider Not Found",
        },
        {
          status: 404,
        }
      );
    }

    return NextResponse.json({
      success: true,
      rider,
    });
  } catch (error) {
    console.error(
      "GET RIDER PROFILE ERROR:",
      error
    );

    return NextResponse.json(
      {
        success: false,
        error:
          "Failed To Load Profile",
      },
      {
        status: 500,
      }
    );
  }
}

export async function POST(
  req: Request
) {
  try {
    const body =
      await req.json();

    const riderId =
      Number(
        body.riderId
      );

    if (!riderId) {
      return NextResponse.json(
        {
          success: false,
          error:
            "Rider ID Required",
        },
        {
          status: 400,
        }
      );
    }

    const rider =
      await prisma.deliveryBoy.findUnique(
        {
          where: {
            id: riderId,
          },
        }
      );

    if (!rider) {
      return NextResponse.json(
        {
          success: false,
          error:
            "Rider Not Found",
        },
        {
          status: 404,
        }
      );
    }

    const updateData: any = {
      name:
        body.name ?? rider.name,

      vehicle:
        body.vehicle ?? rider.vehicle,

      address:
        body.address ?? rider.address,

      photo:
        body.photo ?? rider.photo,

      aadhaar:
        body.aadhaar ?? rider.aadhaar,

      aadhaarFront:
        body.aadhaarFront ?? rider.aadhaarFront,

      aadhaarBack:
        body.aadhaarBack ?? rider.aadhaarBack,

      aadharFile:
        body.aadharFile ?? rider.aadharFile,

      licenseFile:
        body.licenseFile ?? rider.licenseFile,

      rcFile:
        body.rcFile ?? rider.rcFile,
    };

    if (
      body.password &&
      String(
        body.password
      ).trim() !== ""
    ) {
      updateData.password =
        body.password;
    }

    const updatedRider =
      await prisma.deliveryBoy.update(
        {
          where: {
            id:
              riderId,
          },
          data:
            updateData,
        }
      );

    return NextResponse.json({
      success: true,
      rider:
        updatedRider,
      message:
        "Profile Updated Successfully",
    });
  } catch (error) {
    console.error(
      "UPDATE RIDER PROFILE ERROR:",
      error
    );

    return NextResponse.json(
      {
        success: false,
        error:
          "Failed To Update Profile",
      },
      {
        status: 500,
      }
    );
  }
}




==================== D:\D Drive\Desktop\CRM\FreshCut-CRM-Professional-Starter\app\api\upload-file\route.ts ====================

import { NextResponse } from "next/server";
import fs from "fs";
import path from "path";

export async function POST(
  req: Request
) {
  try {
    const formData =
      await req.formData();

    const file =
      formData.get(
        "file"
      ) as File;

    if (!file) {
      return NextResponse.json(
        {
          error:
            "No File Uploaded",
        },
        {
          status: 400,
        }
      );
    }

    const bytes =
      await file.arrayBuffer();

    const buffer =
      Buffer.from(bytes);

    const uploadDir =
      path.join(
        process.cwd(),
        "public",
        "uploads"
      );

    if (
      !fs.existsSync(
        uploadDir
      )
    ) {
      fs.mkdirSync(
        uploadDir,
        {
          recursive:
            true,
        }
      );
    }

    const fileName =
      `${Date.now()}-${file.name}`;

    const filePath =
      path.join(
        uploadDir,
        fileName
      );

    fs.writeFileSync(
      filePath,
      buffer
    );

    return NextResponse.json({
      success: true,
      url: `/uploads/${fileName}`,
    });
  } catch (error) {
    console.error(
      "UPLOAD FILE ERROR",
      error
    );

    return NextResponse.json(
      {
        error:
          "Upload Failed",
      },
      {
        status: 500,
      }
    );
  }
}
