==================== D:\D Drive\Desktop\CRM\FreshCut-CRM-Professional-Starter\app\api\route.ts ====================

import { NextResponse } from "next/server";
import { prisma } from "@/lib/prisma";

export async function GET() {
  try {
    const riders =
      await prisma.deliveryBoy.findMany();

    const assignments =
      await prisma.deliveryAssignment.findMany(
        {
          where: {
            status:
              "Delivered",
          },
        }
      );

    const leaderboard =
      riders.map(
        (rider) => {
          const deliveries =
            assignments.filter(
              (a) =>
                a.deliveryBoyId ===
                rider.id
            );

          const totalDeliveries =
            deliveries.length;

          const totalEarnings =
            deliveries.reduce(
              (
                total,
                current
              ) =>
                total +
                (current.earnings ||
                  0),
              0
            );

          const ratingCount =
            deliveries.filter(
              (d) =>
                d.customerRating
            ).length;

          const averageRating =
            ratingCount > 0
              ? Number(
                  (
                    deliveries.reduce(
                      (
                        total,
                        current
                      ) =>
                        total +
                        (current.customerRating ||
                          0),
                      0
                    ) /
                    ratingCount
                  ).toFixed(1)
                )
              : rider.rating;

          return {
            riderId:
              rider.id,

            riderName:
              rider.name,

            mobile:
              rider.mobile,

            completedDeliveries:
              totalDeliveries,

            earnings:
              totalEarnings,

            averageRating,

            score:
              totalDeliveries *
                10 +
              averageRating *
                20,
          };
        }
      );

    leaderboard.sort(
      (a, b) =>
        b.score -
        a.score
    );

    return NextResponse.json({
      success: true,
      leaderboard,
    });
  } catch (error) {
    console.error(
      "DELIVERY LEADERBOARD ERROR:",
      error
    );

    return NextResponse.json(
      {
        success: false,
        error:
          "Failed To Load Leaderboard",
      },
      {
        status: 500,
      }
    );
  }
}


==================== D:\D Drive\Desktop\CRM\FreshCut-CRM-Professional-Starter\app\cart\page.tsx ====================

"use client";

import { useEffect, useState } from "react";
import Link from "next/link";

type CartItem = {
  id: number;
  name: string;
  price: number;
  qty: number;
  stock?: number;
  image?: string;
  category?: string;
};

export default function CartPage() {
  const [items, setItems] = useState<CartItem[]>([]);

  useEffect(() => {
    loadCart();

    const handleCartUpdated = () => {
      loadCart();
    };

    window.addEventListener("cartUpdated", handleCartUpdated);
    window.addEventListener("storage", handleCartUpdated);

    return () => {
      window.removeEventListener(
        "cartUpdated",
        handleCartUpdated
      );
      window.removeEventListener(
        "storage",
        handleCartUpdated
      );
    };
  }, []);

  function loadCart() {
    try {
      const cart = JSON.parse(
        localStorage.getItem("freshcut-cart") || "[]"
      );

      setItems(
        Array.isArray(cart)
          ? cart.map((item: CartItem) => ({
              ...item,
              qty: Math.max(
                Number(item.qty || 1),
                1
              ),
            }))
          : []
      );
    } catch {
      setItems([]);
    }
  }

  function updateCart(cart: CartItem[]) {
    localStorage.setItem(
      "freshcut-cart",
      JSON.stringify(cart)
    );

    setItems([...cart]);

    window.dispatchEvent(
      new Event("cartUpdated")
    );
  }

  function increase(index: number) {
    const cart = [...items];
    const item = cart[index];

    const currentQty = Number(item.qty || 1);
    const stock = Number(item.stock || 0);

    if (stock > 0 && currentQty >= stock) {
      return;
    }

    cart[index] = {
      ...item,
      qty: currentQty + 1,
    };

    updateCart(cart);
  }

  function decrease(index: number) {
    const cart = [...items];
    const item = cart[index];

    const currentQty = Number(item.qty || 1);

    if (currentQty <= 1) {
      return;
    }

    cart[index] = {
      ...item,
      qty: currentQty - 1,
    };

    updateCart(cart);
  }

  function removeItem(index: number) {
    const cart = [...items];

    cart.splice(index, 1);

    updateCart(cart);
  }

  const totalItems = items.reduce(
    (sum, item) =>
      sum + Number(item.qty || 1),
    0
  );

  const subTotal = items.reduce(
    (sum, item) =>
      sum +
      Number(item.price || 0) *
        Number(item.qty || 1),
    0
  );

  const handlingCharge =
    subTotal > 0 ? 10 : 0;

  // FREE DELIVERY ABOVE Ã¢â€šÂ¹400
  const freeDeliveryTarget = 400;

  const deliveryCharge =
    subTotal >= freeDeliveryTarget
      ? 0
      : subTotal > 0
      ? 40
      : 0;

  const grandTotal =
    subTotal +
    handlingCharge +
    deliveryCharge;

  const remaining = Math.max(
    freeDeliveryTarget - subTotal,
    0
  );

  const progress = Math.min(
    (subTotal / freeDeliveryTarget) * 100,
    100
  );

  function proceed() {
    localStorage.setItem(
      "freshcut-subtotal",
      String(subTotal)
    );

    localStorage.setItem(
      "freshcut-handling",
      String(handlingCharge)
    );

    localStorage.setItem(
      "freshcut-delivery",
      String(deliveryCharge)
    );

    localStorage.setItem(
      "freshcut-total",
      String(grandTotal)
    );

    localStorage.setItem(
      "freshcut-items",
      String(totalItems)
    );

    window.location.href =
      "/customer-details";
  }

  return (
    <div className="max-w-6xl mx-auto px-4 py-6 pb-10">
      {/* HEADER */}
      <div className="flex flex-col md:flex-row md:items-center md:justify-between gap-3 mb-6">
        <div>
          <h1 className="text-3xl md:text-4xl font-bold">
            Shopping Cart
          </h1>

          <p className="text-gray-500 mt-1">
            {totalItems} item
            {totalItems !== 1 ? "s" : ""} in your cart
          </p>
        </div>

        {items.length > 0 && (
          <div className="text-right">
            {remaining > 0 ? (
              <p className="font-bold text-red-600">
                Add Ã¢â€šÂ¹{remaining} More For FREE Delivery
              </p>
            ) : (
              <p className="font-bold text-green-600">
                ÃƒÂ°Ã…Â¸Ã…Â½Ã¢â‚¬Â° FREE Delivery Unlocked
              </p>
            )}
          </div>
        )}
      </div>

      {/* EMPTY CART */}
      {items.length === 0 && (
        <div className="bg-white rounded-3xl shadow p-10 text-center">
          <div className="text-6xl mb-4">
            ÃƒÂ°Ã…Â¸Ã¢â‚¬ÂºÃ¢â‚¬â„¢
          </div>

          <h2 className="text-2xl font-bold mb-2">
            Your Cart is Empty
          </h2>

          <p className="text-gray-500 mb-6">
            Add some fresh products to continue.
          </p>

          <Link
            href="/products"
            className="inline-flex bg-green-600 hover:bg-green-700 text-white px-6 py-3 rounded-xl font-bold"
          >
            Shop Products
          </Link>
        </div>
      )}

      {items.length > 0 && (
        <>
          {/* FREE DELIVERY PROGRESS */}
          <div className="bg-white rounded-3xl p-5 shadow mb-6">
            <div className="flex justify-between items-center mb-3">
              <span className="font-semibold">
                Free Delivery Progress
              </span>

              <span className="font-bold text-green-700">
                Ã¢â€šÂ¹{subTotal} / Ã¢â€šÂ¹{freeDeliveryTarget}
              </span>
            </div>

            <div className="w-full bg-gray-200 h-3 rounded-full overflow-hidden">
              <div
                className="bg-green-500 h-3 rounded-full transition-all duration-500"
                style={{
                  width: `${progress}%`,
                }}
              />
            </div>
          </div>

          {/* CART ITEMS */}
          <div className="space-y-4 mb-6">
            {items.map((item, index) => {
              const itemQty = Number(
                item.qty || 1
              );

              const itemTotal =
                Number(item.price || 0) *
                itemQty;

              const stock = Number(
                item.stock || 0
              );

              return (
                <div
                  key={`${item.id}-${index}`}
                  className="bg-white rounded-3xl p-4 md:p-5 shadow"
                >
                  <div className="flex gap-4 items-center">
                    {/* IMAGE */}
                    <div className="w-24 h-24 md:w-28 md:h-28 rounded-2xl bg-gray-100 overflow-hidden shrink-0 flex items-center justify-center">
                      {item.image ? (
                        <img
                          src={item.image}
                          alt={item.name}
                          className="w-full h-full object-cover"
                        />
                      ) : (
                        <span className="text-gray-400 text-sm">
                          No Image
                        </span>
                      )}
                    </div>

                    {/* DETAILS */}
                    <div className="flex-1 min-w-0">
                      <h2 className="font-bold text-lg md:text-xl truncate">
                        {item.name}
                      </h2>

                      <p className="text-green-700 font-semibold mt-1">
                        Ã¢â€šÂ¹{item.price}
                      </p>

                      <div className="flex flex-wrap items-center gap-3 mt-3">
                        {/* QTY */}
                        <div className="flex items-center border rounded-xl overflow-hidden">
                          <button
                            type="button"
                            onClick={() =>
                              decrease(index)
                            }
                            disabled={itemQty <= 1}
                            className="w-10 h-10 font-bold text-xl hover:bg-gray-100 disabled:opacity-40"
                          >
                            ÃƒÂ¢Ã‹â€ Ã¢â‚¬â„¢

"use client";

import { useEffect, useState } from "react";
import Link from "next/link";

type CartItem = {
  id: number;
  name: string;
  price: number;
  qty: number;
  stock?: number;
  image?: string;
};

export default function CheckoutPage() {
  const [items, setItems] = useState<CartItem[]>([]);

  const [customer, setCustomer] = useState("");
  const [phone, setPhone] = useState("");
  const [address, setAddress] = useState("");

  useEffect(() => {
    try {
      const cart = JSON.parse(
        localStorage.getItem("freshcut-cart") || "[]"
      );

      setItems(Array.isArray(cart) ? cart : []);
    } catch {
      setItems([]);
    }
  }, []);

  const totalItems = items.reduce(
    (sum, item) =>
      sum + Number(item.qty || 1),
    0
  );

  const subTotal = items.reduce(
    (sum, item) =>
      sum +
      Number(item.price || 0) *
        Number(item.qty || 1),
    0
  );

  const handlingCharge =
    subTotal > 0 ? 10 : 0;

  const freeDeliveryTarget = 400;

  const deliveryCharge =
    subTotal >= freeDeliveryTarget
      ? 0
      : subTotal > 0
      ? 40
      : 0;

  const grandTotal =
    subTotal +
    handlingCharge +
    deliveryCharge;

  function continueToPayment() {
    if (!customer.trim()) {
      alert("Please enter your name.");
      return;
    }

    if (!phone.trim()) {
      alert("Please enter your mobile number.");
      return;
    }

    if (!/^[0-9]{10}$/.test(phone.trim())) {
      alert("Please enter a valid 10 digit mobile number.");
      return;
    }

    if (!address.trim()) {
      alert("Please enter your delivery address.");
      return;
    }

    if (items.length === 0) {
      alert("Your cart is empty.");
      return;
    }

    localStorage.setItem(
      "freshcut-customer",
      customer.trim()
    );

    localStorage.setItem(
      "freshcut-phone",
      phone.trim()
    );

    localStorage.setItem(
      "freshcut-address",
      address.trim()
    );

    localStorage.setItem(
      "freshcut-subtotal",
      String(subTotal)
    );

    localStorage.setItem(
      "freshcut-handling",
      String(handlingCharge)
    );

    localStorage.setItem(
      "freshcut-delivery",
      String(deliveryCharge)
    );

    localStorage.setItem(
      "freshcut-total",
      String(grandTotal)
    );

    localStorage.setItem(
      "freshcut-items",
      String(totalItems)
    );

    localStorage.setItem(
      "freshcut-order-items",
      JSON.stringify(items)
    );

    localStorage.setItem(
      "freshcut-payment-success-message",
      "Your order has been placed successfully."
    );

    window.location.href = "/payment";
  }

  if (items.length === 0) {
    return (
      <div className="max-w-3xl mx-auto px-4 py-10">
        <div className="bg-white rounded-3xl shadow p-8 text-center">
          <div className="text-5xl mb-4">
            ÃƒÂ°Ã…Â¸Ã¢â‚¬ÂºÃ¢â‚¬â„¢
          </div>

          <h1 className="text-3xl font-bold mb-3">
            Your Cart is Empty
          </h1>

          <p className="text-gray-500 mb-6">
            Please add products before checkout.
          </p>

          <Link
            href="/products"
            className="inline-flex bg-green-600 hover:bg-green-700 text-white px-6 py-3 rounded-xl font-bold"
          >
            Go To Products
          </Link>
        </div>
      </div>
    );
  }

  return (
    <div className="max-w-6xl mx-auto px-4 py-8 pb-20">
      <h1 className="text-3xl md:text-4xl font-bold mb-8">
        Checkout
      </h1>

      <div className="grid lg:grid-cols-3 gap-6">
        {/* CUSTOMER DETAILS */}
        <div className="lg:col-span-2">
          <div className="bg-white rounded-3xl shadow p-6">
            <h2 className="text-2xl font-bold mb-6">
              Delivery Details
            </h2>

            <div className="space-y-5">
              <div>
                <label className="block font-semibold mb-2">
                  Full Name
                </label>

                <input
                  type="text"
                  value={customer}
                  onChange={(e) =>
                    setCustomer(e.target.value)
                  }
                  placeholder="Enter your full name"
                  className="w-full border border-gray-300 rounded-xl px-4 py-3 outline-none focus:border-green-600"
                />
              </div>

              <div>
                <label className="block font-semibold mb-2">
                  Mobile Number
                </label>

                <input
                  type="tel"
                  value={phone}
                  maxLength={10}
                  onChange={(e) =>
                    setPhone(
                      e.target.value.replace(
                        /\D/g,
                        ""
                      )
                    )
                  }
                  placeholder="10 digit mobile number"
                  className="w-full border border-gray-300 rounded-xl px-4 py-3 outline-none focus:border-green-600"
                />
              </div>

              <div>
                <label className="block font-semibold mb-2">
                  Delivery Address
                </label>

                <textarea
                  value={address}
                  onChange={(e) =>
                    setAddress(e.target.value)
                  }
                  placeholder="House/Flat No., Society, Street, Dwarka"
                  rows={5}
                  className="w-full border border-gray-300 rounded-xl px-4 py-3 outline-none focus:border-green-600 resize-none"
                />
              </div>
            </div>
          </div>
        </div>

        {/* ORDER SUMMARY */}
        <div>
          <div className="bg-white rounded-3xl shadow p-6 sticky top-24">
            <h2 className="text-2xl font-bold mb-5">
              Order Summary
            </h2>

            <div className="space-y-4">
              {items.map((item, index) => (
                <div
                  key={`${item.id}-${index}`}
                  className="flex justify-between gap-3"
                >
                  <div className="min-w-0">
                    <p className="font-semibold truncate">
                      {item.name}
                    </p>

                    <p className="text-sm text-gray-500">
                      Qty: {Number(item.qty || 1)}
                    </p>
                  </div>

                  <p className="font-semibold whitespace-nowrap">
                    Ã¢â€šÂ¹
                    {Number(item.price || 0) *
                      Number(item.qty || 1)}
                  </p>
                </div>
              ))}
            </div>

            <hr className="my-5" />

            <div className="flex justify-between mb-3">
              <span>Products Total</span>
              <span>Ã¢â€šÂ¹{subTotal}</span>
            </div>

            <div className="flex justify-between mb-3">
              <span>Handling Charges</span>
              <span>Ã¢â€šÂ¹{handlingCharge}</span>
            </div>

            <div className="flex justify-between mb-3">
              <span>Delivery Charges</span>

              <span
                className={
                  deliveryCharge === 0
                    ? "text-green-600 font-bold"
                    : ""
                }
              >
                {deliveryCharge === 0
                  ? "FREE"
                  : `Ã¢â€šÂ¹${deliveryCharge}`}
              </span>
            </div>

            <hr className="my-4" />

            <div className="flex justify-between text-2xl font-bold text-green-700">
              <span>Total</span>
              <span>Ã¢â€šÂ¹{grandTotal}</span>
            </div>

            {subTotal < freeDeliveryTarget && (
              <p className="text-sm text-red-600 font-semibold mt-4">
                Add Ã¢â€šÂ¹
                {freeDeliveryTarget - subTotal}
                {" "}more for FREE Delivery
              </p>
            )}

            {subTotal >= freeDeliveryTarget && (
              <p className="text-sm text-green-600 font-semibold mt-4">
                ÃƒÂ°Ã…Â¸Ã…Â½Ã¢â‚¬Â° FREE Delivery Unlocked
              </p>
            )}

            <button
              type="button"

            >

==================== D:\D Drive\Desktop\CRM\FreshCut-CRM-Professional-Starter\app\delivery\assignments\page.tsx ====================

"use client";

import { useEffect, useState } from "react";

export default function Page() {
  const [assignments, setAssignments] =
    useState<any[]>([]);

  useEffect(() => {
    load();
  }, []);

  async function load() {
    const res =
      await fetch(
        "/api/delivery-assignments"
      );

    const json =
      await res.json();

    setAssignments(
      json.assignments || []
    );
  }

  async function updateStatus(
    id: number,
    action: string
  ) {
    await fetch(
      `/api/delivery-assignments/${id}`,
      {
        method: "POST",
        headers: {
          "Content-Type":
            "application/json",
        },
        body: JSON.stringify({
          action,
        }),
      }
    );

    load();
  }

  return (
    <div className="p-6">

      <div className="flex items-center justify-between mb-6">
        <h1 className="text-3xl font-bold">
          Delivery Assignments
        </h1>

        <button
          onClick={load}
          className="bg-blue-600 text-white px-4 py-2 rounded-lg"
        >
          Refresh
        </button>
      </div>

      <div className="bg-white rounded-xl shadow overflow-auto">

        <table className="w-full">

          <thead>
            <tr>

              <th className="p-3 text-left">
                Order
              </th>

              <th className="p-3 text-left">
                Customer
              </th>

              <th className="p-3 text-left">
                Status
              </th>

              <th className="p-3 text-left">
                Pickup
              </th>

              <th className="p-3 text-left">
                Delivery
              </th>

              <th className="p-3 text-left">
                OTP
              </th>

              <th className="p-3 text-left">
                Earnings
              </th>

              <th className="p-3 text-left">
                Actions
              </th>

            </tr>
          </thead>

          <tbody>

            {assignments.map(
              (a) => (
                <tr
                  key={a.id}
                  className="border-b"
                >

                  <td className="p-3">
                    #{a.orderId}
                  </td>

                  <td className="p-3">
                    <div>
                      {a.order?.customerName ||
                        "-"}
                    </div>

                    <div className="text-xs text-gray-500">
                      {a.order?.customerMobile ||
                        "-"}
                    </div>
                  </td>

                  <td className="p-3">
                    {a.status}
                  </td>

                  <td className="p-3">
                    {a.pickedAt
                      ? new Date(
                          a.pickedAt
                        ).toLocaleString()
                      : "-"}
                  </td>

                  <td className="p-3">
                    {a.deliveredAt
                      ? new Date(
                          a.deliveredAt
                        ).toLocaleString()
                      : "-"}
                  </td>

                  <td className="p-3">

                    {a.status ===
                    "Delivered"
                      ? "Verified"
                      : a.status ===
                        "Otp Sent"
                      ? "Waiting"
                      : "-"}

                  </td>

                  <td className="p-3">
                    ?
                    {a.status ===
                    "Delivered"
                      ? a.earnings || 25
                      : 0}
                  </td>

                  <td className="p-3">

                    <div className="flex gap-2 flex-wrap">

                      {a.status ===
                        "Pending Acceptance" && (
                        <>
                          <button
                            onClick={() =>
                              updateStatus(
                                a.id,
                                "accept"
                              )
                            }
                            className="bg-green-600 text-white px-3 py-1 rounded"
                          >
                            Accept
                          </button>

                          <button
                            onClick={() =>
                              updateStatus(
                                a.id,
                                "reject"
                              )
                            }
                            className="bg-red-600 text-white px-3 py-1 rounded"
                          >
                            Reject
                          </button>
                        </>
                      )}

                      {a.status ===
                        "Accepted" && (
                        <button
                          onClick={() =>
                            updateStatus(
                              a.id,
                              "pickup"
                            )
                          }
                          className="bg-blue-600 text-white px-3 py-1 rounded"
                        >
                          Picked Up
                        </button>
                      )}

                      {a.status ===
                        "Picked Up" && (
                        <button
                          onClick={() =>
                            updateStatus(
                              a.id,
                              "sendOtp"
                            )
                          }
                          className="bg-orange-600 text-white px-3 py-1 rounded"
                        >
                          Send OTP
                        </button>
                      )}

                      {a.status ===
                        "Otp Sent" && (
                        <button
                          onClick={() =>
                            updateStatus(
                              a.id,
                              "verifyOtp"
                            )
                          }
                          className="bg-purple-600 text-white px-3 py-1 rounded"
                        >
                          Deliver
                        </button>
                      )}

                    </div>

                  </td>

                </tr>
              )
            )}

          </tbody>

        </table>

      </div>

    </div>
  );
}

==================== D:\D Drive\Desktop\CRM\FreshCut-CRM-Professional-Starter\app\delivery\change-password\page.tsx ====================

"use client";

import { useState } from "react";

export default function ChangePasswordPage() {
  const [oldPassword, setOldPassword] =
    useState("");

  const [newPassword, setNewPassword] =
    useState("");

  const [
    confirmPassword,
    setConfirmPassword,
  ] = useState("");

  const [loading, setLoading] =
    useState(false);

  async function changePassword() {
    const session =
      localStorage.getItem(
        "delivery-session"
      );

    if (!session) {
      alert(
        "Please Login Again"
      );

      window.location.href =
        "/delivery/login";

      return;
    }

    const rider =
      JSON.parse(session);

    if (
      !oldPassword ||
      !newPassword ||
      !confirmPassword
    ) {
      alert(
        "Fill All Fields"
      );
      return;
    }

    if (
      newPassword !==
      confirmPassword
    ) {
      alert(
        "Passwords Do Not Match"
      );
      return;
    }

    if (
      newPassword.length < 4
    ) {
      alert(
        "Password Must Be At Least 4 Characters"
      );
      return;
    }

    try {
      setLoading(true);

      const res =
        await fetch(
          "/api/delivery-change-password",
          {
            method: "POST",
            headers: {
              "Content-Type":
                "application/json",
            },
            body: JSON.stringify({
              riderId:
                rider.id,
              oldPassword,
              newPassword,
            }),
          }
        );

      const data =
        await res.json();

      if (!res.ok) {
        alert(
          data.error ||
            "Failed"
        );
        return;
      }

      alert(
        "Password Changed Successfully"
      );

      setOldPassword("");
      setNewPassword("");
      setConfirmPassword("");

      window.location.href =
        "/delivery/profile";
    } catch (error) {
      console.error(error);

      alert(
        "Something Went Wrong"
      );
    } finally {
      setLoading(false);
    }
  }

  return (
    <div className="min-h-screen bg-gray-100 p-5">

      <div className="max-w-xl mx-auto">

        <div className="bg-white rounded-3xl shadow p-8">

          <h1 className="text-3xl font-bold mb-8">
            Change Password
          </h1>

          <div className="space-y-5">

            <div>
              <label className="font-medium">
                Current Password
              </label>

              <input
                type="password"
                value={oldPassword}
                onChange={(e) =>
                  setOldPassword(
                    e.target.value
                  )
                }
                className="w-full mt-2 border p-3 rounded-xl"
                placeholder="Current Password"
              />
            </div>

            <div>
              <label className="font-medium">
                New Password
              </label>

              <input
                type="password"
                value={newPassword}
                onChange={(e) =>
                  setNewPassword(
                    e.target.value
                  )
                }
                className="w-full mt-2 border p-3 rounded-xl"
                placeholder="New Password"
              />
            </div>

            <div>
              <label className="font-medium">
                Confirm Password
              </label>

              <input
                type="password"
                value={
                  confirmPassword
                }
                onChange={(e) =>
                  setConfirmPassword(
                    e.target.value
                  )
                }
                className="w-full mt-2 border p-3 rounded-xl"
                placeholder="Confirm Password"
              />
            </div>

            <button
              onClick={
                changePassword
              }
              disabled={loading}
              className="w-full bg-green-600 text-white py-3 rounded-xl font-bold"
            >
              {loading
                ? "Updating..."
                : "Update Password"}
            </button>

            <button
              onClick={() =>
                (window.location.href =
                  "/delivery/profile")
              }
              className="w-full bg-gray-200 py-3 rounded-xl font-bold"
            >
              Back To Profile
            </button>

          </div>

        </div>

      </div>

    </div>
  );
}

"use client";

import Link from "next/link";
import { useEffect, useState } from "react";

export default function DeliveryDashboardPage() {
  const [data, setData] =
    useState<any>(null);

  useEffect(() => {
    loadDashboard();
  }, []);

  async function loadDashboard() {
    try {
      const res = await fetch(
        "/api/admin-delivery-dashboard"
      );

      const json =
        await res.json();

      setData(json);
    } catch (error) {
      console.error(error);
    }
  }

  if (!data) {
    return (
      <div className="p-6">
        Loading...
      </div>
    );
  }

  return (
    <div className="p-6">

      <div className="flex items-center justify-between mb-6">

        <h1 className="text-3xl font-bold">
          Delivery Dashboard
        </h1>

        <Link
          href="/delivery/assignments"
          className="bg-blue-600 text-white px-5 py-3 rounded-lg"
        >
          Open Assignments
        </Link>

      </div>

      <div className="grid md:grid-cols-4 lg:grid-cols-8 gap-4">

        <Card
          title="Total Riders"
          value={data.totalRiders}
        />

        <Card
          title="Online Riders"
          value={data.onlineRiders}
        />

        <Card
          title="Orders"
          value={data.totalOrders}
        />

        <Card
          title="Delivered"
          value={data.deliveredOrders}
        />

        <Card
          title="Pending"
          value={data.pendingOrders}
        />

        <Card
          title="Assignments"
          value={data.assignments}
        />

        <Card
          title="Pending Accept"
          value={data.pendingAssignments}
        />

        <Card
          title="Delivered Jobs"
          value={data.deliveredAssignments}
        />

      </div>

      <div className="mt-8 bg-white rounded-xl shadow p-6">

        <h2 className="text-xl font-bold mb-2">
          Rider Control Center
        </h2>

        <p className="text-gray-600 mb-5">
          Accept ? Pickup ?
          Send OTP ?
          Deliver
        </p>

        <Link
          href="/delivery/assignments"
          className="bg-green-600 text-white px-5 py-3 rounded-lg inline-block"
        >
          Manage Rider Assignments
        </Link>

      </div>

    </div>
  );
}

function Card({
  title,
  value,
}: any) {
  return (
    <div className="bg-white shadow rounded-xl p-5">

      <p className="text-gray-500">
        {title}
      </p>

      <h2 className="text-3xl font-bold mt-2">
        {value || 0}
      </h2>

    </div>
  );
}

==================== D:\D Drive\Desktop\CRM\FreshCut-CRM-Professional-Starter\app\delivery\location-tracker\page.tsx ====================

"use client";

import { useEffect, useState } from "react";

export default function LocationTrackerPage() {
  const [status, setStatus] =
    useState("Starting GPS...");

  const [coords, setCoords] =
    useState<any>(null);

  const [speed, setSpeed] =
    useState(0);

  useEffect(() => {
    startTracking();
  }, []);

  function startTracking() {
    const session =
      localStorage.getItem(
        "delivery-session"
      );

    if (!session) {
      setStatus(
        "Login Required"
      );
      return;
    }

    const data =
      JSON.parse(session);

    const rider =
      data.rider || data;

    if (
      !navigator.geolocation
    ) {
      setStatus(
        "GPS Not Supported"
      );
      return;
    }

    navigator.geolocation.watchPosition(
      async (position) => {
        const latitude =
          position.coords.latitude;

        const longitude =
          position.coords.longitude;

        const currentSpeed =
          Math.round(
            (position.coords.speed ||
              0) * 3.6
          );

        setCoords({
          latitude,
          longitude,
        });

        setSpeed(
          currentSpeed
        );

        try {
          await fetch(
            "/api/delivery-location-update",
            {
              method: "POST",
              headers: {
                "Content-Type":
                  "application/json",
              },
              body: JSON.stringify({
                riderId:
                  rider.id,
                latitude,
                longitude,
                speed:
                  currentSpeed,
              }),
            }
          );

          setStatus(
            "Live Tracking Active"
          );
        } catch {
          setStatus(
            "Update Failed"
          );
        }
      },
      () => {
        setStatus(
          "Location Permission Denied"
        );
      },
      {
        enableHighAccuracy: true,
        maximumAge: 5000,
        timeout: 10000,
      }
    );
  }

  return (
    <div className="max-w-4xl mx-auto">

      <div className="bg-white rounded-3xl shadow p-8">

        <h1 className="text-3xl font-bold mb-6">
          Live GPS Tracking
        </h1>

        <div className="grid md:grid-cols-3 gap-4">

          <div className="bg-green-50 rounded-2xl p-5">
            <p className="text-sm text-gray-500">
              Status
            </p>

            <h2 className="font-bold text-green-600 mt-2">
              {status}
            </h2>
          </div>

          <div className="bg-blue-50 rounded-2xl p-5">
            <p className="text-sm text-gray-500">
              Speed
            </p>

            <h2 className="font-bold text-blue-600 mt-2">
              {speed} km/h
            </h2>
          </div>

          <div className="bg-purple-50 rounded-2xl p-5">
            <p className="text-sm text-gray-500">
              GPS
            </p>

            <h2 className="font-bold text-purple-600 mt-2">
              Active
            </h2>
          </div>

        </div>

        {coords && (
          <div className="mt-8 bg-gray-50 rounded-2xl p-6">

            <div className="mb-4">
              <strong>
                Latitude:
              </strong>{" "}
              {coords.latitude}
            </div>

            <div>
              <strong>
                Longitude:
              </strong>{" "}
              {coords.longitude}
            </div>

          </div>
        )}

      </div>

    </div>
  );
}



==================== D:\D Drive\Desktop\CRM\FreshCut-CRM-Professional-Starter\app\delivery\login\page.tsx ====================

"use client";

import { useState } from "react";

export default function DeliveryLoginPage() {
  const [mobile, setMobile] =
    useState("");

  const [password,
    setPassword] =
    useState("");

  const [loading,
    setLoading] =
    useState(false);

  async function login() {
    if (
      !mobile ||
      !password
    ) {
      alert(
        "Enter Mobile & Password"
      );
      return;
    }

    try {
      setLoading(true);

      const res =
        await fetch(
          "/api/delivery-login",
          {
            method: "POST",
            headers: {
              "Content-Type":
                "application/json",
            },
            body: JSON.stringify({
              mobile,
              password,
            }),
          }
        );

      const data =
        await res.json();

      if (!res.ok) {
        alert(
          data.message
        );
        return;
      }

      localStorage.setItem(
        "delivery-rider",
        JSON.stringify(
          data.rider
        )
      );

      alert(
        "Login Successful"
      );

      window.location.href =
        "/delivery/dashboard";
    } catch (error) {
      console.error(error);

      alert(
        "Login Failed"
      );
    } finally {
      setLoading(false);
    }
  }

  return (
    <div className="max-w-md mx-auto p-6">

      <div className="bg-white border shadow rounded-3xl p-8 mt-10">

        <h1 className="text-3xl font-bold mb-2">
          Delivery Partner Login
        </h1>

        <p className="text-gray-500 mb-6">
          Login To Start Deliveries
        </p>

        <input
          type="text"
          placeholder="Mobile Number"
          value={mobile}
          onChange={(e) =>
            setMobile(
              e.target.value
            )
          }
          className="w-full border p-3 rounded-xl mb-4"
        />

        <input
          type="password"
          placeholder="Password"
          value={password}
          onChange={(e) =>
            setPassword(
              e.target.value
            )
          }
          className="w-full border p-3 rounded-xl mb-6"
        />

        <button
          onClick={login}
          disabled={loading}
          className="w-full bg-green-600 text-white py-4 rounded-xl font-bold"
        >
          {loading
            ? "Please Wait..."
            : "Login"}
        </button>

      </div>

    </div>
  );
}

"use client";

import { useEffect, useState } from "react";
import FileUploader from "@/components/FileUploader";

export default function DeliveryProfilePage() {
  const [rider, setRider] =
    useState<any>(null);

  const [vehicle, setVehicle] =
    useState("");

  const [photo, setPhoto] =
    useState("");

  const [aadharFile, setAadharFile] =
    useState("");

  const [licenseFile, setLicenseFile] =
    useState("");

  const [rcFile, setRcFile] =
    useState("");

  const [password, setPassword] =
    useState("");

  const [loading, setLoading] =
    useState(false);

  useEffect(() => {
    loadProfile();
  }, []);

  async function loadProfile() {
    const session =
      localStorage.getItem(
        "delivery-session"
      );

    if (!session) {
      window.location.href =
        "/delivery/login";
      return;
    }

    const data =
      JSON.parse(session);

    const riderData =
      data.rider || data;

    setRider(riderData);

    setVehicle(
      riderData.vehicle || ""
    );

    setPhoto(
      riderData.photo || ""
    );

    setAadharFile(
      riderData.aadharFile || ""
    );

    setLicenseFile(
      riderData.licenseFile || ""
    );

    setRcFile(
      riderData.rcFile || ""
    );
  }

  async function saveProfile() {
    if (!rider?.id) return;

    try {
      setLoading(true);

      const res =
        await fetch(
          "/api/update-rider-profile",
          {
            method: "POST",
            headers: {
              "Content-Type":
                "application/json",
            },
            body: JSON.stringify({
              riderId:
                rider.id,
              vehicle,
              photo,
              aadharFile,
              licenseFile,
              rcFile,
              password,
            }),
          }
        );

      const data =
        await res.json();

      if (!res.ok) {
        alert(
          data.error ||
            "Update Failed"
        );
        return;
      }

      alert(
        "Profile Updated Successfully"
      );
    } catch (error) {
      console.error(error);

      alert(
        "Update Failed"
      );
    } finally {
      setLoading(false);
    }
  }

  return (
    <div className="min-h-screen bg-gray-100 p-6">

      <div className="max-w-4xl mx-auto bg-white rounded-3xl shadow p-8">

        <h1 className="text-3xl font-bold mb-8">
          Rider Profile
        </h1>

        <div className="grid md:grid-cols-2 gap-6">

          <div>
            <label className="block font-semibold mb-2">
              Name
            </label>

            <input
              value={
                rider?.name || ""
              }
              disabled
              className="w-full border p-3 rounded-xl bg-gray-100"
            />
          </div>

          <div>
            <label className="block font-semibold mb-2">
              Mobile Number
            </label>

            <input
              value={
                rider?.mobile || ""
              }
              disabled
              className="w-full border p-3 rounded-xl bg-gray-100"
            />
          </div>

          <div>
            <label className="block font-semibold mb-2">
              Vehicle Number
            </label>

            <input
              value={vehicle}
              onChange={(e) =>
                setVehicle(
                  e.target.value
                )
              }
              className="w-full border p-3 rounded-xl"
            />
          </div>

          <div>
            <label className="block font-semibold mb-2">
              New Password
            </label>

            <input
              type="password"
              value={password}
              onChange={(e) =>
                setPassword(
                  e.target.value
                )
              }
              placeholder="Leave Empty If No Change"
              className="w-full border p-3 rounded-xl"
            />
          </div>

        </div>

        <div className="mt-8">

          <h2 className="text-2xl font-bold mb-5">
            Profile Photo
          </h2>

          <FileUploader
            label="Upload Profile Photo"
            onUploaded={
              setPhoto
            }
          />

          {photo && (
            <img
              src={photo}
              alt="Profile"
              className="w-32 h-32 rounded-xl mt-4 object-cover border"
            />
          )}

        </div>

        <div className="mt-8">

          <h2 className="text-2xl font-bold mb-5">
            Documents
          </h2>

          <div className="space-y-6">

            <FileUploader
              label="Aadhaar Card"
              onUploaded={
                setAadharFile
              }
            />

            {aadharFile && (
              <a

                  aadharFile
                }
                target="_blank"
                className="text-blue-600"
              >
                View Aadhaar
              </a>
            )}

            <FileUploader
              label="Driving License"
              onUploaded={
                setLicenseFile
              }
            />

            {licenseFile && (

                setRcFile

            />

            {rcFile && (

    address2: "",

  });

      !form.name ||

      !form.vehicle
    ) {

        "Please Fill Required Fields"
      );

        await fetch(
          "/api/delivery-register",
          {
            method: "POST",
            headers: {
              "Content-Type":
                "application/json",
            },
            body: JSON.stringify(
              form
            ),
          }
        );

        await res.json();

        alert(
          data.message ||
            "Registration Failed"
        );

"use client";

import { useState } from "react";
import FileUploader from "@/components/FileUploader";

export default function UploadDocumentsPage() {
  const [aadharFile, setAadharFile] =
    useState("");

  const [licenseFile, setLicenseFile] =
    useState("");

  const [rcFile, setRcFile] =
    useState("");

  const [photo, setPhoto] =
    useState("");

  const [loading, setLoading] =
    useState(false);

  async function saveDocuments() {
    const session =
      localStorage.getItem(
        "delivery-session"
      );

    if (!session) {
      alert(
        "Please Login First"
      );
      return;
    }

    const rider =
      JSON.parse(
        session
      );

    try {
      setLoading(true);

      const res =
        await fetch(
          "/api/upload-rider-document",
          {
            method: "POST",
            headers: {
              "Content-Type":
                "application/json",
            },
            body: JSON.stringify({
              riderId:
                rider.id,

              aadharFile,

              licenseFile,

              rcFile,

              photo,
            }),
          }
        );

      const data =
        await res.json();

      if (!res.ok) {
        alert(
          data.error
        );
        return;
      }

      alert(
        "Documents Uploaded Successfully"
      );
    } catch (error) {
      console.error(error);

      alert(
        "Upload Failed"
      );
    } finally {
      setLoading(false);
    }
  }

  return (
    <div className="min-h-screen bg-gray-100 p-6">

      <div className="max-w-2xl mx-auto bg-white rounded-3xl shadow p-8">

        <h1 className="text-3xl font-bold mb-6">
          Upload Documents
        </h1>

        <div className="space-y-5">

          <FileUploader
            label="Aadhar Card"
            onUploaded={
              setAadharFile
            }
          />

          {aadharFile && (
            <p className="text-green-600 text-sm">
              Uploaded
            </p>
          )}

          <FileUploader
            label="Driving License"
            onUploaded={
              setLicenseFile
            }
          />

          {licenseFile && (
            <p className="text-green-600 text-sm">
              Uploaded
            </p>
          )}

          <FileUploader
            label="Vehicle RC"
            onUploaded={
              setRcFile
            }
          />

          {rcFile && (
            <p className="text-green-600 text-sm">
              Uploaded
            </p>
          )}

          <FileUploader
            label="Profile Photo"
            onUploaded={
              setPhoto
            }
          />

          {photo && (
            <img
              src={photo}
              alt="Profile"
              className="w-28 h-28 rounded-xl border object-cover"
            />
          )}

              saveDocuments

          )
        )}
      </div>
    </div>
  );

==================== D:\D Drive\Desktop\CRM\FreshCut-CRM-Professional-Starter\app\order-tracking\page.tsx ====================

"use client";

import { useEffect, useState } from "react";

type Order = {
  id: number;
  customer: string;
  phone?: string | null;
  address?: string | null;
  amount: number;
  status: string;
  createdAt: string;
};

const steps = [
  "Pending",
  "Confirmed",
  "Packed",
  "Out for Delivery",
  "Delivered",
];

export default function OrderTrackingPage() {
  const [order, setOrder] =
    useState<Order | null>(null);

  const [loading, setLoading] =
    useState(true);

  const [error, setError] =
    useState("");

  useEffect(() => {
    loadOrder();
  }, []);

  async function loadOrder() {
    try {
      const orderId = Number(
        localStorage.getItem(
          "freshcut-order-id"
        ) || 0
      );

      if (!orderId) {
        setError(
          "No recent order found."
        );
        return;
      }

      const response =
        await fetch("/api/orders", {
          cache: "no-store",
        });

      const data =
        await response.json();

      if (!response.ok) {
        throw new Error(
          data?.error ||
            "Failed to load order"
        );
      }

      const found =
        Array.isArray(data)
          ? data.find(
              (item: Order) =>
                item.id === orderId
            )
          : null;

      if (!found) {
        setError(
          "Order not found."
        );
        return;
      }

      setOrder(found);
    } catch (err) {
      console.error(err);

      setError(
        err instanceof Error
          ? err.message
          : "Failed to load order"
      );
    } finally {
      setLoading(false);
    }
  }

  function getStepIndex(status: string) {
    if (
      status === "Cancelled"
    ) {
      return -1;
    }

    return steps.indexOf(status);
  }

  function getWhatsAppNumber() {
    const phone = String(
      order?.phone || ""
    ).replace(/\D/g, "");

    if (phone.length === 10) {
      return `91${phone}`;
    }

    return phone;
  }

  function contactWhatsApp() {
    const number =
      getWhatsAppNumber();

    if (!number) {
      alert(
        "Customer mobile number is not available."
      );
      return;
    }

    const message = [
      `Hello ${order?.customer || ""},`,
      "",
      `Your Fresh2Cook order #${order?.id} is currently ${order?.status}.`,
      `Order Amount: Ã¢â€šÂ¹${order?.amount || 0}`,
      "",
      "Thank you for choosing Fresh2Cook! ÃƒÂ°Ã…Â¸Ã‚Â¥Ã‚Â¬ÃƒÂ¢Ã‚ÂÃ‚Â¤ÃƒÂ¯Ã‚Â¸Ã‚Â",
    ].join("\n");

    window.open(
      `https://wa.me/${number}?text=${encodeURIComponent(
        message
      )}`,
      "_blank",
      "noopener,noreferrer"
    );
  }

  if (loading) {
    return (
      <main className="min-h-screen bg-[#f7f7f3] flex items-center justify-center p-6">
        <div className="bg-white rounded-3xl shadow p-8 text-center">
          <div className="text-xl font-bold text-green-700">
            Loading Order...
          </div>
        </div>
      </main>
    );
  }

  if (error || !order) {
    return (
      <main className="min-h-screen bg-[#f7f7f3] flex items-center justify-center p-6">
        <div className="bg-white rounded-3xl shadow p-8 text-center max-w-md w-full">

          <div className="text-6xl mb-4">
            ÃƒÂ°Ã…Â¸Ã¢â‚¬Å“Ã‚Â¦
          </div>

          <h1 className="text-2xl font-bold">
            {error || "Order not found"}
          </h1>

          <a
            href="/products"
            className="inline-block mt-6 bg-green-600 text-white px-6 py-3 rounded-xl font-bold"
          >
            Continue Shopping
          </a>

        </div>
      </main>
    );
  }

  const currentStep =
    getStepIndex(order.status);

  const cancelled =
    order.status === "Cancelled";

  return (
    <main className="min-h-screen bg-[#f7f7f3] p-6">

      <div className="max-w-3xl mx-auto">

        <div className="flex items-center justify-between mb-6">

          <div>
            <h1 className="text-3xl md:text-4xl font-extrabold">
              Track Your Order
            </h1>

            <p className="text-gray-500 mt-1">
              Order #{order.id}
            </p>
          </div>

          <a
            href="/products"
            className="text-green-700 font-bold"
          >
            Shop More
          </a>

        </div>

        <div className="bg-white rounded-3xl shadow-sm border p-6">

          <div className="flex flex-col md:flex-row md:justify-between gap-5">

            <div>

              <p className="text-sm text-gray-500">
                Customer
              </p>

              <h2 className="text-xl font-bold mt-1">
                {order.customer}
              </h2>

              <p className="text-gray-600 mt-1">
                ÃƒÂ°Ã…Â¸Ã¢â‚¬Å“Ã‚Â± {order.phone || "-"}
              </p>

              <p className="text-gray-600 mt-2">
                ÃƒÂ°Ã…Â¸Ã¢â‚¬Å“Ã‚Â {order.address || "-"}
              </p>

            </div>

            <div className="md:text-right">

              <p className="text-sm text-gray-500">
                Order Total
              </p>

              <p className="text-3xl font-extrabold text-green-700">
                Ã¢â€šÂ¹{order.amount}
              </p>

              <p className="text-xs text-gray-500 mt-1">
                {new Date(
                  order.createdAt
                ).toLocaleString(
                  "en-IN"
                )}
              </p>

            </div>

          </div>

          <div className="border-t mt-6 pt-6">

            <div className="flex items-center justify-between mb-6">

              <h3 className="text-xl font-bold">
                Order Status
              </h3>

              <span
                className={`px-4 py-2 rounded-full text-sm font-bold ${
                  cancelled
                    ? "bg-red-100 text-red-700"
                    : order.status ===
                      "Delivered"
                    ? "bg-green-100 text-green-700"
                    : "bg-orange-100 text-orange-700"
                }`}
              >
                {order.status}
              </span>

            </div>

            {cancelled ? (
              <div className="bg-red-50 border border-red-200 rounded-2xl p-5 text-red-700 font-semibold text-center">
                This order has been cancelled.
              </div>
            ) : (
              <div className="space-y-6">

                {steps.map(
                  (step, index) => {

                    const completed =
                      index <= currentStep;

                    const current =
                      index === currentStep;

                    return (
                      <div
                        key={step}
                        className="flex items-center gap-4"
                      >

                        <div
                          className={`w-11 h-11 rounded-full flex items-center justify-center font-bold ${
                            completed
                              ? "bg-green-600 text-white"
                              : "bg-gray-200 text-gray-500"
                          } ${
                            current
                              ? "ring-4 ring-green-100"
                              : ""
                          }`}
                        >
                          {completed
                            ? "ÃƒÂ¢Ã…â€œÃ¢â‚¬Å“"
                            : index + 1}
                        </div>

                        <div>

                          <div
                            className={`font-bold ${
                              completed
                                ? "text-green-700"
                                : "text-gray-500"
                            }`}
                          >
                            {step}
                          </div>

                          <div className="text-sm text-gray-400">
                            {step === "Pending" &&
                              "Order received"}
                            {step === "Confirmed" &&
                              "Order confirmed by Fresh2Cook"}
                            {step === "Packed" &&
                              "Your fresh products are packed"}
                            {step ===
                              "Out for Delivery" &&
                              "Your order is on the way"}
                            {step ===
                              "Delivered" &&
                              "Order delivered successfully"}
                          </div>

                        </div>

                      </div>
                    );
                  }
                )}

              </div>
            )}

          </div>

          <div className="grid md:grid-cols-2 gap-3 mt-8">

            <button
              onClick={loadOrder}
              className="border-2 border-green-600 text-green-700 py-3 rounded-xl font-bold"
            >
              Refresh Status
            </button>

            <button
              onClick={contactWhatsApp}
              className="bg-green-600 text-white py-3 rounded-xl font-bold"
            >
              WhatsApp Support
            </button>

          </div>

        </div>

        <div className="bg-white rounded-3xl shadow-sm border p-6 mt-5 text-center">

          <h2 className="text-xl font-bold">
            Need Help?
          </h2>

          <p className="text-gray-500 mt-2">
            Contact us on WhatsApp for any order-related help.
          </p>

          <a
            href="https://wa.me/919811001901"
            target="_blank"
            rel="noreferrer"
            className="inline-block mt-4 bg-green-600 text-white px-6 py-3 rounded-xl font-bold"
          >
            Contact Fresh2Cook
          </a>

        </div>

      </div>

    </main>
  );
}




==================== D:\D Drive\Desktop\CRM\FreshCut-CRM-Professional-Starter\app\orders\page.tsx ====================

async function getOrders() {
  const res = await fetch(
    "http://localhost:3000/api/orders",
    {
      cache: "no-store",
    }
  );

  return res.json();
}

export default async function OrdersPage() {
  const orders = await getOrders();

  return (
    <div className="max-w-4xl mx-auto p-6">

      <div className="flex items-center justify-between mb-6">
        <h1 className="text-3xl font-bold">
          My Orders
        </h1>

        <a
          href="/products"
          className="bg-green-600 text-white px-4 py-2 rounded-lg"
        >
          Continue Shopping
        </a>
      </div>

      {orders.length === 0 && (
        <div className="bg-white rounded-xl p-6 border">
          No Orders Found
        </div>
      )}

      <div className="space-y-4">

        {orders.map((order: any) => (
          <div
            key={order.id}
            className="bg-white border rounded-2xl p-5 shadow-sm"
          >
            <div className="flex justify-between items-center">

              <div>
                <div className="font-bold text-lg">
                  Order #{order.id}
                </div>

                <div className="text-gray-600">
                  {order.customer}
                </div>
              </div>

              <div
                className={`px-3 py-1 rounded-full text-sm font-bold
                ${
                  order.status === "Delivered"
                    ? "bg-green-100 text-green-700"
                    : order.status === "Pending"
                    ? "bg-yellow-100 text-yellow-700"
                    : "bg-blue-100 text-blue-700"
                }`}
              >
                {order.status}
              </div>

            </div>

            <div className="mt-4 grid md:grid-cols-3 gap-4">

              <div>
                <div className="text-gray-500 text-sm">
                  Amount
                </div>

                <div className="font-bold text-xl text-green-600">
                  Ã¢â€šÂ¹{order.amount}
                </div>
              </div>

              <div>
                <div className="text-gray-500 text-sm">
                  Date
                </div>

                <div>
                  {new Date(
                    order.createdAt
                  ).toLocaleDateString()}
                </div>
              </div>

              <div>
                <div className="text-gray-500 text-sm">
                  Time
                </div>

                <div>
                  {new Date(
                    order.createdAt
                  ).toLocaleTimeString()}
                </div>
              </div>

            </div>

          </div>
        ))}

      </div>

    </div>
  );
}

"use client";

import { useEffect, useMemo, useState } from "react";
import QRCode from "react-qr-code";

type CartItem = {
  id: number;
  name: string;
  price: number;
  mrp?: number;
  qty: number;
  pack?: string;
  image?: string | null;
};

type ApiProduct = {
  id: number;
  name: string;
  price: number;
  mrp?: number;
  pack?: string;
  image?: string | null;
};

const FREE_DELIVERY_LIMIT = 400;
const DELIVERY_CHARGE = 40;
const HANDLING_CHARGE = 10;

function numberToWords(num: number): string {
  const ones = [
    "",
    "One",
    "Two",
    "Three",
    "Four",
    "Five",
    "Six",
    "Seven",
    "Eight",
    "Nine",
    "Ten",
    "Eleven",
    "Twelve",
    "Thirteen",
    "Fourteen",
    "Fifteen",
    "Sixteen",
    "Seventeen",
    "Eighteen",
    "Nineteen",
  ];

  const tens = [
    "",
    "",
    "Twenty",
    "Thirty",
    "Forty",
    "Fifty",
    "Sixty",
    "Seventy",
    "Eighty",
    "Ninety",
  ];

  function belowThousand(n: number): string {
    let result = "";

    if (n >= 100) {
      result +=
        ones[Math.floor(n / 100)] +
        " Hundred";
      n %= 100;

      if (n > 0) {
        result += " ";
      }
    }

    if (n >= 20) {
      result += tens[Math.floor(n / 10)];
      n %= 10;

      if (n > 0) {
        result +=
          " " + ones[n];
      }
    } else if (n > 0) {
      result += ones[n];
    }

    return result;
  }

  if (!Number.isFinite(num)) {
    return "Zero Rupees Only";
  }

  num = Math.round(num);

  if (num === 0) {
    return "Zero Rupees Only";
  }

  let result = "";

  if (num >= 10000000) {
    result +=
      belowThousand(
        Math.floor(
          num / 10000000
        )
      ) +
      " Crore";

    num %= 10000000;

    if (num > 0) {
      result += " ";
    }
  }

  if (num >= 100000) {
    result +=
      belowThousand(
        Math.floor(
          num / 100000
        )
      ) +
      " Lakh";

    num %= 100000;

    if (num > 0) {
      result += " ";
    }
  }

  if (num >= 1000) {
    result +=
      belowThousand(
        Math.floor(
          num / 1000
        )
      ) +
      " Thousand";

    num %= 1000;

    if (num > 0) {
      result += " ";
    }
  }

  if (num > 0) {
    result += belowThousand(num);
  }

  return `${result.trim()} Rupees Only`;
}

export default function PaymentPage() {
  const [customer, setCustomer] =
    useState("");

  const [phone, setPhone] =
    useState("");

  const [address, setAddress] =
    useState("");

  const [city, setCity] =
    useState("");

  const [pincode, setPincode] =
    useState("");

  const [gpsLocation, setGpsLocation] =
    useState("");

  const [cart, setCart] =
    useState<CartItem[]>([]);

  const [transactionId, setTransactionId] =
    useState("");

  const [processing, setProcessing] =
    useState(false);

  const [paymentSuccess, setPaymentSuccess] =
    useState(false);

  const [orderId, setOrderId] =
    useState<number | null>(null);

  const [deliveryOtp, setDeliveryOtp] =
    useState("");

  useEffect(() => {
    async function loadData() {
      try {
        const storedCart = JSON.parse(
          localStorage.getItem(
            "freshcut-cart"
          ) || "[]"
        );

        const safeCart: CartItem[] =
          Array.isArray(storedCart)
            ? storedCart
            : [];

        const customerValue =
          localStorage.getItem(
            "freshcut-customer"
          ) || "";

        const phoneValue =
          localStorage.getItem(
            "freshcut-phone"
          ) || "";

        const addressValue =
          localStorage.getItem(
            "freshcut-address"
          ) || "";

        setCustomer(customerValue);
        setPhone(phoneValue);
        setAddress(addressValue);

        try {
          const response =
            await fetch(
              "/api/products",
              {
                cache: "no-store",
              }
            );

          if (response.ok) {
            const products: ApiProduct[] =
              await response.json();

            const productMap =
              new Map(
                products.map(
                  (product) => [
                    product.id,
                    product,
                  ]
                )
              );

            const enrichedCart =
              safeCart.map(
                (item) => {
                  const product =
                    productMap.get(
                      item.id
                    );

                  const currentPack =
  item.pack ||
  product?.pack ||
  "250g";

const baseMrp =
  Number(
    product?.mrp ||
    item.mrp ||
    item.price ||
    0
  );

const calculatedMrp =
  currentPack === "500g"
    ? baseMrp * 2
    : currentPack === "1kg"
    ? baseMrp * 4
    : baseMrp;

return {
  ...item,
  mrp: calculatedMrp,
  pack: currentPack,
  image:
    product?.image ||
    item.image ||
    null,
};
                }
              );

            setCart(
              enrichedCart
            );

            return;
          }
        } catch (error) {
          console.error(
            "PRODUCT MRP LOAD ERROR:",
            error
          );
        }

        setCart(safeCart);
      } catch (error) {
        console.error(
          "PAYMENT LOAD ERROR:",
          error
        );

        setCart([]);
      }
    }

    loadData();
  }, []);

  const subtotal = useMemo(() => {
    return cart.reduce(
      (sum, item) =>
        sum +
        Number(item.price || 0) *
          Number(item.qty || 1),
      0
    );
  }, [cart]);

  const totalItems = useMemo(() => {
    return cart.reduce(
      (sum, item) =>
        sum +
        Number(item.qty || 1),
      0
    );
  }, [cart]);

  const freeDeliveryUnlocked =
    subtotal >=
    FREE_DELIVERY_LIMIT;

  const delivery =
    freeDeliveryUnlocked
      ? 0
      : DELIVERY_CHARGE;

  const total =
    subtotal +
    HANDLING_CHARGE +
    delivery;

  const amountForFreeDelivery =
    Math.max(
      FREE_DELIVERY_LIMIT -
        subtotal,
      0
    );

  const totalMrp = useMemo(() => {
    return cart.reduce(
      (sum, item) =>
        sum +
        Number(
          item.mrp ||
            item.price ||
            0
        ) *
          Number(item.qty || 1),
      0
    );
  }, [cart]);

  const productSavings =
    Math.max(
      totalMrp - subtotal,
      0
    );

  const deliverySavings =
    freeDeliveryUnlocked
      ? DELIVERY_CHARGE
      : 0;

  const totalSavings =
    productSavings +
    deliverySavings;

  const amountInWords =
    numberToWords(total);

  const upiUrl =
    `upi://pay?pa=ramakant.rao-1@okicici&pn=Fresh2Cook&am=${total}&cu=INR`;

  function getLocation() {
    if (!navigator.geolocation) {
      alert(
        "GPS not supported"
      );
      return;
    }

    navigator.geolocation.getCurrentPosition(
      (position) => {
        setGpsLocation(
          `${position.coords.latitude},${position.coords.longitude}`
        );
      },
      () => {
        alert(
          "Unable to fetch location"
        );
      }
    );
  }

  function saveSmallOrderRecord(
    createdOrderId: number
  ) {
    try {
      localStorage.setItem(
        "freshcut-payment-status",
        "Paid"
      );

      localStorage.setItem(
        "freshcut-order-id",
        String(createdOrderId)
      );

      localStorage.setItem(
        "freshcut-order-date",
        new Date().toISOString()
      );
    } catch (error) {
      console.error(
        "ORDER RECORD SAVE ERROR:",
        error
      );
    }
  }

  function openWhatsApp(
    otpValue?: string
  ) {
    const cleanedPhone =
      phone.replace(/\D/g, "");

    const whatsappNumber =
      cleanedPhone.length === 10
        ? `91${cleanedPhone}`
        : cleanedPhone;

    const productText =
      cart
        .map(
          (item) =>
            `${item.name} | ${item.pack || "-"} | Qty ${item.qty} | Ã¢â€šÂ¹${item.price}`
        )

    const message = `

${address}
${city} - ${pincode}

${productText}

Subtotal: Ã¢â€šÂ¹${subtotal}
Handling: Ã¢â€šÂ¹${HANDLING_CHARGE}

      delivery === 0
        ? "FREE"
        : `Ã¢â€šÂ¹${delivery}`
    }

Delivery Saving: Ã¢â€šÂ¹${deliverySavings}

  async function completePayment() {
    if (!customer.trim()) {
      alert(
        "Enter Customer Name"
      );
      return;
    }

    if (!phone.trim()) {
      alert(
        "Enter Mobile Number"
      );
      return;
    }

    if (!address.trim()) {
      alert(
        "Enter Delivery Address"
      );
      return;
    }

    if (cart.length === 0) {
      alert(
        "Your cart is empty."
      );
      return;
    }

    if (!transactionId.trim()) {
      alert(
        "Enter Transaction ID / UTR"
      );
      return;
    }

    try {
      setProcessing(true);

      const response =
        await fetch(
          "/api/orders",
          {
            method: "POST",
            headers: {
              "Content-Type":
                "application/json",
            },
            body: JSON.stringify({
              customer,
              phone,
              address,
              amount: total,
              items: cart.map(
                (item) => ({
                  id: item.id,
                  name: item.name,
                  price: item.price,
                  qty: item.qty,
                  pack: item.pack,
                  mrp: item.mrp,
                })
              ),
              transactionId,
              paymentStatus:
                "Paid",
              city,
              pincode,
              gpsLocation,
            }),
          }
        );

      const data =
        await response.json();

      if (!response.ok) {
        throw new Error(
          data?.error ||
            "Failed to create order"
        );
      }

      const createdOrderId =
        Number(
          data?.order?.id || 0
        );

      const otp =
        String(
          data?.deliveryOtp ||
            data?.order?.deliveryOtp ||
            ""
        );

      if (createdOrderId > 0) {
        setOrderId(
          createdOrderId
        );

        saveSmallOrderRecord(
          createdOrderId
        );
      }

      if (otp) {
        setDeliveryOtp(otp);
      }

      setPaymentSuccess(true);

      localStorage.removeItem(
        "freshcut-cart"
      );

      setTimeout(() => {
        openWhatsApp(otp);
      }, 800);
    } catch (error) {
      console.error(
        "PAYMENT ERROR:",
        error
      );

      alert(
        error instanceof Error
          ? error.message
          : "Order Failed"
      );
    } finally {
      setProcessing(false);
    }
  }

"use client";

import {
  useCallback,
  useEffect,
  useState,
} from "react";

type Item = {
  id: number;
  productName: string;
  pack: string;
  quantity: number;
  total: number;
  packed: boolean;
};

type Order = {
  id: number;
  customer: string;
  phone: string | null;
  address: string | null;
  amount: number;
  status: string;
  createdAt: string;

  processingStep: number;

  processingAcceptedById:
    number | null;

  processingAcceptedAt:
    string | null;

  processingPreparedAt:
    string | null;

  processingCrossCheckedAt:
    string | null;

  processingStickerAt:
    string | null;

  processingPackagingAt:
    string | null;

  processingDispatchedById:
    number | null;

  processingDeadline:
    string | null;

  acceptedByName:
    string | null;

  preparedByName:
    string | null;

  crossCheckedByName:
    string | null;

  stickerByName:
    string | null;

  packagingByName:
    string | null;

  dispatchedByName:
    string | null;

  items: Item[];
};

type Staff = {
  id: number;
  name: string;
};

type ApiResponse = {
  success?: boolean;
  error?: string;
  orders?: Order[];
  currentStaff?: Staff;
};

function money(
  amount: number
) {
  return `â‚¹${Number(
    amount || 0
  ).toLocaleString(
    "en-IN"
  )}`;
}

function timeText(
  value: string | null
) {
  if (!value)
    return "-";

  return new Date(
    value
  ).toLocaleTimeString(
    "en-IN",
    {
      hour: "2-digit",
      minute: "2-digit",
    }
  );
}

function timer(
  deadline: string | null
) {
  if (!deadline)
    return "30:00";

  const seconds =
    Math.max(
      0,
      Math.ceil(
        (
          new Date(
            deadline
          ).getTime() -
          Date.now()
        ) / 1000
      )
    );

  const m =
    Math.floor(
      seconds / 60
    );

  const s =
    seconds % 60;

  return `${String(
    m
  ).padStart(
    2,
    "0"
  )}:${String(
    s
  ).padStart(
    2,
    "0"
  )}`;
}

  const [orders, setOrders] =

      []

    );

      null
    );

    useState<number | null>(
      null
    );

      Date.now()
    );

      null
    );

    useCallback(
      async () => {
        try {
          const response =
            await fetch(
              "/api/processing/orders",
              {
                cache:
                  "no-store",
                credentials:
                  "include",
              }
            );

          const data: ApiResponse =
            await response.json();

          if (!response.ok) {
            throw new Error(
              data.error ||
                "Processing session expired"
            );
          }

          setOrders(
            data.orders ||
              []
          );

          if (
            data.currentStaff
          ) {
            setStaff(
              data.currentStaff
            );
          }

          setError("");
        } catch (err) {
          setError(
            err instanceof Error
              ? err.message
              : "Unable to load orders"
          );
        } finally {
          setLoading(false);
        }
      },
      []
    );

  useEffect(
    () => {
      loadOrders();

      const refresh =
        window.setInterval(
          loadOrders,
          10000
        );

      const clock =
        window.setInterval(
          () =>
            setTick(
              Date.now()
            ),
          1000
        );

      return () => {
        window.clearInterval(
          refresh
        );

        window.clearInterval(
          clock
        );
      };
    },
    [loadOrders]
  );

  async function action(
    orderId: number,
    actionName: string,
    extra: any = {}
  ) {
    try {
      setBusyOrder(
        orderId
      );

      setError("");

      const response =
        await fetch(
          "/api/processing/orders",
          {
            method:
              "PATCH",
            headers: {
              "Content-Type":
                "application/json",
            },
            credentials:
              "include",
            body: JSON.stringify({
              id: orderId,
              action:
                actionName,
              ...extra,
            }),
          }
        );

      const data =
        await response.json();

      if (!response.ok) {
        throw new Error(
          data.error ||
            "Action failed"
        );
      }

      await loadOrders();

    } catch (err) {
      setError(
        err instanceof Error
          ? err.message
          : "Action failed"
      );
    } finally {
      setBusyOrder(
        null
      );
    }
  }

  async function packItem(
    orderId: number,
    itemId: number,
    packed: boolean
  ) {
    try {
      setBusyItem(
        itemId
      );

      setOrders(
        (current) =>
          current.map(
            (order) =>
              order.id !==
              orderId
                ? order
                : {
                    ...order,
                    items:
                      order.items.map(
                        (item) =>
                          item.id !==
                          itemId
                            ? item
                            : {
                                ...item,
                                packed,
                              }
                      ),
                  }
          )
      );

      const response =
        await fetch(
          "/api/processing/orders",
          {
            method:
              "PATCH",
            headers: {
              "Content-Type":
                "application/json",
            },
            credentials:
              "include",
            body: JSON.stringify({
              id: orderId,
              action:
                "packItem",
              itemId,
              packed,
            }),
          }
        );

      const data =
        await response.json();

      if (!response.ok) {
        throw new Error(
          data.error ||
            "Packing update failed"
        );
      }
    } catch (err) {
      setError(
        err instanceof Error
          ? err.message
          : "Packing update failed"
      );

      await loadOrders();
    } finally {
      setBusyItem(
        null
      );
    }
  }
