"use client";

import {
  useCallback,
  useEffect,
  useState,
} from "react";

type Item = {
  id: number;
  productName: string;
  pack: string;
  quantity: number;
  total: number;
  packed: boolean;
};

type Order = {
  id: number;
  customer: string;
  phone: string | null;
  address: string | null;
  amount: number;
  status: string;
  createdAt: string;

  processingStep: number;

  processingAcceptedById:
    number | null;

  processingAcceptedAt:
    string | null;

  processingPreparedAt:
    string | null;

  processingCrossCheckedAt:
    string | null;

  processingStickerAt:
    string | null;

  processingPackagingAt:
    string | null;

  processingDispatchedById:
    number | null;

  processingDeadline:
    string | null;

  acceptedByName:
    string | null;

  preparedByName:
    string | null;

  crossCheckedByName:
    string | null;

  stickerByName:
    string | null;

  packagingByName:
    string | null;

  dispatchedByName:
    string | null;

  items: Item[];
};

type Staff = {
  id: number;
  name: string;
};

type ApiResponse = {
  success?: boolean;
  error?: string;
  orders?: Order[];
  currentStaff?: Staff;
};

function money(
  amount: number
) {
  return `â‚¹${Number(
    amount || 0
  ).toLocaleString(
    "en-IN"
  )}`;
}

function timeText(
  value: string | null
) {
  if (!value)
    return "-";

  return new Date(
    value
  ).toLocaleTimeString(
    "en-IN",
    {
      hour: "2-digit",
      minute: "2-digit",
    }
  );
}

function timer(
  deadline: string | null
) {
  if (!deadline)
    return "30:00";

  const seconds =
    Math.max(
      0,
      Math.ceil(
        (
          new Date(
            deadline
          ).getTime() -
          Date.now()
        ) / 1000
      )
    );

  const m =
    Math.floor(
      seconds / 60
    );

  const s =
    seconds % 60;

  return `${String(
    m
  ).padStart(
    2,
    "0"
  )}:${String(
    s
  ).padStart(
    2,
    "0"
  )}`;
}

  const [orders, setOrders] =

      []

      null
    );

    useState<number | null>(
      null
    );

      Date.now()
    );

    useState<number | null>(
      null
    );

          cross: boolean;

        }

    useCallback(
      async () => {
        try {
          const response =
            await fetch(
              "/api/processing/orders",
              {
                cache:
                  "no-store",
                credentials:
                  "include",
              }
            );

          const data: ApiResponse =
            await response.json();

          if (!response.ok) {
            throw new Error(
              data.error ||
                "Processing session expired"
            );
          }

          setOrders(
            data.orders ||
              []
          );

          if (
            data.currentStaff
          ) {
            setStaff(
              data.currentStaff
            );
          }

          setError("");
        } catch (err) {
          setError(
            err instanceof Error
              ? err.message
              : "Unable to load orders"
          );
        } finally {
          setLoading(false);
        }
      },
      []
    );

  useEffect(
    () => {
      loadOrders();

      const refresh =
        window.setInterval(
          loadOrders,
          10000
        );

      const clock =
        window.setInterval(
          () =>
            setTick(
              Date.now()
            ),
          1000
        );

      return () => {
        window.clearInterval(
          refresh
        );

        window.clearInterval(
          clock
        );
      };
    },
    [loadOrders]
  );

  async function action(
    orderId: number,
    actionName: string,
    extra: any = {}
  ) {
    try {
      setBusyOrder(
        orderId
      );

      setError("");

      const response =
        await fetch(
          "/api/processing/orders",
          {
            method:
              "PATCH",
            headers: {
              "Content-Type":
                "application/json",
            },
            credentials:
              "include",
            body: JSON.stringify({
              id: orderId,
              action:
                actionName,
              ...extra,
            }),
          }
        );

      const data =
        await response.json();

      if (!response.ok) {
        throw new Error(
          data.error ||
            "Action failed"
        );
      }

      await loadOrders();

    } catch (err) {
      setError(
        err instanceof Error
          ? err.message
          : "Action failed"
      );
    } finally {
      setBusyOrder(
        null
      );
    }
  }

  async function packItem(
    orderId: number,
    itemId: number,
    packed: boolean
  ) {
    try {
      setBusyItem(
        itemId
      );

      setOrders(
        (current) =>
          current.map(
            (order) =>
              order.id !==
              orderId
                ? order
                : {
                    ...order,
                    items:
                      order.items.map(
                        (item) =>
                          item.id !==
                          itemId
                            ? item
                            : {
                                ...item,
                                packed,
                              }
                      ),
                  }
          )
      );

      const response =
        await fetch(
          "/api/processing/orders",
          {
            method:
              "PATCH",
            headers: {
              "Content-Type":
                "application/json",
            },
            credentials:
              "include",
            body: JSON.stringify({
              id: orderId,
              action:
                "packItem",
              itemId,
              packed,
            }),
          }
        );

      const data =
        await response.json();

      if (!response.ok) {
        throw new Error(
          data.error ||
            "Packing update failed"
        );
      }
    } catch (err) {
      setError(
        err instanceof Error
          ? err.message
          : "Packing update failed"
      );

      await loadOrders();
    } finally {
      setBusyItem(
        null
      );
    }
  }

"use client";

import { FormEvent, useState } from "react";
import {
  Eye,
  EyeOff,
  Loader2,
  PackageCheck,
  UserPlus,
} from "lucide-react";

export default function ProcessingLoginPage() {
  const [setupMode, setSetupMode] = useState(false);
  const [name, setName] = useState("");
  const [mobile, setMobile] = useState("");
  const [password, setPassword] = useState("");
  const [showPassword, setShowPassword] = useState(false);
  const [loading, setLoading] = useState(false);
  const [message, setMessage] = useState("");

  async function submit(event: FormEvent) {
    event.preventDefault();

    setLoading(true);
    setMessage("");

    try {
      const endpoint = setupMode
        ? "/api/auth/staff-setup"
        : "/api/auth/staff-login";

      const body = setupMode
        ? {
            name,
            mobile,
            password,
            role: "PROCESSING",
          }
        : {
            mobile,
            password,
            role: "PROCESSING",
          };

      const response = await fetch(endpoint, {
        method: "POST",
        headers: {
          "Content-Type": "application/json",
        },
        body: JSON.stringify(body),
      });

      const data = await response.json();

      if (!response.ok || !data.success) {
        if (!setupMode && data.code === "NO_ACCOUNT") {
          setSetupMode(true);
        }

        throw new Error(
          data.message || "Unable to continue"
        );
      }

      window.location.href = "/processing/dashboard";
    } catch (error) {
      setMessage(
        error instanceof Error
          ? error.message
          : "Unable to continue"
      );
    } finally {
      setLoading(false);
    }
  }

  return (
    <main className="min-h-screen bg-gradient-to-br from-emerald-50 via-white to-orange-50 px-4 py-10">
      <div className="mx-auto flex min-h-[80vh] max-w-md items-center justify-center">
        <div className="w-full rounded-3xl border border-slate-200 bg-white p-7 shadow-xl">

          <div className="mb-7 text-center">
            <div className="mx-auto mb-4 flex h-16 w-16 items-center justify-center rounded-2xl bg-emerald-600 text-white">
              <PackageCheck size={34} />
            </div>

            <h1 className="text-2xl font-extrabold text-slate-900">
              Processing Team
            </h1>

            <p className="mt-1 text-sm text-slate-500">
              {setupMode
                ? "Create the first Processing Team account"
                : "Order processing login"}
            </p>
          </div>

          <form onSubmit={submit} className="space-y-4">
            {setupMode && (
              <input
                value={name}
                onChange={(e) => setName(e.target.value)}
                placeholder="Full Name"
                className="h-12 w-full rounded-xl border border-slate-200 px-4 outline-none focus:border-emerald-500"
              />
            )}

            <input
              value={mobile}
              onChange={(e) =>
                setMobile(
                  e.target.value.replace(/\D/g, "").slice(0, 10)
                )
              }
              placeholder="Mobile Number"
              inputMode="numeric"
              className="h-12 w-full rounded-xl border border-slate-200 px-4 outline-none focus:border-emerald-500"
            />

            <div className="relative">
              <input
                value={password}
                onChange={(e) => setPassword(e.target.value)}
                type={showPassword ? "text" : "password"}
                placeholder="Password"
                className="h-12 w-full rounded-xl border border-slate-200 px-4 pr-12 outline-none focus:border-emerald-500"
              />

              <button
                type="button"
                onClick={() => setShowPassword((value) => !value)}
                className="absolute right-3 top-1/2 -translate-y-1/2 text-slate-500"
                aria-label="Toggle password visibility"
              >
                {showPassword ? (
                  <EyeOff size={20} />
                ) : (
                  <Eye size={20} />
                )}
              </button>
            </div>

            {message && (
              <div className="rounded-xl bg-red-50 px-4 py-3 text-sm font-medium text-red-700">
                {message}
              </div>
            )}

            <button
              type="submit"
              disabled={loading}
              className="flex h-12 w-full items-center justify-center gap-2 rounded-xl bg-emerald-600 font-bold text-white transition hover:bg-emerald-700 disabled:opacity-60"
            >
              {loading ? (
                <Loader2 className="animate-spin" size={19} />
              ) : setupMode ? (
                <UserPlus size={19} />
              ) : (
                <PackageCheck size={19} />
              )}

              {loading
                ? "Please wait..."
                : setupMode
                  ? "Create Processing Account"
                  : "Login"}
            </button>
          </form>

          <div className="mt-5 text-center">
            <button
              type="button"
              onClick={() => {
                setSetupMode((value) => !value);
                setMessage("");
              }}
              className="text-sm font-semibold text-emerald-700 hover:underline"
            >
              {setupMode ? "Back to Login" : "First time setup"}
            </button>
          </div>

          <div className="mt-6 border-t pt-5 text-center text-xs text-slate-400">
            Super Admin Login:{" "}
            <a
              className="font-semibold text-emerald-700"
              href="/admin/login"
            >
              /admin/login
            </a>
          </div>

        </div>
      </div>
    </main>
  );

"use client";

import { useEffect, useState } from "react";

type Product = {
  id: number;
  name: string;
  price: number;
  stock?: number;
  image?: string;
  category?: string;
  pack?: string;
};

type CartItem = Product & {
  qty: number;
};

export default function ProductsPage() {
  const [products, setProducts] = useState<Product[]>([]);
  const [loading, setLoading] = useState(true);
  const [cartCount, setCartCount] = useState(0);
  const [qty, setQty] = useState<Record<number, number>>({});
  const [search, setSearch] = useState("");
  const [selectedPack, setSelectedPack] = useState<Record<number,string>>({});

  useEffect(() => {
    const params = new URLSearchParams(
      window.location.search
    );

    const searchParam =
      params.get("search") || "";

    setSearch(searchParam);

    loadProducts();
    loadCartCount();

    const handleCartUpdated = () => {
      loadCartCount();
      syncQtyFromCart();
    };

    window.addEventListener(
      "cartUpdated",
      handleCartUpdated
    );

    window.addEventListener(
      "storage",
      handleCartUpdated
    );

    return () => {
      window.removeEventListener(
        "cartUpdated",
        handleCartUpdated
      );

      window.removeEventListener(
        "storage",
        handleCartUpdated
      );
    };
  }, []);

  async function loadProducts() {
    try {
      setLoading(true);

      const response = await fetch(
        "/api/products",
        {
          cache: "no-store",
        }
      );

      if (!response.ok) {
        throw new Error(
          "Failed to load products"
        );
      }

      const data =
        await response.json();

      const list: Product[] =
        Array.isArray(data)
          ? data
          : Array.isArray(
              data.products
            )
          ? data.products
          : Array.isArray(data.data)
          ? data.data
          : [];

      setProducts(list);

      const savedCart =
        getCart();

      const startingQty: Record<
        number,
        number
      > = {};

      list.forEach((product) => {
        const existing =
          savedCart.find(
            (item) =>
              Number(item.id) ===
              Number(product.id)
          );

        startingQty[product.id] =
          existing
            ? Number(
                existing.qty || 1
              )
            : 1;
      });

      setQty(startingQty);
    } catch (error) {
      console.error(
        "Products load error:",
        error
      );

      setProducts([]);
    } finally {
      setLoading(false);
    }
  }

  function getCart(): CartItem[] {
    try {
      const saved = JSON.parse(
        localStorage.getItem(
          "freshcut-cart"
        ) || "[]"
      );

      return Array.isArray(saved)
        ? saved
        : [];
    } catch {
      return [];
    }
  }

  function saveCart(
    cart: CartItem[]
  ) {
    localStorage.setItem(
      "freshcut-cart",
      JSON.stringify(cart)
    );

    window.dispatchEvent(
      new Event("cartUpdated")
    );
  }

  function loadCartCount() {
    const cart =
      getCart();

    setCartCount(
      cart.length
    );
  }

  function syncQtyFromCart() {
    const cart =
      getCart();

    setQty((prev) => {
      const next = {
        ...prev,
      };

      products.forEach(
        (product) => {
          const existing =
            cart.find(
              (item) =>
                Number(item.id) ===
                Number(product.id)
            );

          next[product.id] =
            existing
              ? Number(
                  existing.qty || 1
                )
              : Math.max(
                  Number(
                    next[
                      product.id
                    ] || 1
                  ),
                  1
                );
        }
      );

      return next;
    });
  }

  function increase(
    product: Product
  ) {
    const current = Number(
      qty[product.id] || 1
    );

    const stock = Number(
      product.stock || 0
    );

    if (
      stock <= 0 ||
      current >= stock
    ) {
      return;
    }

    setQty((prev) => ({
      ...prev,
      [product.id]:
        current + 1,
    }));
  }

  function decrease(
    productId: number
  ) {
    const current = Number(
      qty[productId] || 1
    );

    setQty((prev) => ({
      ...prev,
      [productId]:
        Math.max(
          current - 1,
          1
        ),
    }));
  }

  function addToCart(
    product: Product
  ) {
    try {
      const stock = Number(
        product.stock || 0
      );

      if (stock <= 0) {
        return;
      }

      const cart =
        getCart();

      const selectedQty =
        Math.max(
          1,
          Math.min(
            Number(
              qty[product.id] || 1
            ),
            stock
          )
        );

      const currentPack =
  selectedPack[product.id] ||
  product.pack ||
  "Piece";

const existingIndex =
  cart.findIndex(
    (item) =>
      Number(item.id) === Number(product.id) &&
      item.pack === currentPack
  );

if (
  existingIndex >= 0
) {
  const existingQty =
    Number(
      cart[
        existingIndex
      ].qty || 1
    );

  cart[
    existingIndex
  ] = {
    ...cart[
      existingIndex
    ],
    name: product.name,
    category:
      product.category,
    price:
(currentPack === "500g")
? product.price * 2
: (currentPack === "1kg")
? product.price * 4
: product.price,
    stock: product.stock,
    image: product.image,
    pack:
      currentPack,
    qty: Math.min(
      existingQty +
        selectedQty,
      stock
    ),
  };
} else {
  cart.push({
    id: product.id,
    name: product.name,
    category:
      product.category,
    price:
(currentPack === "500g")
? product.price * 2
: (currentPack === "1kg")
? product.price * 4
: product.price,
    stock: product.stock,
    image: product.image,
    pack:
      currentPack,
    qty: selectedQty,
  });
}

      saveCart(cart);

      setQty((prev) => ({
        ...prev,
        [product.id]: 1,
      }));
    } catch (error) {
      console.error(
        "Add to cart error:",
        error
      );
    }
  }

  const filteredProducts =
    products.filter(
      (product) =>
        product.name
          .toLowerCase()
          .includes(
            search.toLowerCase()
          )
    );

  if (loading) {
    return (
      <div className="min-h-screen flex items-center justify-center">
        <div className="text-sm font-semibold text-green-700">
          Loading products...
        </div>
      </div>
    );
  }

  return (
    <div className="min-h-screen bg-gray-50">
      <main className="max-w-7xl mx-auto px-4 py-8 pb-32">

        <div className="mb-8">
          <h1 className="text-xl md:text-2xl font-bold">
  Fresh2Cook
</h1>

          <div className="flex items-center justify-between gap-4 flex-wrap">

  <p className="text-gray-600">
    Freshly packed vegetables, ready for your kitchen.</p>

<div className="flex-1 max-w-md">
<input
type="text"
placeholder="..."
className="w-full border rounded-xl px-4 py-2"
/>
</div>

<p>
  </p>

<div className="flex flex-wrap gap-3 mb-6 mt-4">
<button className="px-5 py-2 bg-green-600 text-white rounded-2xl font-medium">All</button>
<button className="px-5 py-2 border rounded-2xl">Vegetables</button>
<button className="px-5 py-2 border rounded-2xl">Fruits</button>
<button className="px-5 py-2 border rounded-2xl">Cut & Ready</button>
<button className="px-5 py-2 border rounded-2xl">Leafy Greens</button>
<button className="px-5 py-2 border rounded-2xl">Root Vegetables</button>
<button className="px-5 py-2 border rounded-2xl">Exotic</button>
<button className="px-5 py-2 border rounded-2xl">Herbs</button>
<button className="px-5 py-2 border rounded-2xl">Seasonal</button>
</div>


  

</div>
        </div>

        

        {filteredProducts.length === 0 ? (
          <div className="bg-white rounded-2xl shadow p-10 text-center">
            <p className="text-xl font-semibold">
              No products found
            </p>

            {search && (
              <p className="text-gray-500 mt-2">
                No product matched "
                {search}"
              </p>
            )}
          </div>
        ) : (
          <div className="grid grid-cols-2 md:grid-cols-4 lg:grid-cols-6 xl:grid-cols-6 2xl:grid-cols-6 gap-4">
            {filteredProducts.map(
              (product) => {
                const stock =
                  Number(
                    product.stock || 0
                  );

                const selectedQty =
                  Number(
                    qty[
                      product.id
                    ] || 1
                  );

                const isOutOfStock =
                  stock <= 0;

                return (
                  <article
                    key={product.id}
                    className="bg-white rounded-2xl shadow-md border overflow-hidden"
                  >
                    <div className="aspect-square bg-gray-100 flex items-center justify-center overflow-hidden">
                      {product.image ? (
                        <img
                          src={product.image}
                          alt={
                            product.name
                          }
                          className="w-full h-full object-contain p-2 transition-transform duration-300 hover:scale-110"
                        />
                      ) : (
                        <div className="text-gray-400">
                          No Image
                        </div>
                      )}
                    </div>

                    <div className="p-4">
                      <h2 className="font-bold text-sm">
                        {product.name}
                      </h2>

                      {product.pack && (
    <div className="mt-2">
      <div className="relative">
  <span className="absolute left-3 top-1/2 -translate-y-1/2 text-sm font-medium text-gray-500">
    <span className="text-green-700 font-semibold">Pack:</span>
  </span>

  <select
  className="w-full border rounded-lg pl-14 pr-3 py-2 text-sm"
  value={selectedPack[product.id] || product.pack || "250g"}
  onChange={(e)=>
    setSelectedPack({
      ...selectedPack,
      [product.id]: e.target.value
    })
  }
>
  <option>250g</option>
  <option>500g</option>
  <option>1kg</option>
  <option>1 Bunch</option>
  <option>1 Pkt</option>
  <option>Piece</option>
</select>
<span className="text-red-600 font-bold text-base">MRP</span>
    </div>
    </div>
)}

<div className="mt-2 rounded bg-gray-50 p-2 text-xs">

<div className="flex justify-between">
<span>MRP</span>
<span className="line-through text-red-600 font-bold text-base">
Rs 
{Math.round(product.price*1.2)}
</span>

        number,

      > = {};

      list.forEach((product) => {
        const existing =
          savedCart.find(
            (item) =>
              Number(item.id) ===
              Number(product.id)
          );

        startingQty[product.id] =
          existing
            ? Number(
                existing.qty || 1
              )
            : 1;
      });

      setQty(startingQty);
    } catch (error) {
      console.error(
        "Products load error:",
        error
      );

      setProducts([]);
    } finally {
      setLoading(false);
    }
  }

  function getCart(): CartItem[] {
    try {
      const saved = JSON.parse(
        localStorage.getItem(
          "freshcut-cart"
        ) || "[]"
      );

      return Array.isArray(saved)
        ? saved
        : [];
    } catch {
      return [];
    }
  }

  function saveCart(
  cart: CartItem[]
) {

  console.log(
    "CART SIZE = ",
    JSON.stringify(cart).length
  );
console.log(
  "Cart Size:",
  JSON.stringify(cart).length

    window.dispatchEvent(
      new Event("cartUpdated")
    );
  }

  function loadCartCount() {
    const cart =
      getCart();

    setCartCount(
      cart.length
    );
  }

  function syncQtyFromCart() {
    const cart =
      getCart();

    setQty((prev) => {
      const next = {
        ...prev,
      };

      products.forEach(
        (product) => {
          const existing =
            cart.find(
              (item) =>
                Number(item.id) ===
                Number(product.id)
            );

          next[product.id] =
            existing
              ? Number(
                  existing.qty || 1
                )
              : Math.max(
                  Number(
                    next[
                      product.id
                    ] || 1
                  ),
                  1
                );
        }
      );

      return next;
    });
  }

  function increase(
    product: Product
  ) {
    const current = Number(
      qty[product.id] || 1
    );

    const stock = Number(
      product.stock || 0
    );

    if (
      stock <= 0 ||
      current >= stock
    ) {
      return;
    }

    setQty((prev) => ({
      ...prev,
      [product.id]:
        current + 1,
    }));
  }

  function decrease(
    productId: number
  ) {
    const current = Number(
      qty[productId] || 1
    );

    setQty((prev) => ({
      ...prev,
      [productId]:
        Math.max(
          current - 1,
          1
        ),
    }));
  }

export default function Page(){

  useState("");

 async function acceptOrder(){

  const res =
   await fetch(
    "/api/rider-accept-order",
    {
     method:"POST",
     headers:{
      "Content-Type":
       "application/json"
     },
     body:JSON.stringify({
      assignmentId
     })
    }
   );

  const data =

   data.message ||

  );

 }

   <h1 className="text-2xl font-bold mb-4">
    Accept Order
   </h1>

   <input
    value={assignmentId}

     setAssignmentId(
      e.target.value
     )
    }
    placeholder="Assignment ID"
    className="border p-3 rounded w-full"
   />

   <button
    onClick={acceptOrder}
    className="mt-4 bg-green-600 text-white px-4 py-2 rounded"
   >
    Accept
   </button>

   <div className="mt-4">

   </div>

  </div>

"use client";

import { useState } from "react";

export default function Page(){

 const [assignmentId,setAssignmentId] =
  useState("");

 const [otp,setOtp] =
  useState("");

 const [message,setMessage] =
  useState("");

 async function completeOrder(){

  const verify =
   await fetch(
    "/api/rider-verify-otp",
    {
     method:"POST",
     headers:{
      "Content-Type":
       "application/json"
     },
     body:JSON.stringify({
      assignmentId,
      otp
     })
    }
   );

  const verifyData =
   await verify.json();

  if(!verifyData.success){

   setMessage(
    "Invalid OTP"
   );

   return;
  }

  const complete =
   await fetch(
    "/api/rider-complete-order",
    {
     method:"POST"
    }
   );

  const completeData =
   await complete.json();

  setMessage(
   completeData.message ||
   "Delivery Completed"
  );

 }

 return(
  <div className="p-6 max-w-xl mx-auto">

   <h1 className="text-3xl font-bold mb-6">
    Complete Delivery
   </h1>

   <input
    className="border p-3 rounded w-full mb-3"
    placeholder="Assignment ID"
    value={assignmentId}
    onChange={(e)=>
     setAssignmentId(e.target.value)
    }
   />

   <input
    className="border p-3 rounded w-full"
    placeholder="Customer OTP"
    value={otp}
    onChange={(e)=>
     setOtp(e.target.value)
    }
   />

   <button
    onClick={completeOrder}
    className="mt-4 bg-green-600 text-white px-4 py-2 rounded"
   >
    Complete Delivery
   </button>

   <div className="mt-4">
    {message}
   </div>

  </div>
 );
}

  newStatus:string
 ){

   localStorage.getItem(

   );

   "/api/rider-status",

    method:"POST",
    headers:{
     "Content-Type":
      "application/json"
    },
    body:JSON.stringify({
     riderId,
     status:newStatus
    })
   }
  );

  );

       )

import { useState } from "react";

export default function Page(){

 const [mobile,setMobile] =
  useState("");

 const [result,setResult] =
  useState("");

 async function login(){

  const res =
   await fetch(
    "/api/rider-login",
    {
     method:"POST",
     headers:{
      "Content-Type":
       "application/json"
     },
     body:JSON.stringify({
      mobile
     })
    }
   );

  const data =
   await res.json();

  if(data.success){

   localStorage.setItem(
    "riderId",
    String(data.rider.id)
   );

   setResult(
    "Login Success"
   );

  }else{

   setResult(
    data.message
   );

  }

 }

 return(

  <div className="max-w-md mx-auto p-6">

   <h1 className="text-3xl font-bold mb-6">
    Rider Login
   </h1>

   <input
    className="border p-3 w-full rounded"
    placeholder="Mobile Number"
    value={mobile}
    onChange={(e)=>
     setMobile(e.target.value)
    }
   />

   <button
    onClick={login}
    className="w-full mt-4 bg-green-600 text-white p-3 rounded"
   >
    Login
   </button>

   <div className="mt-4">
    {result}
   </div>

  </div>

 );

}

import { useEffect, useState } from "react";

type Task = {
  id: number;
  orderId: number;
  status: string;
  order?: {
    customer?: string;
    phone?: string;
    address?: string;
    amount?: number;
  };

export default function Page() {
  const [data, setData] = useState<any>(null);
  const [message, setMessage] = useState("");
  const [loading, setLoading] = useState<number | null>(null);

  const riderId =
    typeof window !== "undefined"
      ? localStorage.getItem("riderId")
      : null;

  async function loadTasks() {
    if (!riderId) return;

    try {
      const res = await fetch(
        `/api/rider-my-tasks?riderId=${riderId}`,
        { cache: "no-store" }
      );

      const result = await res.json();
      setData(result);
    } catch {
      setMessage("Tasks load à¤¨à¤¹à¥€à¤‚ à¤¹à¥‹ à¤¸à¤•à¥‡");
    }
  }

  useEffect(() => {
    loadTasks();
  }, []);

  async function acceptOrder(assignmentId: number) {
    setLoading(assignmentId);
    setMessage("");

    try {
      const res = await fetch("/api/rider-accept-order", {
        method: "POST",
        headers: {
          "Content-Type": "application/json",
        },
        body: JSON.stringify({ assignmentId }),
      });

      const result = await res.json();

      if (!result.success) {
        setMessage(result.error || "Order accept à¤¨à¤¹à¥€à¤‚ à¤¹à¥à¤†");
        return;
      }

      setMessage(
        "Order Accepted âœ… Customer à¤•à¥‹ rider details à¤•à¥€ notification à¤¤à¥ˆà¤¯à¤¾à¤° à¤¹à¥ˆà¥¤"
      );

      await loadTasks();
    } catch {
      setMessage("Order accept à¤•à¤°à¤¨à¥‡ à¤®à¥‡à¤‚ à¤¸à¤®à¤¸à¥à¤¯à¤¾ à¤¹à¥à¤ˆ");
    } finally {
      setLoading(null);
    }
  }

  async function pickupOrder(assignmentId: number) {
    setLoading(assignmentId);
    setMessage("");

    try {
      const res = await fetch("/api/rider-pickup-order", {
        method: "POST",
        headers: {
          "Content-Type": "application/json",
        },
        body: JSON.stringify({ assignmentId }),
      });

      const result = await res.json();

      if (!result.success) {
        setMessage(result.error || "Pickup à¤¨à¤¹à¥€à¤‚ à¤¹à¥à¤†");

          à¤†à¤ªà¤•à¥‡ assigned orders

==================== D:\D Drive\Desktop\CRM\FreshCut-CRM-Professional-Starter\app\rider\otp-verify\page.tsx ====================

"use client";

import { useEffect, useState } from "react";

export default function Page() {
  const [assignmentId, setAssignmentId] = useState("");
  const [otp, setOtp] = useState("");
  const [message, setMessage] = useState("");
  const [loading, setLoading] = useState(false);
  const [resending, setResending] = useState(false);

  useEffect(() => {
    const params = new URLSearchParams(window.location.search);
    const id = params.get("assignmentId");

    if (id) {
      setAssignmentId(id);
    }
  }, []);

  async function resendOtp() {
    if (!assignmentId) {
      setMessage("Assignment ID required");
      return;
    }

    setResending(true);
    setMessage("");

    try {
      const res = await fetch("/api/rider-start-delivery", {
        method: "POST",
        headers: {
          "Content-Type": "application/json",
        },
        body: JSON.stringify({
          assignmentId: Number(assignmentId),
        }),
      });

      const data = await res.json();

      if (!data.success) {
        setMessage(data.error || "OTP à¤­à¥‡à¤œà¤¾ à¤¨à¤¹à¥€à¤‚ à¤œà¤¾ à¤¸à¤•à¤¾");
        return;
      }

      setMessage(
        "à¤¨à¤¯à¤¾ OTP customer à¤•à¥‹ à¤­à¥‡à¤œ à¤¦à¤¿à¤¯à¤¾ à¤—à¤¯à¤¾ à¤¹à¥ˆà¥¤"
      );
    } catch {
      setMessage("OTP à¤­à¥‡à¤œà¤¨à¥‡ à¤®à¥‡à¤‚ à¤¸à¤®à¤¸à¥à¤¯à¤¾ à¤¹à¥à¤ˆ");
    } finally {
      setResending(false);
    }
  }

  async function verify() {
    if (!assignmentId || !otp) {
      setMessage("OTP required");
      return;
    }

    setLoading(true);
    setMessage("");

    try {
      const res = await fetch("/api/rider-complete-delivery", {
        method: "POST",
        headers: {
          "Content-Type": "application/json",
        },
        body: JSON.stringify({
          assignmentId: Number(assignmentId),
          otp,
        }),
      });

      const data = await res.json();

      if (!data.success) {
        setMessage(data.error || "Invalid OTP");
        return;
      }

      setMessage("Delivered Successfully âœ… â‚¹25 Earned");
    } catch {
      setMessage("Verification failed");
    } finally {
      setLoading(false);
    }
  }

  return (
    <div className="min-h-screen bg-gray-50 p-6 max-w-xl mx-auto">

      <h1 className="text-3xl font-bold mb-6">
        Verify Delivery OTP
      </h1>

      <input
        className="border p-3 w-full rounded-xl mb-4"
        placeholder="Assignment ID"
        value={assignmentId}
        onChange={(e) => setAssignmentId(e.target.value)}
      />

      <button
        onClick={resendOtp}
        disabled={resending}
        className="w-full bg-orange-600 text-white p-3 rounded-xl font-semibold"
      >
        {resending ? "Sending..." : "Resend OTP"}
      </button>

      <input
        className="border p-4 w-full rounded-xl mt-5 text-center text-2xl tracking-[0.5em]"
        placeholder="OTP"
        value={otp}
        maxLength={4}
        inputMode="numeric"
        onChange={(e) =>
          setOtp(e.target.value.replace(/\D/g, "").slice(0, 4))
        }
      />

      <button
        onClick={verify}
        disabled={loading}
        className="mt-4 w-full bg-green-600 text-white p-3 rounded-xl font-semibold"
      >
        {loading
          ? "Verifying..."
          : "Verify OTP & Deliver"}
      </button>

      {message && (
        <div className="mt-5 bg-white border rounded-xl p-4">
          {message}
        </div>
      )}

    </div>
  );
}

"use client";

import { useEffect, useState } from "react";

export default function SubscriptionPage() {
  const [subscription, setSubscription] =
    useState<any>(null);

  useEffect(() => {
    const data = JSON.parse(
      localStorage.getItem(
        "freshcut-subscription"
      ) || "null"
    );

    setSubscription(data);
  }, []);

  function createSubscription(
    plan: string
  ) {
    const sub = {
      id: Date.now(),
      plan,
      status: "Active",
      startDate:
        new Date().toLocaleDateString(),
    };

    localStorage.setItem(
      "freshcut-subscription",
      JSON.stringify(sub)
    );

    setSubscription(sub);

    alert(
      plan +
        " Subscription Activated"
    );
  }

  function pauseSubscription() {
    const updated = {
      ...subscription,
      status: "Paused",
    };

    localStorage.setItem(
      "freshcut-subscription",
      JSON.stringify(updated)
    );

    setSubscription(updated);
  }

  function resumeSubscription() {
    const updated = {
      ...subscription,
      status: "Active",
    };

    localStorage.setItem(
      "freshcut-subscription",
      JSON.stringify(updated)
    );

    setSubscription(updated);
  }

  return (
    <div className="min-h-screen bg-gray-100 p-6">

      <div className="max-w-5xl mx-auto">

        <h1 className="text-4xl font-bold mb-8">
          Fresh2Cook Subscription

                onClick={() =>
                  createSubscription(
                    "Weekly"
                  )
                }
                className="mt-6 bg-green-600 text-white px-6 py-3 rounded-xl"
              >
                Subscribe
              </button>

            </div>

            <div className="bg-white rounded-3xl shadow p-6">

              <h2 className="text-2xl font-bold">
                Monthly Plan
              </h2>

              <p className="mt-3">
                Delivery every month

"use client";

import { useEffect, useState } from "react";

type Transaction = {
  type: string;
  amount: number;
  date: string;
};

export default function WalletPage() {
  const [wallet, setWallet] = useState({
    balance: 0,
    points: 0,
  });

  const [transactions, setTransactions] = useState<Transaction[]>([]);

  useEffect(() => {
    const walletData = JSON.parse(
      localStorage.getItem("freshcut-wallet") ||
        '{"balance":0,"points":0}'
    );

    const txns = JSON.parse(
      localStorage.getItem(
        "freshcut-wallet-transactions"
      ) || "[]"
    );

    setWallet(walletData);
    setTransactions(txns);
  }, []);

  function saveWallet(
    data: any,
    txn?: Transaction
  ) {
    localStorage.setItem(
      "freshcut-wallet",
      JSON.stringify(data)
    );

    if (txn) {
      const updatedTxns = [
        txn,
        ...transactions,
      ];

      localStorage.setItem(
        "freshcut-wallet-transactions",
        JSON.stringify(updatedTxns)
      );

      setTransactions(updatedTxns);
    }

    setWallet(data);
  }

  function addCashback() {
    const updated = {
      ...wallet,
      balance: wallet.balance + 50,
      points: wallet.points + 50,
    };

    saveWallet(updated, {
      type: "Cashback",
      amount: 50,
      date: new Date().toLocaleDateString(),
    });

    alert("Ã¢â€šÂ¹50 Cashback Added");
  }

  function referEarn() {
    const updated = {
      ...wallet,
      balance: wallet.balance + 100,
      points: wallet.points + 100,
    };

    saveWallet(updated, {
      type: "Referral",
      amount: 100,
      date: new Date().toLocaleDateString(),
    });

    alert("Ã¢â€šÂ¹100 Referral Reward Added");
  }

  function redeem() {
    if (wallet.balance < 50) {
      alert("Minimum Ã¢â€šÂ¹50 Required");
      return;
    }

    const updated = {
      ...wallet,
      balance: wallet.balance - 50,
      points: wallet.points - 50,
    };

    saveWallet(updated, {
      type: "Redeem",
      amount: -50,
      date: new Date().toLocaleDateString(),
    });

    alert("Ã¢â€šÂ¹50 Redeemed");
  }

  const cashbackTotal = transactions
    .filter((t) => t.type === "Cashback")
    .reduce((sum, t) => sum + t.amount, 0);

  const referralTotal = transactions
    .filter((t) => t.type === "Referral")
    .reduce((sum, t) => sum + t.amount, 0);

  const tier =
    wallet.points >= 2000
      ? "ÃƒÂ°Ã…Â¸Ã‚Â¥Ã¢â‚¬Â¡ Gold"
      : wallet.points >= 500
      ? "ÃƒÂ°Ã…Â¸Ã‚Â¥Ã‹â€  Silver"
      : "ÃƒÂ°Ã…Â¸Ã‚Â¥Ã¢â‚¬Â° Bronze";

  return (
    <div className="min-h-screen bg-gray-100 p-6">
      <div className="max-w-6xl mx-auto">

        <h1 className="text-4xl font-bold mb-8">
          Fresh2Cook Wallet
        </h1>

        <div className="grid md:grid-cols-4 gap-4">

          <div className="bg-white rounded-3xl shadow p-6">
            <p>Wallet Balance</p>
            <h2 className="text-4xl font-bold text-green-600">
              Ã¢â€šÂ¹{wallet.balance}
            </h2>
          </div>

          <div className="bg-white rounded-3xl shadow p-6">
            <p>Reward Points</p>
            <h2 className="text-4xl font-bold text-blue-600">
              {wallet.points}
            </h2>
          </div>

          <div className="bg-white rounded-3xl shadow p-6">
            <p>Loyalty Tier</p>
            <h2 className="text-3xl font-bold">
              {tier}
            </h2>
          </div>

          <div className="bg-white rounded-3xl shadow p-6">
            <p>Lifetime Earnings</p>
            <h2 className="text-3xl font-bold text-purple-600">
              Ã¢â€šÂ¹{cashbackTotal + referralTotal}

          </div>

          <div className="bg-white rounded-3xl shadow p-6">

            <h2 className="text-2xl font-bold mb-4">
              Loyalty Program
            </h2>

            <ul className="space-y-2">
              <li>ÃƒÂ°Ã…Â¸Ã‚Â¥Ã‚Â¬ Every Order Earns Points</li>

        >
          <h2>Something went wrong</h2>

          <button
            onClick={() => reset()}
          >
            Try Again
          </button>
        </div>
      </body>
    </html>
  );
}
